verses.text: Ibi ni ivyo Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe vyerekeye Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu, ku ngoma ya Uziya, iya Yotamu, iya Ahazi n’iya Hezekiya, abami b’i Buyuda.
Nimwumve mwa majuru mwe! Umviriza wa si we! Kuko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Naronkeje abana, ndabakuza, ariko barangararije.
Inka iramenya shebuja, n’indogoba ikamenya ubwato shebuja ayigabuririramwo. Ariko Abisirayeli nta na kimwe bazi, ubwoko bwanje nta co butahura.”
Uragowe wa hanga rikora ivyaha, abantu bagirizwa ibigabitanyo bikomeye, uruvyaro rw’inkozi z’ibibi, abana bononekaye! Bataye Uhoraho , bakengera Uwera wa Isirayeli, bamuvako, basubira inyuma.
Ni igiki gitumye mushaka kwongera guhanwa? Ni igiki gituma muguma mu bugarariji? Ehe raba umutwe wuzuye ibikomere, umutima na wo uragwaye.
Uhereye mu kirenge ugashitsa ku mutwe, nta na hamwe hagikomeye. Mwuzuye inguma, ibivyimba n’ibisebe binuka, bitigeze vyozwa canke ngo bipfukwe, canke ngo bisigweko amavuta ya elayo.
Igihugu canyu carasanganguwe, ibisagara vyanyu vyarahiye. Amatongo yanyu ariko aranyagwa n’abanyamahanga mubiraba n’amaso yanyu, hasigaye ari mu gahinga, nk’ahasenyuwe n’abanyamahanga.
I Siyoni hasigaye hameze nk’akazu kashaje ko mu ruzabibu, hameze nk’akazu k’ivyatsi k’uwurarira umurima w’imyungu, hameze nk’igisagara gikikujwe n’ingabo zagiteye.
Iyo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose atadusigariza abadukomokako bakeya, tuba twararanduwe nk’ab’i Sodomu, tuba twaraherengetejwe nk’ab’i Gomora.
Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe batware b’i Sodomu! Nimwumve Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yacu yemwe bantu b’i Gomora.

“Mbega ibimazi vyanyu vyinshi bimariye iki?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. “Ndarambiwe n’ibimazi vyanyu bituriwe, vyaba ivy’amapfizi y’intama n’ibindi bitungwa binuze, ivyo mwama munshikanira, ndabihaze. Sinezerwa n’amaraso y’amashuri, canke ay’amapfizi y’intama, canke amasuguru y’impene.
Iyo muje kunshengerera, ni nde aba yababwiye ngo muze kumponyangira mu rugo?

Ntimuze musubire kunzanira ibimazi bitagira akamaro. Ibimota neza vyanyu biranukira. Ndarambiwe n’amakoraniro yanyu yo ku mboneko z’ukwezi n’ayo ku masabato, sincihanganira amakoraniro yanyu avanze n’ibibi.
Nzinutswe imisi mikuru y’imboneko z’ukwezi n’iyindi misi mikuru mwishingiye. Irandemereye. Naniwe no kuyihanganira.
Nimwaduza ibiganza musenga, nanje nzobanyegeza mu nyonga hanje. Naho mwosenga amasengesho menshi cane, sinzobumviriza. Ibiganza vyanyu vyuzuye amaraso.
Nimwiyuhagire, mushire ubuhoma. Nimunkure mu maso ibikorwa vyanyu bibi. Mureke gukora ibibi.
Nimwige gukora ivyiza. Murondere guca izigororotse, murenganure abarenganijwe. Muburanire impfuvyi, muvugire abapfakazi.”
“Ehe nimuze tuje inama,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Naho ivyaha vyanyu vyotukura tukutuku nzovyeza vyere derere nka shelegi. Naho vyotukura nk’amaraso, bizohinduka nk’ubwoya bwera cane.
Nimwemera mukanyumvira, muzorya ku vyiza vyo mu gihugu.
Ariko nimwaguma mungarariza, inkota izobarya.” Kuko ari ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimurabe ingene Yerusalemu, umugwa wari umwizigirwa, ubu wahindutse maraya. Wahora wuzuye imanza zigororotse, ubugororotsi ni ho bwibera, ariko ubu hasigaye ari ah’abicanyi.
Amafeza yanyu aguye ingese, n’imivinyu yanyu nta kanovera, yasutswemwo amazi.
Abatware banyu ni abagarariji, bagendana n’inkozi z’ibibi. Bose barya ibiturire, bagakunda gushikanirwa. Ntibaburanira impfuvyi, n’urubanza rw’abapfakazi ntirubashikira.
Ni co gituma Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Umunyenkomezi wa Isirayeli, avuze ati: Nzokwimarira ishavu kuri mwebwe mungwanya, ndabihore mwebwe abansi banje.
Nzohindukiza ukuboko ngwanye Yerusalemu, nzokuvugutira ndagukureko ingese, nzogukuramwo umwanda wose.
Nzogarukana abarongozi beza nk’abo mu gihe ca kera, nsubizeho abahanuzi nk’abo mu gihe ca mbere. Hanyuma uzokwitwa igisagara c’ubugororotsi, umugwa wizerwa.
Siyoni hazotabarwa n’ubutungane, abazokwihana bo muri Yerusalemu bazokizwa n’ukugororoka.
Ariko abagarariji n’abanyavyaha bazovunagurwa, n’abareka Uhoraho bazorandurwa.
“Muzoterwa isoni n’ugusenga ibigirwamana kwanyu muri musi y’imirinzi iyo mwanezerererwamwo, muzomaramara nimwibuka ya matongo, ayo mwatoranirije ibigirwamana.
Muzomera nk’umurinzi ufise amababi akabiranye, mumere nk’amatongo atagiramwo amazi.
Abahambaye bo muri mwebwe bazomera nk’icatsi cumye, ibikorwa vyabo na vyo bimere nk’ivyatsi bifashwe n’umuriro. Bazoshana na vyo, habure uwuzimya umuriro.”
Ibi ni ibindi Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe vyerekeye Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu:
Mu misi y’iherezo, umusozi uriko ingoro y’ Uhoraho uzoba ushimangiwe nk’umusozi usumba iyindi yose, uzoshirwa hejuru usumbe udusozi twose; kandi amahanga yose azohondogana aja kuri wo.

Amoko menshi azoza, avuge ati: “Nimuze tuduge tuje ku musozi w’ Uhoraho , mu ngoro y’Imana ya Yakobo. Izotwigisha inzira zayo kugira ngo tuzigenderemwo.” Kuko i Siyoni ari ho hazova ivyagezwe, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rive i Yerusalemu.

Azocira imanza amahanga, atature amatati hagati y’amoko menshi. Inkota zabo bazozicuramwo amasuka, amacumu yabo bayacuremwo imihoro. Nta hanga rizosubira gutera irindi, kandi ntibazosubira kwiga ivy’intambara.
Nimuze, yemwe ruvyaro rwa Yakobo, ehe nimuze tugendere mu muco w’ Uhoraho !
Uhoraho we, warahevye ubwoko bwawe, ari rwo ruvyaro rwa Yakobo. Buzuyemwo ivyo kugendereza vy’abanyamahanga bo mu buseruko, baraguza nk’Abafilisitiya, kandi bifatanya n’abanyamahanga.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ifeza n’inzahabu; ubutunzi bwabo ntibugira iherezo. Igihugu cabo cuzuye amafarasi; imikogote yabo ntigira igitigiri.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ibigirwamana, bunamira ibintu bakoresheje amaboko yabo, ivyo bacurishije intoke zabo.
Ni co gituma abo bantu bazocinyizwa, n’umuntu wese agacishwa bugufi. Ntuze ubaharire.
Nimwinjire mu masenga, mwinyegeze mu kuzimu ntimuhure n’ Uhoraho kuko biteye ubwoba cane ntimuhure n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe!
Amaso y’ubwibone azocishwa bugufi, n’ubwibone bwose bw’abantu bunyitswe; kuri uwo musi Uhoraho wenyene ni we azoshirwa hejuru.
Kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, arafise umusi yibikiye uwo azokwihorerako abishira hejuru n’abibona kandi n’igishizwe hejuru cose gicishwe bugufi.
Azoca amasederi maremere y’i Libani, hamwe n’imirinzi ikomakomeye y’i Bashani.
Imitumba miremire hamwe n’uturambi, bizoringanizwa.
Iminara miremire hamwe n’ibihome vyose bikomeye azobisenyagura.
Azomenagura amato y’abadandaji, n’amato y’igiciro kinini.
Ubwibone bw’abantu buzoshirwa hasi, abishira hejuru bose bacishwe bugufi. Uwo musi Uhoraho wenyene ni we azoba ashizwe hejuru.
Ibigirwamana bizokurwaho vyose.
Abantu bazohungira mu masenga y’amabuye no mu binogo vyimbwe mu kuzimu, ngo bahunge uburake bw’ Uhoraho , n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe igihe azohagurukira gutigitisha isi.
Kuri uwo musi w’urubanza, abantu bazota kure, baterere imbeba n’ubuhungarema, ibigirwamana vyabo bicuzwe mw’ifeza no mu nzahabu, ivyo bicuriye ngo babisenge.
Bazohungira mu masenga y’amabuye, no mu binogo vyo mu kuzimu, ngo bahunge uburake bw’ Uhoraho , n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe igihe azohagurukira gutigitisha isi.
Nimureke kwizigira abantu, kuko bameze nk’impwemu zo mu mazuru yabo. Mbega hari ico bobamarira?
Ehe raba, Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, agira anyage ab’i Yerusalemu n’ab’i Buyuda ivyo baronka n’ivyabashigikira: ivyo baronka vyose vyokurya n’ivyo baronka vyose vy’amazi.
Azohonya abahizi mu ntambara, abacamanza, abavugishwa, abapfumu hamwe n’abakuru,
intwazangabo irongora abasoda mirongo itanu n’abanyacubahiro, abahanuzi, abanyamyuga bahambaye hamwe n’inkerebutsi z’abaragura.
Nzobaha abana babo bababere abatware, abana bato babe ari bo babategeka.
Abantu bazocinyizanya, umugabo acinyize uwundi mugabo, umubanyi acinyize umubanyi wiwe. Umwana azosuzugura umutama, umuntu ata co amaze asuzugure umunyacubahiro.
Ico gihe umuntu azobwira uwo bavukana ati: “Ko ari wewe ufise umwambaro, ba ari wewe uba umutware wacu, abe ari wewe witaho ico kirundo c’umusaka!”
Ariko muri ico gihe na we azosemerera ababwire ati: “Erega nta co nobafasha! Simfise ivyokurya canke ivyambarwa mu nzu yanje; ntimungire umurongozi w’abantu.”
Yerusalemu haradandabagirana, n’i Buyuda haratemvye. Amajambo n’ibikorwa vyabo bigwanya Uhoraho , bagashinyagurira imbere y’ubwiza bwiwe.
Mu maso habo harabagiriza, bagenda berekana ivyaha vyabo nk’ab’i Sodomu, ntibabinyegeza. Baragowe! Bihamagariye ivyago.
Bwira abagororotsi ko bazomererwa neza, kuko bazorya ibivuye mu maboko yabo.
Ariko abanyavyaha bazobona ibara! Ivyago bizobagwako. Bazosubirizwa mu nkoko, ibihwanye n’ivyo bakoze.
Ubwoko bwanje bucinyijwe n’abana, abagore ni bo babutegeka. Yewe bwoko bwanje, abarongozi bawe barakuzimije, bagutesheje inzira.
Uhoraho yicaye ku ntebe y’imanza, ahagurukijwe no gucira urubanza ubwoko bwiwe.
Uhoraho yinjiye ngo ace urubanza arucira abatware n’abarongozi b’ubwoko bwiwe: “Ni mwebwe mwamponereje uruzabibu, ivyo mwanyaze abakene bikaba biri mu mazu yanyu.
Ni iki catumye musiribanga ubwoko bwanje, mukamenagura imitwe y’aboro?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Uhoraho aravuze ati: “Abakobwa b’i Siyoni buzuye ubwibone, bagenda baneze amazosi, barabisha amaso yuzuye ubushirasoni, kandi bakagenda baneze amazosi, bajegeza ibisharizo vy’imigufu bambaye ku maguru.
Ni co gituma Imana izoteza abakobwa b’i Siyoni ibisekera ku mitwe, imitwe yabo iyigire ibiharabuga.”
Kuri uwo musi Imana izokuraho ubwiza bw’ivyambarwa vyabo:
amahereni, imiringa yo ku maboko, hamwe n’imyitwikiro,
ingori, imigufu yo ku maguru, uducupa tw’ibimota neza, utugirwamana,
impeta zo ku ntoke n’izo ku mazuru,
amakanzu mezameza, impuzu zo kurenza hejuru n’udusaho,
ivyirore, inkenyerano zera hamwe n’ibitambara vyo ku mutwe.

Maze aho kumota neza, bazonuka; mu gishingo c’umukanda, azobakenyeza umugozi, mu gishingo co gusokoza uruhanika, azobaharangura imitwe, mu gishingo c’impuzu nziza azobambika amagunira, mu gishingo c’ubwiza, azobambika ibimaramare.
Abagabo banyu bazomarwa n’inkota, abagwanyi banyu na bo bazogwa ku rugamba.
Amarembo y’i Siyoni azorira aboroge, igisagara gisanganguwe, kizokwicara hasi.

Muri ico gihe, abagore indwi bazofata umugabo umwe, bamubwire bati: “Tuzorya ivyokurya twirondereye, kandi tuzokwironderera impuzu twambara. Twemerere gusa twitirirwe izina ryawe, udukureko ibimaramare.”
Ariko muri ico gihe ishami ry’ Uhoraho rizokwambikwa ubwiza n’ugukayangana, kandi amasigarira y’Abisirayeli azokwishimira yongere anezererwe ivyamwa vyo mu gihugu.
Abazoba basigaye i Siyoni, bakaguma i Yerusalemu, bazokwitwa abera. Ni abazoba barokotse bakaba banditswe mu gitabu c’abazima i Yerusalemu.
Imana izokwoza imyanda y’abakobwa b’i Siyoni, ihanagure amaraso yasesekeye i Yerusalemu ikoresheje impwemu y’urubanza n’impwemu y’umuriro.
Ku murango, Uhoraho azorema igicu kibe hejuru y’umusozi Siyoni hamwe n’abahakoranira bose, mw’ijoro na ho aharemere imbeya z’umuriro. Icubahiro ciwe kizoba hejuru ya vyose nk’ihema rinini rihapfutse.
Kizoba ubwugamo n’igitutu mu bushuhe bwo ku murango, n’ubuhungiro n’ubwihisho mu gihe c’igihuhusi n’imvura.
Reka ndirimbire umukunzi wanje, indirimbo y’umurima wiwe w’imizabibu: Umukunzi wanje yari afise umurima w’imizabibu ku musozi umera cane.

Uwo musozi yarawurimye, akuraho amabuye, atoranya imizabibu myiza kurusha iyindi, ayitera kuri wo. Awubakako umunara, ashiramwo n’ubwato baganiramwo. Mu nyuma aja kuraba ko yoronka inzabibu nziza yokwimbura, ariko asanga huzuyeyo ibihumbwa gusa.
None rero yemwe ababa i Yerusalemu, namwe bagabo b’i Buyuda, nimuducire urubanza twe n’uwo murima wanje.
Ni igiki kirengeye ivyo nari gukorera uwo murima wanje w’imizabibu? Ni kuki wamye ibihumbwa, kandi nari niteze ko unyamira inzabibu nziza?
Hinge ndababwire ico ngiye gukorera uwo murima wanje w’imizabibu: Nzosambura inzitiro zawo, kugira ngo wonwe. Nzosenyura impome ziwukikuje, kugira ngo uze uhonyangwe.
Nzowuhonya, ntuzotuturirwa, ntuzonabagarirwa, amahwa n’ibitovu ni vyo bizowumeramwo. Nzotegeka ibicu, ntihagire imvura iwugwamwo.

Umurima w’imizabibu w’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni inzu ya Isirayeli, abantu b’i Buyuda na bo ni bo murima wamuhimbara. Uhoraho yari abitezeko imanza zigororotse, ariko abona ugusesa amaraso, yabarondeyeko ukugororoka, ariko abumvamwo amarira n’imibabaro.
Muragowe mwebwe mwomeka amazu ku yandi, amatongo ku yandi mukifataniriza, igihugu mukaciganzira, ngo mukibemwo mwenyene.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yabivuze numva, ati: “Ndababwije ukuri, amazu mezameza azosambuka, kandi n’amazu maninimanini azosigara ata wuyabamwo.
Ihegitari zitatu z’imizabibu zizovamwo ingero batu imwe gusa y’umutobe, ingero homeru y’imbuto z’ingano izovamwo ingero efa imwe gusa y’umwimbu.”
Muragowe mwebwe muzindukira kunywa ibiboreza mukarara mwicaye, mwishusha mu kunywa umuvinyu.
Ibirori vyabo birimwo inanga, amakembe, ingoma, imyironge n’umuvinyu, ariko nta wubabara ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho , nta wuha agaciro ibikorwa vy’amaboko yiwe.
Ni co gituma abantu banje bazoja mu kinyago, kuko batigeze bagira ugutahura. Abashizwe hejuru bo muri bo bazokwicwa n’inzara, abaciye bugufi bicwe n’inyota.
Ni co gituma i kuzimu haguye umuhogo waho, hagataburura umunwa cane. Abubashwe n’amasinzi hazobamira, bajane n’amasinzi y’imborerwa zaho.
Abantu bazosubizwa hasi, kandi n’umwana w’umuntu acishijwe bugufi, amaso y’abibone amaramare.
Ariko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azoshirwa hejuru mu bugororotsi bwiwe, kandi Imana Yera izokwerekanwa ko ari iyera n’ibikorwa vyayo vy’ubugororotsi.
Ico gihe intama zizorisha nk’iziri mu buragiro bwazo, imyagazi na yo izorisha ahahora amazu y’abatunzi.
Bazobona ibara abakwegesha ivyaha imigozi y’ububeshi. Bakwegana n’ivyaha vyabo nk’uko umuntu akwega umukogote.
Ni bo bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho nanyaruke; nanyarutse igikorwa ciwe, natwe tukibone. Integuro y’Uwera wa Isirayeli nitwegere, nishike aho tuyibona kugira ngo tuyimenye.”
Bazobona ibara abafata ibibi bakavyita ivyiza, ivyiza na vyo bakavyita ibibi. Umuco bawita umwijima, umwijima bakawita umuco. Kuri bo, ikirura kirasosa, igisosa na co kirarura.
Baragowe abigira abanyabwenge mu mitima, bakibona ko bafise ubumenyi bukomeye.
Baragowe abigira abahizi mu kunywa umuvinyu, no mu kugana inzoga zikaze,
bakarya ibiturire kugira beze uwatsinzwe n’icaha, bagatsindisha uwutagira ico azira.

Ni co gituma, bazozimangana nk’ubwatsi buturirwa n’umuriro, imizi yabo izobora, n’amashurwe yabo azokabirana; kuko bataye Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, birengagiza ijambo ry’Uwera wa Isirayeli.

Ni co gituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bururumvye ku bantu biwe, ukuboko kwiwe akakubangurira kubahonya. Imisozi izonyiganyiga, imivyimba y’abapfuye izokwandagara ku mabarabara nk’imyanda. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Azorungikira amahanga ikimenyetso ari kure. Azovuza uruhwa ahamagare abo ku mpera z’isi, maze bose bazosiganwa baja i Yerusalemu.
Nta n’umwe muri bo azoruha canke ngo atsitare. Nta wuzohunyiza canke ngo asinzire. Imikanda yabo ntizokenyuruka, n’imigozi y’ibirato vyabo ntizocika.
Imyampi yabo irasongoye, n’imiheto yabo irabanze. Ibinono vy’ifarasi zabo bimeze nk’amabuye y’amasare, imikogote yabo yiruka nk’agashururu.
Ukwivuga kwabo ni nk’ukw’intambwe, bivuga nk’imikangara y’intare. Ziraroha iyo zigize ico zubura, zikagitwara ata gitabara.
Muri ico gihe, hazoba imituragaro hejuru kandi abazoterera amaso mu gihugu, bazobona ukwiraburanirwa kuvuye ku mibabaro, n’umuco uzozimanganywa n’ibicu.
Mu mwaka Uziya yapfa, nabonye Imana yicaye ku ntebe y’inganji ishizwe hejuru, imisozo y’ikanzu yayo yuzuye Ingoro.
Abaserafi bari hejuru yayo, umwumwe wese afise amababa atandatu. Amababa abiri bayipfukisha mu maso, yandi abiri bakayapfukisha amaguru yabo, ayandi abiri bakayagurukisha.
Bahamagarana bavuga bati: “Uwera, Uwera, Uwera ni we Uhoraho Mushoboravyose; isi yose yuzuye icubahiro ciwe.”
Ijwi ry’indirimbo yabo rinyiganyiza ibishimaryango n’umushinge vy’Ingoro kandi na rwo rwuzura umwotsi.
Nca ndatakamba nti: “Yewe jewe ndagowe, kuko iminwa yanje yanduye, kandi mba mu bantu bafise iminwa yanduye, none amaso yanje akaba abonye Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose!”
Umwe mu baserafi aca aguruka aza aho ndi afise ikara ryaka mu ntoke, yokoje icuma cokora amakara ku gicaniro.
Arinkoza ku munwa avuga ati: “Ehe raba iri kara rikoze ku munwa wawe, ukugabitanya kwawe ugukuweko, n’ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe.”
Nca numva ijwi ry’Imana ribaza riti: “Ni nde notuma? Ni nde yogenda mu gishingo cacu?” Nanje nca ndishura nti: “Ndi hano ntuma!”
Na we aca ambwira ati: “Genda umbwirire barya bantu uti: ‘Muze mwame mwumva ariko ntimuze mwigere mutahura. Muze mwame muraba ariko ntimuze mwigere mubona.’

Genda ukomantaze imitima y’abo bantu, amatwi yabo uyazivye, amaso yabo uyahumye. Kugira ngo ntibashobore kubonesha amaso yabo, no kwumvisha amatwi yabo, canke ngo batahurishe imitima yabo, bagahava bahindukira, nanje nkabakiza.”

Nanje nca ndabaza nti: “None ga Mwami, ivyo bizomara igihe kingana gute?” Na we aranyishura ati: “Gushika ibisagara vyabo bisambutse, ata na kimwe gisigaye gihagaze, amazu yose agasigara agaragara, igihugu cose kigahinduka igisanze,
gushika ndabirukanye kure, bagata igihugu cabo cose.

Kandi n’aho hosigara igice kimwe kuri cumi c’igihugu, na ho nyene kizosubira gisamburwe. Ariko nk’uko ibiti vyitwa terebinti na aloni bisiga ibishitsi vyavyo iyo vyiciwe, ni ko imbuto yejejwe izozigamwa nk’igishitsi muri kino gihugu.”
Ku ngoma ya Ahazi mwene Yotamu, Yotamu mwene Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda, Rezini umwami w’i Siriya hamwe na Peka mwene Remaliya umwami wa Isirayeli bagiye gutera i Yerusalemu, ariko biranka ko bahafata.
Abo mu nzu ya Dawidi babwirwa ngo: “Siriya yifatanije na Efurayimu.” Umwami Ahazi n’abantu bose baranduka imitima, bahinda agashitsi kurya kw’ibiti bihuye n’umuyaga w’igihuhusi.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Yesaya ati: “Sohoka ujane n’umuhungu wawe Sheyari-Yashubi, muje guhura na Ahazi muhurire aho umugende ujana amazi kw’itangi yo haruguru ugarukira, ku nzira ija aho bamesurira.
Umubwire uti: ‘Tekana ugumye umutima, ntugire ubwoba. Ntucike ivutu kubera uburake bwa Rezini na Siriya hamwe na mwene Remaliya. Bameze nk’ibiti biri mu ziko bifumba umwotsi gusa.
Abana ba Siriya, Efurayimu na Remaliya bagiye inama yo kukugwanya, bavuga bati:
“Reka dutere i Buyuda, tuhagabangane hagati yacu maze mwene Tabeyeli tumugire umwami waho.”
Ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ivyo ntibizoba, ntibizokwigera biba,

kuko Siriya ntihakomeye gusumvya umugwa mukuru waho, Damasiko. Kandi Damasiko ntihakomeye gusumvya umwami waho, Rezini. Nayo mu myaka mirongo itandatu n’itanu, aba Efurayimu bazoherengetezwa ntibabe bacitwa ihanga.
Umugwa mukuru wa Efurayimu ni Samariya, kandi uwuganza Samariya ni mwene Remaliya. Nimba mudashikamye mu kwizera, ntimuzohagarara na gatoya.’ ”
Uhoraho arasubira atuma kuri Ahazi,
ati: “Saba Uhoraho Imana yawe aguhe ikimenyetso, caba ikiri kure i kuzimu, canke kure hejuru mu kirere.”
Ariko Ahazi avuga ati: “Nta kimenyetso nsaba, sinokwubahuka kugerageza Uhoraho .”
Maze Yesaya aca avuga ati: “Nimwumve rero yemwe abakomoka kuri Dawidi! Mbega ntibihagije kugerageza ukwihangana kw’abantu? None mugomba no kugerageza ukwihangana kw’Imana yanje na kwo?
Ko bimeze uko Imana izokwitangira ikimenyetso yo nyene: inkumi izosama inda, ivyare umwana w’umuhungu kandi bazomwita Emanuweli.
Azotungwa n’amata avuze hamwe n’ubuki gushika amaze kumenya gutandukanya ikibi n’iciza.
Ariko imbere yo kumenya gutandukanya ivyo, ibihugu vy’abo bami babiri utinya cane bizoba bisigaye ari ubugaragwa ata muntu akihaba.
Uhoraho azozana ivyago bikomeye kuri mwebwe no ku bwoko bwanyu no ku muryango wanyu. Muzoterwa n’ubwoba mutigeze mugira kuva Abefurayimu bitandukanije n’Abayuda. Azorungika umwami wa Ashuri abatere.”
Uwo musi Uhoraho azovuza uruhwa gusa, maze isazi zizanane kw’isesero ry’uruzi Nili, inzuki na zo zizanane mu gihugu ca Ashuri.
Zizozira icarimwe zisagaze ku mimanuko ihanamye, mu masenga yo mu bitandara, ku bisaka vy’amahwa yose no ku binogo vy’amazi vyose.
Uwo musi Uhoraho azokota urwembe akuye hakurya y’uruzi Efurate ari rwo mwami wa Ashuri, arukoreshe mu kubamwa ahantu hose: imitwe yanyu, ahari ubwoya hose, hamwe n’ubwanwa.
Inyuma y’ivyo bihe, umuntu atunze azoba afise inyana y’inka imwe hamwe n’impene zibiri gusa.
Ariko hazoba umusesekara w’amata zizokamwa, kuko igihugu kizoba casigayemwo abantu bake cane. Amasigarira azoba yasigaye mu gihugu azonywa amata avuze arye n’ubuki.
Uwo musi ahahora hari umurima w’imizabibu igihumbi wogurwa shekeli igihumbi z’ifeza nyene, hazosigara hari imikere n’ibitovu gusa.
Abahigi bazokwinjirayo bitwaje imyampi n’imiheto, kuko igihugu cose kizoba cuzuye amahwa n’ibitovu.
Nayo imitumba yahora irimishwa amasuka, ntimuzoba mukiyishikako kubera gutinya amahwa n’ibitovu. Hazohinduka uburagiro ibitungwa bizorishamwo.
Uhoraho ambarira ati: “Fata umuzingo munini uwandikeko n’ikaramu isanzwe uti: Maheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bazi.”
Maze nca mpamagara Uriya umuherezi na Zakariya mwene Yeberekiya, ngo bambere ivyabona vyizerwa yuko nabikoze.
Hanyuma ndyamana n’umugore wanje w’umuvugishwakazi, asama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu. Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Numwite Maheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bazi.
Imbere y’uko uwo mwana amenya kuvuga ngo data canke mama, umwami wa Ashuri azoba yaramaze gutwara ubutunzi bwose bw’i Damasiko n’i Samariya.”
Uhoraho yongera ambwira ati:
Kubera ko aba bantu bagaye ukubitaho kwanje kugereranywa n’amazi meza atemba y’i Shilowa, bakanezerererwa umwami Rezini hamwe na mwene Remaliya,
nuko rero Uhoraho agiye kubateza umwuzure w’inkomezi nyinshi, uvuye ku ruzi Efurate, ni wo mwami wa Ashuri n’ingabo ziwe. Uzosendanisha urengere imivo yose, urengere n’inkombe zarwo zose,
kugeza ushike n’i Buyuda, uharengere, uzosendanisha uduge gushika no ku mazosi y’abantu. Kandi nirwasanzara ruzokwira igihugu cawe cose, yewe Emanuweli.
Nimuje hamwe yemwe mahanga, muhinde agashitsi! Nimwumve namwe abo mu bihugu vya kure mwese. Mwitegurire intambara, ariko muhinde agashitsi! Mwitegurire intambara, ariko muhinde agashitsi!
Nimuje inama, ariko inama zanyu zizoba impfagusa. Nimwagira n’ico mupfundika ntikizorama, kuko Imana iri ku ruhande rwacu.
Uhoraho yamfatishije ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi, ambwira anyihanikiriza ati: Ntuzogendere mu ngeso z’ubwo bwoko:
Ntimwite umugararizo ibintu vyose abo bita umugararizo; ntimugatinye ivyo batinya, kandi na bo ubwabo ntimubatinye.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abe ari we wenyene mwita Uwera, ni we mukwiye kwubaha, ni we mukwiye gutinya.
Azobazigama. Ariko kuri Yerusalemu no ku Buyuda, azobabera ibuye batsitarako, n’urutare rutuma bagwa. Kandi ababa i Yerusalemu bose, azobabera umutego.
Benshi muri bo bazomutsitarako bagwe; bazogwa bavunagurike, bazogwa mu mutego.
Bika neza ico gishingantahe, ivyagezwe ubifatanishe ikimenyetso mu bigishwa banje.
Nzororera Uhoraho , yahishije ab’inzu ya Yakobo mu maso hiwe. Ni we nzokwizigira.
Ehe raba jewe, n’abana Uhoraho yampaye, turi abo kubera Abisirayeli ibimenyetso biva k’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ahangamye ku Musozi Siyoni.

Nihagira umuntu akubwira ngo uje kuraguza ku bapfumu n’abasiguza imizimu, bavuga bongorera kandi bajwigira kugira ngo bakubwire ivyo muri kazoza, mbega igikwiye si ugusiguza Imana yanyu? Ni kuki muja kubaza abapfuye ivy’abakiriho?
Nimusuzumire ivyo bavuga ku vyagezwe vyanje no ku ntahe! Nimba bavuga ibitandukanye n’ijambo ryanje, bazokwama mu mwijima.
Ukwihebura n’ikigoyi ni vyo bizorangwa mu gihugu cabo. Nibafatwa n’ikigoyi, bazoterwa n’ishavu, maze barabe hejuru, bavume umwami wabo n’Imana yabo.
Bazoraba hasi babone amakuba n’umwijima, n’umubabaro w’umururazi, kandi bazotererwa mu mwijima w’umuzitanya.

Naho biri uko, umwijima ntuzokwamaho ibihe vyose ku bari mu mubabaro. Muri kahise yacishije bugufi intara ya Zebuloni n’iya Nafutali. Ariko muri kazoza azotera iteka inzira ija ku kiyaga, hakurya ya Yorodani, i Galilaya h’Abanyamahanga.
Abantu bahora bagendera mu mwijima babonye umuco mwinshi. Ababa mu gihugu c’umwijima w’umuzitanya bakiwe n’umuco mwinshi.
Waragwije ihanga, wongereza umunezero w’abantu baho; banezererewe imbere yawe, nk’uko abantu banezerwa mw’iyimbura, nk’uko abagwanyi banezerwa iyo bariko baragabura iminyago.
Kuko umutwaro wahora ubaremereye, ikimoko bakubitwa ku mugongo n’inkoni bakubitwa n’uwabacinyiza, wabivunaguye, nk’uko wabigiriye Abamidiyani.
Ibirato vyose vyambawe mu ntambara, n’impuzu yavumbagajwe mu maraso, bizoturirwa, bitongorwe n’umuriro.
Kuko umwana avutse ku neza yacu, duhawe umwana w’umuhungu, ubutware bwose buzoba ku bitugu vyiwe. Azokwitwa Umujenama w’igitangaza, Imana ikomeye, Data ahoraho, Umwami w’amahoro.

Ubutware bwiwe n’amahoro yiwe ntibizogira iherezo. Azoganzira ku ntebe ya Dawidi, no mu bwami bwiwe, aganzanye ubutungane n’ukugororoka, uhereye ico gihe, gushitsa ibihe vyose. Ishaka ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo rizobishitsa.
Uhoraho arungikiye ubutumwa Yakobo, bushika kuri Isirayeli.
Abantu bose bazobimenya; baba Abefurayimu canke ababa i Samariya, ari bo bavugana ubwibone, bagakomantaza imitima, bavuga bati:
“Amatafari yarakoraguritse, ariko tuzosubira tugisanuze amabuye abaje. Ibiti vy’imisukomora vyariciwe, ariko tuzobisubiriza amasederi.”
Ariko Uhoraho azobaneshesha umwansi wabo Rezini, kandi azokwongerereza ububasha abansi babo.
Abasiriya bo mu buseruko n’Abafilisitiya bo mu burengero, bazokwasama babatabagure. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Ariko abo bantu ntibagarutse ku wabahanye, ntibarondeye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
None rero, ku musi umwe wonyene, Uhoraho azoca Isirayeli umutwe n’umurizo, ikigazi n’irenga abicire amababi umusi umwe.
Abatware n’abahambaye muri Isirayeli ni bo mutwe, abavugishwa b’ibinyoma na bo ni bo murizo.
Abarongora abo bantu barabayobeza, abayobowe na bo barazimijwe.

Uhoraho ntazonezererwa abasore, kandi ntazogirira impuhwe impfuvyi n’abapfakazi. Kuko bose bahevye Imana, bagakora ibibi; akanwa kabo kavuga ububeshi gusa. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Erega ubugarariji buturira nk’umuriro, utongora imikere n’amahwa, ugatuma ishamba rinini rirurumba, umwotsi ugapfunduka umeze nk’igicu mu kirere.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose butumye igihugu gitongorwa, abantu biwe bamera nk’inkwi zo gucana. Abantu bazoryana ata kubabarirana.
Bazoshikura i buryo ariko bagume bashonje. Bazorya i bubamfu, na ho nyene ntibahage. Mu mperuka, abantu bazorya n’inyama z’abana babo.
Manase azorya Efurayimu, Efurayimu na we arye Manase. Bompi bazohindukira batere Yuda. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Muragowe mwebwe mushinga amategeko y’akarenganyo, mugashinga amategeko acinyiza abantu.
Munyaga abakene utwabo, mukareka gucira imanza zibereye abacinyijwe bo mu bwoko bwanje, abapfakazi mubagira iminyago yanyu, impfuvyi mukazisahura utwazo.
Mbega ku musi w’imanza muzogira gute, igihe amakuba azobashikako avuye kure? Muzohungira kwa nde ngo abatabare? Mbega ubutunzi bwanyu muzobunyegeza he?
Nta kindi muzoba musigaje atari ukuburanirwa muri mu banyagano, canke imivyimba yanyu ikagwa mu basogoswe. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
“Uragowe, yewe Ashuri, wewe nkoni y’ishavu ryanje, inkoni witwaje ni yo burake bwanje.
Nzogutuma gutera ihanga ritubaha Imana, nzokurungika mu bwoko buntera ishavu, ubasahure wongere ubatware nk’iminyago, ubahonyangishe ibirenge nk’uwuhonyanga ivyondo mu nzira.
Ariko umwami wa Ashuri ntazoba atahura ko ari igikoresho canje, ivyo si vyo azoba afise mu mutwe; intumbero yiwe ni uguhonya, ashire iherezo ku mahanga menshi.
Kuko avuga ati: umwe wese mu baganwa banje azoba umwami vuba.
Tuzosangangura Kalino nk’uko twabikoreye Karikemishi, Hamati hazogwa mu maboko yacu nk’uko vyagendeye Arupadi. Kandi tuzosangangura Samariya nk’uko twabikoze i Damasiko.
Ko ukuboko kwanje kwashoboye gufata ubwami bufise ibigirwamana, ubwami bwasumvya ibigirwamana Yerusalemu na Samariya,
mbega sinzomara amanyama Yerusalemu n’ibigirwamana vyaho, nk’uko namaze amanyama Samariya n’ibigirwamana vyaho?”
Uhoraho niyamara gushitsa ivyago yateguriye umusozi Siyoni na Yerusalemu, azovuga ati: “Ngiye guhana umwami wa Ashuri, kuko yuzuye ubwibone n’ukwishira hejuru.

Kuko azovuga ati: ‘Narabikoze jewe ubwanje, ndabikoresheje inkomezi z’ukuboko kwanje n’ubwenge bwanje, kuko ndi umunyabwenge. Nakuyeho imbibe hagati y’amahanga, nanyaze ubutunzi bwaho; mu butwari bwinshi, nakuye ku ngoma abami benshi.

Nk’uko umuntu yaruza icari, ni ko ukuboko kwanje kwatwaye ubutunzi bw’amahanga. Nk’uko umuntu yegeranya amagi, ni ko negeranije ibihugu vyo kw’isi vyose. Nta n’umwe yakubise n’ibaba, nta n’uwaryogoye.’ ”
Mbega incabiti yokwirata ku wuyikoresha? Canke umusumeno wokwishima ku wuwukoresha? Mbega inkoni yokubita ata wuyikubitishije, canke inkoni yokwigendagendesha ata wuyishimikije?
Ni co gituma Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azoteza ingwara abasoda bawe bakomeye, amagara abashiremwo, kandi musi y’ubwiza bwiwe, hazocanwa umuriro umuriro utongora.
Uhoraho , Umuco wa Isirayeli, azohinduka umuriro; kandi Uwera azohinduka nk’urubeya. Ku musi umwe, azotongora ayo mahwa n’imikere.
Ubwiza bw’amashamba yiwe n’amatongo yiwe amera, bizotikizwa bihere, bimere nk’umugwayi acikanye.
Ibiti bizosigara muri ayo mashamba yaho bizoba ari bike, ku buryo n’umwana yobiharura.
Kuri uwo musi amasigarira ya Isirayeli, abazoba barokotse ba Yakobo, ntibazoba bakimwisunga ntibazisunga uwabakubise, ahubwo bazokwizigira Uhoraho , Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Amasigarira azogaruka, amasigarira ya Yakobo azogaruka ku Mana Ikomeye.
Isirayeli we, naho abantu bawe ari nk’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga, inkehwa gusa ni zo zizogaruka. Agatikizo karamaze gutegurwa, Uhoraho yahisemwo kubatikiza kuko ari co babereye.
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azoshitsa ako gatikizo ku gihugu cose, nk’uko yabiteguye.
None rero uku ni ko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze: “Yemwe bwoko bwanje buba i Siyoni, ntimutinye Abashuri, babakubita inkoni, bakababangurira ibibando, nk’uko Abanyegiputa babigira.
Hasigaye igihe gito, uburake nari mfitiye mwebwe bugahera, uburake bwanje buzoba agatikizo k’Abashuri.”
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azobakubitisha ikimoko, nk’uko yakubitiye Abamidiyani ku gitandara c’i Horebu, kandi azoramvurira inkoni yiwe hejuru y’amazi, nk’uko yabigize muri Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi imitwaro yabo izokurwa ku bitugu vyanyu, ingogo zabo zikurwe ku mazosi yanyu; ingogo izovunika kuko muzoba mwaravyibushe cane.
Ehe raba Abashuri bageze muri Ayiyati; baciye i Miguroni, i Mikimashi bahagize ububiko bw’ibikoresho vyabo.
Bariko barajabuka, bavuga bati: “Tuza gucumbika ijoro ryose i Geba.” Ab’i Rama barajugumiye, ab’i Gibeya kwa Sawuli barahunze.
Semerera yewe Mukobwa w’i Galimu! Umviriza yewe Layisha, nawe Anatoti wigorewe!
Ab’i Medimena bariko barahunga, ab’i Gebimu barinyegeje.
Ariko uwo musi bazogira ikambi i Nobu, baforere ingumu umukobwa w’i Siyoni, ku musozi wa Yerusalemu.
Ehe raba, Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azotemaguza amashami inkomezi ziwe zihambaye. Ibiti birusha ibindi uburebure bizotemwa, birebire na vyo bicishwe bugufi.
Azotemesha incabiti amashamba akomeye, Libani hazokubitwa hasi n’Umunyenkomezi.
Umunago uzova ku gishitsi ca Dawidi, kandi ishami riva ku mizi yaco rizokwama ivyamwa.
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho azoba kuri we; ni we Mpwemu w’ubwenge n’ugutahura, Mpwemu w’ukuja inama kandi w’ububasha, Mpwemu w’ubumenyi n’ukwubaha Uhoraho .
Azonezerezwa no kwubaha Uhoraho . Ntazoca imanza afatiye ku vyo abonesheje amaso, canke ngo afatire ingingo ku vyo yumvise;
ahubwo abakene azobacira izigororotse, azotunganiriza aboro bo kw’isi bose. Azokubitisha isi inkoni yo mu kanwa kiwe, kandi impwemu zo mu kanwa kiwe zizotikiza abagarariji.
Ukugororoka kuzoba nk’umukanda, kandi ubwizigirwa azobwambara mu rukenyerero.
Ico gihe amabingira azobana n’imyagazi y’intama, ingwe iryamane n’impene, inyana y’inka igendane n’intare, biragirwe n’umwana mutoya.
Inka izorisha hamwe n’idubu, inyana zavyo zizoryamana, intare zizorisha ubwatsi nk’inka.
Umwana yonka azokinira ku mwobo w’imvuvyi, n’umucuko azoshira ukuboko kwiwe mu mwobo w’inkoma.
Nta bizoba bikiryana canke ngo vyonone ku musozi wanje wera iyo uva ukagera, kuko isi izokwuzura ukumenya Uhoraho , nk’uko amazi yuzura ikiyaga.
Ico gihe uwukomoka kuri Isayi azoba ibendera ry’agakiza k’isi yose; amahanga yose azokwifatanya na we, kandi ikibanza c’uburuhukiro bwiwe kizoba ic’ubwiza.

Ico gihe Uhoraho azoramvura ukuboko kwiwe ubugira kabiri, agarukane amasigarira y’abantu biwe abakuye muri Ashuri, abadugane abakuye muri Egiputa, muri Etiyopiya, muri Elamu, i Babiloni, i Hamati, no mu mazinga yo mu biyaga.
Azodugiriza ibendera amahanga, yegeranye Abisirayeli basabagiye. Azokwegeranya ubwoko bw’Abayuda bwashwiragiye, abakure ku mpande zine z’isi.
Ni ho ishari rya Efurayimu rizokamanganira, abansi ba Yuda na bo bahaherengeterezwe; Efurayimu ntazokwongera kugirira ishari Yuda, canke ngo Yuda agirire urwanko Efurayimu.
Bazokwiyunga, bacakire imisozi y’Abafilisitiya mu burengero, kandi bazoja hamwe banyage amahanga yo mu buseruko. Bazokwigarurira Edomu na Mowabu, kandi Abamoni bazoba abagurano babo.
Uhoraho azokamya ikigobe c’ikiyaga ca Egiputa, azohungabanisha uruzi Efurate ukuboko kwiwe. Azorucamwo imigende indwi, kugira ngo abantu bashobore kurujabuka bambaye isandare.
Hazobaho inzira yagutse ku bantu biwe b’amasigarira bazoza bavuye muri Ashuri, nk’iyo Abisirayeli baciyemwo bava muri Egiputa.
Ico gihe uzovuga uti: “Ndaguhimbaza, ewe Uhoraho . Naho wandakiye, uburake bwawe bwaraheze, kandi urandemesheje.
Ni ukuri Uhoraho ni we gakiza kanje, nzomwizigira kandi sinzotinya. Uhoraho Imana ubwiwe ni we nkomezi zanje n’indirimbo yanje, yambereye agakiza.”
Muzovoma amazi munezerewe kw’isoko y’agakiza.
Uwo musi muzovuga muti: “Nimushimire Uhoraho , mwambaze izina ryiwe, mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze, muvuge ko izina ryiwe rihambaye.
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho , kuko yakoze ibihambaye; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga yose ivyo yakoze.
Nimuririmbane umunezero, yemwe bantu b’i Siyoni, kuko Uwera wa Isirayeli aba hagati muri mwebwe ahambaye.”
Ibi ni vyo Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe, vyerekeye ugutikizwa kwa Babiloni:
Nimushinge ibendera ku musozi muremure utagirako ibiti; musemerere mubabwire; mubahamagare binjire mu marembo y’abanyacubahiro.
Jewe Uhoraho , ni je nategetse ingabo zanje, zinezererwa icubahiro canje, kugira ngo zishitse ivy’uburake bwanje.
Nimwumve urwamo ku misozi, rumeze nk’urw’ingabo isinzi! Nimwumve urwamo rw’ubwami, rumeze nk’urw’amahanga ateranye! Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ariko aragenzura ingabo, nk’abasoda biteguriye intambara.
Baje bava mu bihugu vya kure, iyo amajuru aherera. Bazananye n’ Uhoraho n’ibigwanisho vyiwe, kugira ngo batikize igihugu cose.
Nimuboroge, kuko umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi gushika. Uzobashikira umeze nk’agatikizo karungitswe n’Iyishoboravyose.
Ivyo bizotuma amaboko y’ingabo zikomeye adendebukirwa, umutima ukomeye na wo ucike ivutu.
Bazocika intege, umubabaro n’uburibwe bizobafata, baribwe nk’umugore ari ku bise. Bazorabana mu maso bumirwe, kandi mu maso habo hazohishira hase n’umuriro.
Ehe raba umusi w’ Uhoraho urashitse, umusi w’uburake bw’inkazi buteye ubwoba. Azotikiza igihugu gicike ubugaragwa, abanyavyaha bashirane na co.
Inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru ntizizokwaka. Izuba riserutse rizocura umwijima, ukwezi ntikuzobonesha.
Ab’isi nzobahanira ibibi bakoze, n’abagarariji ndabahanire ivyaha vyabo. Abishira hejuru nzobamara ubwibone, ncishe bugufi agasuzuguro k’abanyacubahiro.
Nzomara abantu, basigare bakenye kurya kw’inzahabu z’indobanurwa, kandi abantu bazokena gusumvya inzahabu y’agaciro yo muri Ofiru.
Kuko nzotigitisha amajuru, isi inyiganyige, ive mu kibanza cayo, ndabikoreshejwe n’umujinya w’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ku musi w’uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi.
Maze umuntu wese azosubira inyuma ahunga nk’ingeregere ihigwa, canke intama itagira umwungere, umwe wese asubire iwabo, umwe wese ahungire mu gihugu ciwe.
Uwo bazobona wese azotoborwa n’umwampi, kandi uwuzofatwa wese azosogotwa inkota.
Inzoya zabo bazozifyonyangira imbere yabo, amazu yabo azosahurwa, abagore babo bafatwe ku nguvu.
Ehe raba nzobateza Abamedi, batitaho ifeza, batanezererwa inzahabu.
Imyampi yabo izotobekeranya abasore; kandi inzoya ntibazozigirira akagongwe, canke ngo bagirire impuhwe abana.
Babiloni, mu cubahiro c’ubwami bw’amahanga, ubwiza bw’ubwibone bw’Abakaludaya, nzohatikiza, nk’uko natikije Sodomu na Gomora.
Nta bantu bazosubira kuhaba, kandi nta wuzosubira kuhubaka uko urunganwe ruzogenda rurakurikirana. Abungere bama bimuka ntibazosubira kuhashinga ihema, nta n’umwungere azosubira kuharagira.
Ariko ibikoko vyo mu bugaragwa ni vyo bizohaba, imbwebwe ni zo zizokwuzura mu mazu yaho; ibihuna ni vyo bizoba mu mazu yaho, kandi impene z’inyeshamba ni zo zizohakinira.
Imfyisi zizogerera mu mazu maninimanini yaho, imbwebwe zibere mu mazu mezameza yaho. Igihe caho kirageze, umusi waho ntuzoteba gushika.
Uhoraho azogirira impuhwe aba Yakobo, asubire atoranye Abisirayeli, abasubize mu gihugu cabo. Abanyamahanga bazokwifatanya na bo, biyunge n’uruvyaro rwa Yakobo.

Amahanga ni yo azobarerura abagarukane mu gihugu cabo. Kandi igihugu ca Isirayeli kizokwigarurira amahanga kiyahindure abagurano n’abaguranokazi mu gihugu c’ Uhoraho . Kizogira imbohe abari barakigize imbohe, kiganze abari barakiganje.
Kuri uwo musi w’igitangaza, aho Uhoraho azobamarira imibabaro n’ubwoba vyo mu buja no mu minyororo,
umwami w’i Babiloni muzomwitamba ku muvyimba muvuga muti: Mbega vyagenze gute ngo uwucinyiza azimangane? Ubwicanyi bwiwe buheze gute?
Uhoraho yavunaguye ububasha bw’abanyakibi, ari yo nkoni y’abaganza.
Ni yo yakubita abantu n’umujinya, ikabakubita idahengeshanya; yategekana amahanga uburake, ikabatwaza umukazo ubudasiba.
Ubu isi yose iraruhutse, ihawe impore; baraturikisha bakaririmba.
Mbere n’ibiti vy’amapinusi n’amasederi vy’i Libani bizokwitamba ku muvyimba biti: “Uhereye igihe bakwicira, natwe nta wasubiriye kutwicira.”

I kuzimu iwabo w’abapfuye harahagurutse ngo hagusanganire ushitse, hazuye imizimu y’abapfuye ngo ikuramutse; bamwe bahoze ari abategetsi mw’isi bose; hahagurukije ku ntebe zabo, bamwe bahoze ari abami b’amahanga bose
Abo bose bazokwakira, bakubwire bati: “Ehe nawe ubaye umunyantegenke nkatwe! Ubaye nk’umwe muri twebwe!”
Icubahiro cawe kimanuwe iwabo w’abapfuye, kijanye n’amajwi y’inanga zawe. Inyo ni zo ndava wisasiye, kandi inyo ni zo burengeti wipfutse.
Mbega ukuntu uvuye mw’ijuru ugakoroka, wa nyenyeri yo mu gaturuturu, mwana w’umutwenzi! None bakujugunye kw’isi, wewe wahora unesha amahanga!

Wahora wibwira mu mutima uti: “Nzoduga nshike kw’ijuru; nzoduza intebe yanje y’ubwami, isumbe inyenyeri z’Imana. Nzokwicara nganze ndi ku musozi mw’ikoraniro ry’imana, hejuru cane ku masonga y’umusozi Zafoni.
Nzorenga aho ibicu bigarukira, nzokwigira nk’Iyisumbavyose.”
Ariko umanutse i kuzimu mu bwami bw’abapfuye ugeze epfo i bwina mu nda y’urwobo.
Abakubona barakwihweza cane, bakakwibazako bati: “Uyu ni wa wundi yahindisha isi agashitsi, akajugumiza ubwami bwose,
agahindura isi yose ubugaragwa, agasenyura ibisagara vyo muri yo, akabuza n’impfungwa gusubira iwabo?”
Abami b’amahanga bose basinziranye ivyubahiro vyabo, umwe wese mu mva yiwe.
Ariko weho bagutesheje imva yawe ubaye nk’ishami ritawe; urengejweko imivyimba y’abishwe iy’abacumiswe inkota, itererwa ikamanuka ku mabuye yo mu rwobo. Ubaye nk’umuvyimba bakandagira.
Ntuzohambanwa iteka, kuko watikije igihugu cawe, ukica ubwoko bwawe. Uruvyaro rw’abanyakibi ntiruzokwibukwa.
Nimutegure aho kwicira abana biwe, bazira ivyaha vya ba sekuruza; kugira ngo ntibahaguruke ngo batorane igihugu, hanyuma ngo bacuzuzemwo ibisagara vyabo.
“Nzobahagurukira,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Kandi nzosibanganya izina rya Babiloni n’abacitse kw’icumu, abana biwe n’abamukomokako,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Babiloni nzohahindura igihugu c’ibihuna n’ibidengeri vy’amazi; nzoyikubuza umukubuzo w’agatikizo,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yararahiye ati: “Ni ukuri, uko nabitegekanije ni ko nzobikora, kandi bizorama nk’uko nabiteguye.
Nzovunagurira Abashuri mu gihugu canje, kandi nzobahonyangira ku misozi yanje. Ingogo yabo izova ku bantu banje, n’umutwaro wabo uzova ku bitugu vy’abantu banje.
Uwo ni wo mugambi wateguriwe isi yose, kandi ukwo ni kwo kuboko kuramvuriwe hejuru y’amahanga yose.”
Kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yabiteguye. Ukuboko kwiwe kurabanguye: mbe ni nde yogusubiza inyuma?
Mu mwaka Ahazi yapfuyemwo, ni ho haza iyi mburi:
Yemwe Bafilisitiya, ntimunezerezwe n’uko inkoni yabakubita yavunitse. Kuko ku gishitsi c’iyo nzoka hazovamwo imvuvyi, kandi uruvyaro rwayo ruzoba inzoka iguruka, y’ubumara bw’inkazi.
Abakene kurusha abandi bantu bose bazogaburirwa, n’aboro bazoryama basinzire. Ariko uruvyaro rwawe nzorumarisha inzara, n’abazocika kw’icumu nzobica.
Boroga, yewe wa rembo we! Namwe Bafilisitiya, nimurire! Kuko igicu c’umwotsi giturutse mu buraruko, kandi nta musoda n’umwe asigaye adatonze urugamba.
Mbega intumwa z’iryo hanga bazozishura iki? “ Uhoraho ni we ashinze Siyoni, kandi abantu biwe barenganywa, ni ho bazohungira.”
Ivyo Yesaya yavugishijwe kuri Mowabu: Igisagara Ari c’i Mowabu kirasambutse, gitikijwe mw’ijoro rimwe! Ikindi citwa Kiri c’i Mowabu nyene gihindutse umusaka, gitikijwe mw’ijoro rimwe!
Ab’i Diboni baraduze, bagiye mu nsengero no ku dutwe tw’imisozi kuririrayo, Abanyamowabu bariko baraborogera i Nebo n’i Medeba. Umuntu wese yimosheje uruharabuga, kandi abafise ubwanwa barabumoye.
Mu mabarabara, bambaye amagunira; bari hejuru ku mazu yabo no mu bibanza vy’amakoraniro bose baraboroga, bubamye barira.
Heshiboni na Eliyalehi bakoma induru, induru yabo irumvikana gushika i Yahazi. Ni co gituma ingabo z’i Mowabu zikomye induru, imitima yabo icitse ivutu.

Umutima wanje uraririra Mowabu: abacitse kw’icumu baho birutse bahunga bashika n’i Zowari, bageze no muri Egulati-Shelishiya. Baduze n’umusozi witwa Luhiti, barira ingenda; bafashe inzira ija i Horonayimu, bagiye baracura intimba kubera agatikizo kababayeko.
Amazi y’i Nimurimu arakamye, ivyatsi birakabiranye: ibiterwa biratikiye, nta catsi kibisi gisigaye.
Ubutunzi bari bariyegeranirije, butwawe hakurya y’umwonga w’i Popalarisi.
Induru zabo zirasekera gushika ku mbibe zose za Mowabu: amaborogo yabo ashika kure no muri Egilayimu, gucura intimba kwabo gushika kure n’i Beyeri Elimu.
Amazi y’i Diboni yuzuyemwo amaraso, kandi sindaheza gutera i Dimoni: intambwe yirutse ku banyamowabu bahunze no ku basigaye mu gihugu.
Nimurungike imyagazi y’intama nk’ishikanwa ryo kwisaba muyirungikire umurongozi w’igihugu, uhereye i Sela ugaca mu bugaragwa, ukageza ku musozi w’Umukobwa Siyoni.
Nk’uko inyoni ziyerera iyo zisamburiwe ivyari, ni ko abagore b’i Mowabu bazomera ku vyambu vy’uruzi Arunoni.
“Tugire inama,” ni ko ab’i Mowabu bavuga. “Fata ingingo. Tuma igitutu cawe kitubere nk’ijoro mu mashoka y’inka. Nyegeza abacitse kw’icumu, ntuhemukire impunzi.
Reka Abanyamowabu bacitse kw’icumu bagumane nawe, ubabere ubwihisho bubakingira umuranduzi.” Kuko uwucinyiza ivyiwe bizoteba bihere, kandi agatikizo kazorangira, abateye bazokamangana bave mu gihugu.

Ico gihe, intebe y’ubwami izokomezwa n’urukundo, mu bwizigirwa umugabo umwe azoyicarako, ni uwukomoka mu nzu kwa Dawidi, uwo mu guca imanza azorondera gukora ibigororotse: kandi azonyarutsa guca urubanza mu bugororotsi.
Twarumvise ivy’ubwibone bwa Mowabu, ko yibona birengeje. Twarumvise ivy’ukwishira hejuru kwiwe n’agasuzuguro kiwe. Ariko ukwishira hejuru kwiwe ni ukw’ubusa.
Ni co gituma Abanyamowabu baboroga, bakoraniye hamwe kuborogera Mowabu. Nimucure intimba, ku bw’udutsima tw’inzabibu z’i Kiru-Hareseti.

Imirima y’i Heshiboni irakabiranye, co kimwe n’inzabibu z’i Sibuma. Abategetsi b’amahanga basiribangiye hasi inzabibu z’indobanurwa, kera zahora zishika n’i Yazeri zigakwira no mu bugaragwa. Imivyaro yazo yararandarara, igashika kure ku kiyaga.

Ni co gituma ndira, nk’uko ab’i Yazeri barira, baririra uruzabibu rw’i Sibuma, ewe Heshiboni nawe Eliyalehi, nzobavomeza amarira yanje. Kuko impundu zitewe no kwera kw’ivyamwa vyawe, n’izitewe no kwimbura kwawe zitacumvikana.
Umunezero n’urweze bikuwe mw’itongo rimera cane; mu nzabibu ntihazosubira kwumvikana indirimbo canke akamo k’umunezero. Nta wuzosubira kwengera umuvinyu mu bwato, kuko nahagaritse akamo k’umunezero.
Ni co gituma ncurira intimba Mowabu nkamera nk’umurya w’inanga, mu nda yanje hakaririra Kiru-Hareseti.
Ab’i Mowabu nibaja ku gasozi hejuru, bazoba biyambagurira ubusa. Nibaduga ku dutwe tw’imisozi ngo basenge ibigirwamana, bizoba ari ivy’impfagusa.
Iryo ni ryo jambo Uhoraho yavuze kuri Mowabu.

Ariko noneho Uhoraho aravuze ati: “Imyaka itatu itarahera, nka kurya umukozi w’umucangero ayiharura, icubahiro ca Mowabu kizokengerwa, co kimwe n’abantu baho. Kandi abazosigara bacitse kw’icumu bazoba ari inkehwa cane, ata co bamaze.”
Imburi kuri Damasiko. “Ehe raba i Damasiko ntihazokwongera kuba igisagara, hazoba ikirundo c’ivyabomaguritse.
Ibisagara vya Aroweri bizohebwa, bihebewe ibitungwa. Bizorisha vyiryamire, ata muntu n’umwe abikomakoma.
Ibisagara bizitiye vya Efurayimu bizosenyurwa, n’ububasha bw’ubwami bw’i Damasiko buzohera. Amasigarira y’i Siriya azoherengetera, nk’icubahiro ca Isirayeli,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Uwo musi icubahiro ca Yakobo kizokabirana, n’ukuvyibuha kwiwe kuzohera.
Bizoba bimeze nka kurya umwimbuzi agenya ingano, akegeraniriza imikama y’ingano mu maboko, canke nk’abashwabura amasaka mu kiyaya ca Refayimu.

Ariko hazosigaramwo uduhumbwa nk’udusigara ku giti c’umwelayo bamaze gukubitisha inkoni bimbura, hagasigara tubiri canke dutatu mu bushorishori, na tune canke dutanu mu mashami yama cane,” ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze.
Ico gihe abantu bazohanga amaso Umuremyi wabo, maze bahindukirire Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Ntibazoba bagihindukiriza amaso yabo ku bicaniro, vyubatswe n’amaboko yabo, kandi ntibazoba bacunamira inkingi za Ashera, canke ngo baturirire ibimota neza ku bicaniro vyubatswe n’intoke zabo.
Uwo musi, ibisagara bizitiye vya Isirayeli bizotabwa, bimere nk’ibisagara vy’Abahiwi n’Abamori, vyatawe igihe Abisirayeli babishikamwo. Hazosigara ari mu gahinga.
Ko wibagiye Imana yo Mukiza wawe, ntiwibuke igitandara, ari co bwihisho bwawe, naho warobanuye imbuto nziza, ugatera imizabibu y’imvamahanga,
umusi uzitera zigaca zimera, mu gatondo ugasanga zanaze, umwimbu wazo uzobura ku musi w’amagorwa n’umubabaro udakira.
Aragowe amahanga menshi yuzuye ubushangashirwe! Babomborana nk’amazi y’ikiyaga. Baragowe abantu bahinda! Basuma nk’amazi yo mw’isumo rinini.
Naho abantu basuma nk’amazi yo mw’isumo rinini, Imana ibakankamiye barahunga, umuyaga ukabagurura nk’umuguruka wo ku mpinga z’umusozi, bakaguruka nk’umukungugu wo mu gashururu.
Ku mugoroba haza ibitera ubwoba, ariko butaraca bikaba vyaheze! Uwo ni wo mugabane w’abatunyaga, kandi ni yo ngero y’abatwambura.
Uragowe, yewe wa gihugu c’amababa ahinda, kiri impande y’inzuzi za Etiyopiya,

kirungika intumwa zigaca mu kiyaga, zigendera mu bwato bujishwe mu rufunzo. Genda, mwa ntumwa zinyaruka cane, mushikire bariya bantu barebare kandi b’umubiri woroshe, ubwoko butinywa kuva aha gushika kure, ihanga rikomeye, nivuga ururimi rutamenyerewe, igihugu kigabanganywa n’inzuzi.
Yemwe bantu bose bo kw’isi, mwebwe mwese muyibako, ibendera niryaduzwa ku musozi, murirabe, kandi inzamba niyavuga, muyumvirize.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho ambariye, ati: “Nzoguma nitekerereje, nihweze nibereye iwanje, meze nk’ubushuhe buva ku zuba ryaka mu gihe co mu ci, meze nk’ikime co mu gihe c’ubushuhe bwo mw’iyimbura.”
Kuko iyimbura ritaragera, amashurwe amaze guhunguruka, akavamwo inzabibu zeze, azotema iminago itama ayitemesheje umuhoro, n’amashami yasanzaraye azoyaca ayakureho.
Bose bazotererwa ku misozi baribwe n’ibisiga hamwe n’inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba. Ibisiga bizobarya ici ryose, ibikoko na vyo bibarye urushana rwose.

Ico gihe amashikanwa azozanirwa Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuye mu gihugu c’abantu barebare b’umubiri woroshe, avuye mu bantu batinywa uhereye aha ugashika kure, ihanga rikomeye rivuga ururimi rutamenyerewe, igihugu kigabuwe n’inzuzi. Amashikanwa azohora azanwa ku musozi Siyoni, ahitirirwa Izina ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Imburi kuri Egiputa. Raba Uhoraho aje ku gicu kinyaruka, aziye Egiputa. Ibigirwamana vyo muri Egiputa bihinze agashitsi imbere yiwe, kandi imitima y’Abanyegiputa ishongeshejwe n’ubwoba.
Nzoteranya Abanyegiputa basubiranemwo, abavukana bagwane, umubanyi agwanye uwundi mubanyi, igisagara kigwanye ikindi gisagara, n’ubwami bugwanye ubundi bwami.
Abanyegiputa bazocika ivutu, kandi imigambi yabo nzoyihindura ubusa. Bazoja kuraguza ku bigirwamana no ku mpwemu z’abapfuye, baje ku bapfumu no ku bakonikoni.
Egiputa nzohagomorerako umutware w’imburakigongwe, kandi umwami w’inkazi ni we azohategeka, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Amazi yo mu ruzi Nili azokama, n’aho urwo ruzi ruca hazokwuma hagaduke.
Imigende y’uruzi Nili izogaduka, n’imigende yo muri Egiputa izogabanuka ikame. Amarenga n’urufunzo bizokabirana,
mbere n’ibiterwa vyo ku nkombe y’urwo ruzi. N’ibiterwa vyose biharimwa, bizokwuma bihere, ntibizosubira kuhaboneka.
Abarovyi bazoboroga bacure intimba, abarobesha igera mu ruzi Nili bose. Abarobesha insenga mu ruzi bazobura ico bari bukore.
Abahingura inyuzi na bo nyene bazomaramara, n’abajisha impuzu zera bazodendebukirwa.
Abajisha impuzu baricurikiriye, abakorera umushahara bazogwara imitima.
Abatware ba Zowani ni ibipfu gusa, abahanuzi ba Farawo bahanura ivy’ubupfu gusa. Mbega ushobora ute kubwira Farawo uti: “Ndi umwe mu banyambwenge, ndi umwigishwa w’abami ba kera”?
Mbega abahanuzi bawe b’incabwenge ubu bari hehe? Nibakwereke bongere bagutahuze, ivyo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yateguye bigeramiye Egiputa.
Abatware b’i Zowani babaye ibipfu, n’abaganwa b’i Memfisi barahenzwe. Ni bo bari urufatiro mu moko yabo, none barazimije Egiputa.
Uhoraho yabasutsemwo impwemu yo kuzungurirwa, batuma Egiputa hadandabagirana mu vyo bakora vyose nk’uko imborerwa idandabagirana mu vyo yadashwe.
Nta kintu na kimwe muri Egiputa bashoboye gukora si umutwe canke umurizo, si ishami ry’ikigazi canke irenga.
Kuri uwo musi Abanyegiputa bazomera nk’abagore b’abanyantegenke. Bazohindishwa agashitsi n’uko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ababanguriye ukuboko.
Kandi igihugu c’i Buyuda kizotera ubwoba Abanyegiputa; uwuzobwirwa izina rya Yuda azohinda agashitsi, kubera ivyo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ateguye kugirira Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi, ibisagara bitanu vyo muri Egiputa bizovuga ururimi rw’Igiheburayo, biyegurira Uhoraho Mushoboravyose. Kimwe muri vyo kizokwitwa Igisagara c’Izuba.
Uwo musi hazokwubakwa igicaniro c’ Uhoraho hagati muri Egiputa, hamwe n’icibutso ku rubibe rwaho.
Bizoba ibimenyetso bishingira intahe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose muri Egiputa. Nibaborogera Uhoraho kubera agacinyizo, azobarungikira umukiza abarinda, abarokore.
Maze uwo musi Uhoraho azokwimenyekanisha ku Banyegiputa, kandi bazomwemera nk’umwami. Bazomusenga bongere bamushikanire ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ifu. Bazosezeranira Uhoraho kandi isezerano barishitse.
Uhoraho azoteza Egiputa icago; azobakubita yongere abavure. Bazogaruka k’ Uhoraho , na we azobumviriza, abakize.

Kuri uwo musi hazoba inzira yagutse iva muri Egiputa, ija muri Ashuri. Kandi abo muri Ashuri bazogendera abo muri Egiputa n’abo muri Egiputa bazogendera abo muri Ashuri. Abo muri Ashuri n’abo muri Egiputa bazotazirira hamwe Imana.
Muri ico gihe, Isirayeli bazoba bagira gatatu inyuma ya Egiputa na Ashuri, bose bazobera umugisha isi.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azobahezagira, avuga ati: “Hahiriwe Egiputa, ubwoko bwanje, na Ashuri igikorwa c’amaboko yanje, hamwe na Isirayeli iragi ryanje!”
Mu mwaka kizigenza mu ntwaramiheto yarungikwa na Sarugoni, umwami wa Ashuri, gutera muri Ashidodi akahafata,
ni ho Uhoraho yavugisha Yesaya mwene Amozi, amubwira ati: “Niwambure ayo magunira, ukure n’ibirato wambaye.” Na we abigenza gutyo, maze agendagenda ari gusa, ata n’ibirato yambaye.
Nuko Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Nk’uko umusavyi wanje Yesaya amaze imyaka itatu agenda ari gusa, ata n’ibirato yambaye, akabera Abanyegiputa n’Abanyetiyopiya imburi,
ni ko umwami wa Ashuri azotwara Abanyegiputa nk’abanyagano, n’Abanyetiyopiya nk’imbohe, bari gusa, batambaye n’ibirato, ata co bakenyeye, kugira ngo Egiputa hamaramare.
Kandi abari bizigiye Etiyopiya, bakishimira Egiputa, bazotinya, baterwe n’isoni.
Kuri uwo musi, ababa muri iki kiyaya cegereye ikiyaga bazovuga bati: ‘Nimurabe ivyashikiye abo twari twishimiye, abo twari twahungiyeko ngo badukize umwami wa Ashuri. Mbega none tumukira gute?’ ”
Imburi ku bugaragwa bwo ku kiyaga. Nk’uko agashururu ko mu gihugu co mu bumanuko gasuriranya, ni ko uwuguteye aje azananye mu bugaragwa, avuye mu gihugu giteye ubwoba.
Neretswe ibintu biteye ubwoba: Umuhemu ariko arahemuka, umunyazi ariko aranyaga. Ewe Elamu, tera! Nawe Medi, ugariza! Nzorangiza amaborogo yose Babiloni hahora hateza.
Ncitse intege kubera ububabare. Uburibwe bumfashe nk’umuvyeyi ari ku bise. Njugumijwe n’ivyo numvise, ivyo mbonye bimpumye amaso.
Umutima wanje urasimbagurika, ubwoba butumye njugumira. Umugoroba nari nipfuje ko ushika unteye guhinda agashitsi.
Bateguye imeza, basasa ibirago, bararya, baranywa! Nimuhaguruke mwa ntwazangabo mwe, musige amavuta inkinzo zanyu.
Kuko Uhoraho yambwiye ati: “Genda ushireho umuteramyi, na we aje arakubwira ivyo abona.
Niyabona imikogote iri kumwe n’amafarasi, canke akabona abagendera ku ndogoba, canke abagendera ku ngamiya, yitegereze cane kandi akobeje.”
Maze wa muteramyi arasemerera ati: “Mwami, imisi yose nama mpagaze ku munara. Amajoro yose mba ndi ku kirindiro canje.

None raba haje umugabo ari ku mukogote, ari kumwe n’umugwi w’amafarasi. Wa muteramyi arongera avuga ati: ‘Babiloni harasenyutse, harasenyutse! Ibibumbano vy’ibigirwamana vyabo vyose bisenyukiye hasi biramenaguritse.’ ”
Mwa bantu banje, musekuriwe ku mbuga nk’ingano, ndababwiye ivyo numvanye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ivyo nakuye ku Mana ya Isirayeli.
Imburi kuri Duma. Hari uwumpamagaye ari i Seyiri, ambaza ati: “Yewe muteramyi, ijoro rigeze he? Yewe muteramyi, ijoro rigeze he?”
Umuteramyi yishura ati: “Bugira buce, ariko buca bwongera bwire. Nimba ugomba gusubira kumbaza, uze kugaruka umbaze.”
Imburi kuri Arabiya: Yemwe mwa ngenzi z’i Dedani mwe, nimwinyegeze mu bugaragwa bwa Arabiya,
Yemwe ababa i Tema, nimuzanire amazi abanyotewe, abahunga nimubasanganize ivyokurya.
Bariko barahunga inkota kuko yakuwe mu rwubati, n’imiheto ikaba yafowe, batewe ubwoba n’intambara.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho yambwiye: “Mu mwaka umwe, nk’uko umukozi akorera impembo ku kwezi awuharura, icubahiro c’i Kedari kizorangira.
Abarashi b’intwari bake ni bo bazosigara i Kedari.” Uko ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze.
Imburi ku kiyaya co kwerekerwamwo: Mbega Yerusalemu, ufashwe n’ibiki? Ko abantu bawe bose baduze hejuru ku mazu?
Yewe wa gisagara cuzuyemwo urwamwo, nawe wa gisagara cuzuye umuvurungano n’ubwibone! Abantu bawe bapfuye, ntibishwe n’inkota canke ngo bagwe ku rugamba.
Abatware bawe bose bahungiye rimwe, bafashwe ata muheto urinze gukoreshwa. Abafashwe bose batwawe icarimwe ngo babe imbohe, naho bagerageje guhunga umwansi akiri kure.
Ni co catumye mvuga nti: “Nimumve i ruhande, mundeke ndirane umubabaro. Ntimugerageze kumpoza kandi mbona ubwoko bwanje buriko burahona.”
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, yarashizeho umusi w’imibabaro, w’umuvurungano, ugusiribangwa n’ubwoba, mu kiyaya c’ukwerekerwamwo, umusi wo gusangangura inzitiro, no kuborogera ku misozi.
Abanyelamu bambaye imyampi, imikogote n’amafarasi yabo birateguye, Kiru yasokoroye inkinzo.
Ibiyaya vyawe vyiza vyuzuye imikogote, n’abagendera ku mafarasi bahagaze ku marembo y’igisagara.
Uhoraho yakuyeho ibikingira i Buyuda, maze uwo musi murahindukira mufata ibigwanisho mwashinguye, mu nzu yitwa Inzu y’Ishamba.
Murabona ko impome z’Igisagara ca Dawidi zasambutse ahatari hake, maze muca muziganya amazi, mwuzuza amazi itangi yo hepfo.
Mugenzura amazu y’i Yerusalemu, amwe murayasambura kugira ngo muronke amabuye yo gusanura uruzitiro.
Hagati y’inzitiro z’igisagara mwubakaho itangi y’amazi kugira ngo muziganye amazi yo mw’itangi ya kera. Ariko ntimwigeze muhanga amaso Uwabiremye, canke ngo mwiyumvire ku wabiteguye kuva kera.
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, arabararitse kuri uwo musi, ngo murire mwongere muboroge, ngo mwimoshe inkomvorera mwongere mwambare impuzu z’ikigandaro.
Ariko raba, hari umunezero no kwiginana, mubaga inka mukica intama, mwirira inyama, mwinywera umuvinyu. Mukavuga muti: “Reka twirire twongere twinywere, kuko ejo tuzopfa.”
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yampishuriye ibi nanje ndiko ndumviriza: “No gushika ku musi muzopfirako, ico caha ntikizoharirwa,” ni ko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze.
Uku ni ko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze: Genda, ubwire urya muzezwabintu, ari we Shebuna umurongozi w’ibikorwa vyo ku kirimba, umubaze uti:
Uriko ukora iki ngaha; ni nde yaguhaye uruhusha rwo kwiyimbira imva ngaha, ukayiyimbira ahakirurutse, ukiyimbira aho uzohambwa mu gitandara?
“Wiyubare. Uhoraho azogufatana inkomezi nyinshi, agushiburire kure, yewe wa munyenkomezi we.
Azokuzingazinga bwa mupira wo gukina, aguterere mu gihugu cagutse. Aho ni ho uzogwa, hamwe n’imikogote yawe yatuma wishima, uzoba agatetereza k’inzu ya shobuja.
Nzokwaka ubutware bwawe, kandi nzogukura mu kibanza cawe nkumanure.
Kuri uwo musi, nzohamagaza umusavyi wanje Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya agusubirire.
Nzomwambika ikanzu yawe, ndamukenyeze umukanda, maze ndamuhe ubutware bwawe. Azoba se w’ababa i Yerusalemu hamwe n’ab’inzu ya Yuda.
Nzoshira ku bitugu vyiwe urupfunguruzo rw’inzu ya Dawidi; yuguruye nta wuzokwugara, kandi niyugara nta wuzokwugurura.
Nzomushimangira nk’urumambo ahantu hakomeye; azozana icubahiro ku nzu ya se.
Icubahiro c’umuryango wiwe cose kizoba kuri we: kizoba ku ruvyaro rwiwe, no gushika ku wo hasi y’abandi bose.”
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ati: “Kuri uwo musi, urumambo rwashimangiwe ahakomeye ruzokurwaho; ruzotemwa rugwe, umutwaro wari uruboheweko ukoroke.” Ni ko Uhoraho yavuze.
Imburi kuri Tiro. Nimuboroge, yemwe mwa mato y’i Tarushishi, kuko i Tiro hatikiye, amazu n’ivyambu vy’amato vyasanganguwe! Bari bakiri mu gihugu ca Kupuro maze inkuru ibasangaho.
Nimucereze, yemwe bantu bo mw’izinga, hamwe namwe badandaza b’i Sidoni, mwebwe mwari mutungishijwe n’abatwara ibintu ku kiyaga.
Abatwara ibintu ku mazi menshi bakazana ingano ziva i Shiholi; n’ivyimburwa vy’uruzi Nili, ari vyo vyari bitungishije Tiro, hagaca hahinduka isoko y’amahanga.
Maramara yewe Sidoni, hamwe nawe gihome co ku kiyaga, kuko ikiyaga kivuze kiti: “Sindigera ntera ibise, kandi sindigera mvyara. Nta bahungu nonkeje, kandi nta bakobwa nareze.”
Inkuru y’i Tiro niyashika muri Egiputa, bazobabara cane.
Jabuka ikiyaga ushike i Tarushishi, nimuboroge, yemwe bantu bo kuri iryo zinga!
Mbega iki ni ca gisagara canyu c’umunezero, kimwe kimaze imyaka n’iyindi, ibirenge vyaco vyajanye abaco kure, bakaja gutegeka amahanga ya kure?
Mbega ni nde yateguye gutera Tiro, kandi ari co gisagara cambika ingori abami, abadandaza baho bakaba ari abaganwa, abatunzi baho na bo bakaba ba rurangiranwa mw’isi?
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni we yabiteguye, kugira ngo asubize hasi ubwibone bwose, yongere acishe bugufi abanyacubahiro bo kw’isi bose.
Rima ku nkengera y’ikiyaga nk’uko Abanyegiputa babigira ku ruzi Nili, yewe mukobwa w’i Tarushishi, kuko ata vyambu bikiriho.
Uhoraho yaramvuriye ukuboko kwiwe ku kiyaga, ajugumiza ubwami bwaho. Yatanze itegeko ryerekeye Foyinike, ko inzitiro zaho zisenyurwa.
Yavuze ati: “Ntukongere kunezerwa yewe mukobwa Sidoni, kuko usanganguwe! Mbere, naho wojabuka ikiyaga ukagera i Kupuro, na ho nyene nta buruhukiro woharonka.”

Tereza amaso ku gihugu c’i Babiloni, abantu baho ntibagiharurwa nk’abariho! Abanyashuri barahahinduye bahahinduye igihugu c’imfyisi zo mu bugaragwa. Bahubatse ivyo kwuririrako, basenyagura ingoro z’abami, igihugu bagisiga ari umusaka.
Nimuboroge yemwe mwa mato y’i Tarushishi, kuko ivyambu vyanyu vyakuweho.
Ico gihe i Tiro hazokwibagirwa imyaka mirongo indwi, imyaka ingana n’iy’ubuzima bw’umwami. Ariko inyuma y’iyo myaka, ibizoba kuri Sidoni bizoba nk’ibiri muri iyi ndirimbo ya maraya:
“Akira inanga, ugendagende mu gisagara, yewe maraya wibagiwe; ucurarange, uririmbe indirimbo nyinshi, kugira ngo usubire wibukwe.”
Inyuma y’iyo myaka mirongo indwi, Uhoraho azosubira kuvyura Tiro. Ariko hazosubira ku rudandazwa rwaho rwa kera, hasambane n’ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi.
Ariko inyuma y’aho inyungu zaho zose zizokwegurirwa Uhoraho . Ntizizobikwa canke ngo zishirwe ukwazo, kuko zizohabwa abama imbere y’ Uhoraho , kugira ngo baronke ivyo barya n’ivyo bambara.
Ehe Uhoraho agira ahindure isi umusaka. Agira ayisambure, asibanganye ubwiza bwayo abayibako bashwiragire:

ibizoba kuri umwe ni vyo bizoba no ku wundi yaba umuherezi canke umuntu asanzwe, yaba umukoresha canke umukozi wiwe, yaba inabuja canke incoreke yiwe yaba uwushora canke uwugura, yaba uwugurana canke uwuguranwa, yaba uwugurana yunguka canke uwishura, yaba uwuheraniwe canke uwuheranye.
Isi izocika umusaka, inyagwe ibiri kuri yo vyose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Isi iragandaye, kandi irakabiranye, isi iraburaniwe, irakabiranye, mbere n’amajuru ashiranye na yo.
Isi irahumanye kandi ihumanijwe n’abantu bayibako: bataye ivyagezwe, barenga ku mabwirizwa, bica isezerano ry’ibihe vyose.
Ni co gituma umuvumo utongoye isi, abantu bayo bashitsweko n’ingaruka z’ivyo bakoze. Ni co gituma abayibako batongowe bagashira, hasigaye inkehwa gusa.
Umuvinyu mushasha urabuze, n’uruzabibu rurakabiranye, abahorana umunezero barijiriwe.
Umunezero uvuye ku dushako tw’ingoma urahagaze, urwamo rw’abanezerewe ruraheze, inanga zihimbaye kwumva zirahagaze.
Ntibazosubira kunywa umuvinyu baririmba, inzoga ihindukiye umururazi abayinywa.
Igisagara c’imivurungano kirasenyutse, inzugi z’amazu yose zirugawe.
Baririra mu mabarabara barondera umuvinyu, ahari umunezero habaye ukwihebura, amajwi yose y’umunezero akuwe mw’isi.
Igisagara gisigaye ari umusaka, inzugi z’amarembo yaco baziciye ubunywenywe.
Ni ko bizogenda kw’isi no mu mahanga, bizomera kurya igiti c’umwelayo cazungagijwe kimera, canke kurya bimera iyo hasigaye uduhumbwa inzabibu zimaze kwimburwa.
Abazorokoka bazoduza amajwi, bavuze akamo k’umunezero, bave mu buseruko baririmba icubahiro c’ Uhoraho .
None rero nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe abo mu buseruko, mushire hejuru izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, yemwe abo mu mazinga yo mu kiyaga.

Twumvise indirimbo ziva ku mpera z’isi zivuga ziti: “Icubahiro kibe ic’umwe agororotse!” Ariko nanje mvuga nti: “Ndageseye, ndageseye! Ewe jewe ndagowe! Abahemu barahemukiye abandi, mbere barahemutse cane.”
Ibiteye ubwoba, urwobo n’umutego birabarindiriye, yemwe bantu bo kw’isi.
Uwuzohunga urwamo rw’ibiteye ubwoba azogwa mu rwobo, uwuzosimba urwobo azogwa mu mutego. Ingomero zo mw’ijuru ziragomorowe, kandi amatanguriro y’isi aranyiganyize.
Isi iramenetse, isi irasenyutse, iranyiganyijwe cane.
Isi iradandabagiranye nk’imborerwa, inyiganyizwa nk’akazu k’ivyatsi kanyiganyizwa n’umuyaga. Iremerewe no gutsindwa n’ubugarariji bwayo, ni co gituma itemvye kandi ntizokwongera kuvyuka.
Kuri uwo musi, Uhoraho azohana ingabo zo hejuru mw’ijuru, n’abami bo hasi kw’isi.
Bazokwegeranirizwa hamwe nk’uko imbohe zegeranirizwa mu rwobo, bugaranirwe mw’ibohero, maze bazocirwa urubanza haciye igihe kirekire.
Ukwezi kuzogira isoni, izuba na ryo rizomaramara. Kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azoganza ku Musozi Siyoni n’i Yerusalemu, ari imbere y’abatware baho kandi ari mu bwiza bwinshi.
Yewe Uhoraho , ni wewe Mana yanje; nzogushira hejuru nongere ntazire izina ryawe, kuko mu bwizigirwa butagira agasembwa wakoze ibitangaza, ivyo wari warateguye kuva kera.
Wahinduye igisagara ibirundo vy’isakamburira, igisagara kizitiriwe ukigira umusaka. Ibirimba vyiza vyo mu mahanga ya kure bikuweho, kandi ntibizosubira kwubakwa.
Ni co gituma ibihugu bikomeye bizokwubaha, ibisagara vy’amahanga ateye ubwoba bikagutinya.

Wabereye aboro ubuhungiro, ubuhungiro bw’abakene mu kuburanirwa kwabo, ubabera ubwugamo mu gihuhusi, n’igitutu mu gihe c’indugumba. Kuko uburake bw’inkozi z’ibibi, bumeze nk’igihuhusi cisuka ku gihome,
canke nk’ubushuhe bwo mu bugaragwa. Uzibiza urwamo rw’abanyamahanga; nk’uko ubushuhe bugabanurwa n’igitutu kizanywe n’igicu, uko ni ko uzivya n’indirimbo z’inkozi z’ibibi.
Kuri uwu musozi Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azohategurira abantu bose amazimano aryoshe, banywe umuvinyu wa kera, barye inyama zinuze bongere banywe n’umuvinyu umiminye neza.
Kuri uwo musozi ni ho azotabagurira igihuzu co kugandara cipfutswe n’abantu bose, ari wo mwambaro utwikiriye amahanga yose.
Urupfu azorumira ataruhekenye! Uhoraho Nyeninganji azobahanagura amarira yose ayakure ku maso yose; azokura agakengerwe kose ku bantu biwe iyo bari kw’isi hose. Uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Kuri uwo musi ni ho bazovuga bati: “Vy’ukuri iyi ni yo Mana yacu, turayizeye, ni yo yaturokoye. Uwu ni Uhoraho , turamwizeye; reka duhimbarwe, tunezerererwe agakiza kiwe.”
Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kuri kuri uwu musozi, ariko Mowabu bazohonyangirwa iwabo, nk’uko ivyatsi bihonyangirwa mu nyabarega.
Bazokwaya amaboko bari muri ivyo, nk’uko aboga baya amaboko yabo mu kwoga. Ariko Uhoraho azobamara ubwibone, ntazokangwa n’ububangutsi bwabo.
Uhoraho azosenyura inzitiro zanyu ndende, aziryamike hasi; azozihenura zigwe zishike hasi, mu mukungugu.
Kuri uwo musi, iyi ni yo ndirimbo izoririmbwa mu gihugu c’i Buyuda: Dufise igisagara gikomeye, Imana iduhaye agakiza, ngo kabe inzitiro n’ibihome bidukingira.
Nimwugurure amarembo, kugira ngo ihanga rigororotse ryinjire, ihanga rigumya ukwizera.
Uzozigamira mu mahoro yuzuye abo bose bashira ivyiyumviro vyabo kuri wewe, kuko bakwizigiye!
Mwizigire Uhoraho ibihe vyose, kuko Uhoraho Imana ubwiwe ari we gitandara gihoraho.
Acisha bugufi ababa ahantu hakirurutse; igisagara cishira hejuru agisubiza hasi; arakimanura gushika hasi, akakiryamika mu mukungugu.
Kizohonyangwa n’ibirenge, ibirenge vy’impahazwa, n’ibirenge vy’aboro.
Inzira y’umugororotsi iraramvuye, kandi wewe Mugororotsi wenyene, ni wewe utuma inzira y’umugororotsi iringanira.
Ewe Uhoraho , mu nzira z’ivyagezwe vyawe ni ho tukwitegeye, izina ryawe n’ukuba rurangiranwa kwawe ni vyo imitima yacu ihahamiye.
Umutima wanje uragushaka mw’ijoro, mu gitondo impwemu yanje ikakurondera. Iyo urubanza rwawe ruje kw’isi, ababa kw’isi baca bigiraho ukugororoka.
Ariko abanyakibi n’aho ubagirira ubuntu, ntibaca biga ukugororoka; mbere no mu gihugu c’abagororotsi baguma bakora ivyaha, ntibigera babona ubukuru bw’ Uhoraho .
Yewe Uhoraho , ubabanguriye ukuboko kwawe, ariko ntibanabibona. Reka babone ishaka ufitiye ubwoko bwawe, maze ubamaramaze; rekura umuriro wageneye abansi bawe ubatongore.
Uhoraho , ni wewe uzoduha amahoro, kandi ivyo twashitseko vyose ni wewe wabidukoreye.
Yewe Uhoraho , Mana yacu, abami badutwaye ni benshi, ariko izina ryawe ryonyene ni ryo duha icubahiro.
Barapfuye, ntibakiriho, impwemu zabo zaragiye, ntizikigaruka. Warabahanye kandi ubashitsa aho batikira, urabazimanganya, ntibasubira kwibukwa.
Yewe Uhoraho , waratwaguriye igihugu, ni wewe wakitwaguriye. Warihesheje icubahiro, utwagurira imbibe z’igihugu.
Uhoraho we, igihe twari mu vyago twarakurondeye, inkoni yawe idushitseko dusuka amaganya yacu imbere yawe.
Twari tumeze nk’umugore ari ku bise aribwa akarizwa n’imibabaro. Natwe ni ko twari tumeze, yewe Uhoraho .
Twari twibungenze umwana, turibwa, turi mu mibabaro, ariko tuvyara umuyaga. Nta gakiza twazaniye isi, kandi nta n’ubuzima twazanye muri iyi si.

Ariko abawe bapfuye bazobaho, yewe Uhoraho ; imibiri yabo izozuka. Mwebwe abari mu mukungugu, ikangure muririmbe indirimbo z’umunezero. Kuko ikime canyu kimeze nk’ikime c’agatondo, kandi isi izogarukana abapfuye.
Nimugende, yemwe mwa bwoko bwanje, mwinjire mu vyumba mwiyugarane, mwinyegeze gatoya, uburake bwiwe bubanze burengane.
Ehe raba Uhoraho avuye mw’ijuru, ahagurukanywe no guhanira abo kw’isi ivyaha vyabo. Isi izogaragaza amaraso yayisheshweko, ntizosubira gupfuka abishwe bari muri yo.

Kuri uwo musi Uhoraho azohanisha inkota yiwe, inkota yiwe ikarishe, nini kandi y’ubushobozi, agwanye Leviyatani ca kiyoka kinyaruka, Leviyatani ca kiyoka cigonyonzora; azokwica ca gisizimwe co mu kiyaga.
Kuri uwo musi, tuzotera indirimbo, turirimbira uruzabibu rwamye cane.
Jewe Uhoraho ni jewe ndarurinda, nkama ndaruvomera ubudasiba, ndarurinda ijoro n’umurango, kugira ngo ntihagire ikirwonona.
Sinkirushavuriye! Ariko ninarusangamwo imibambangwe n’amahwa, nzoja kubitera ndabigwanye nzobituririra hamwe;
kiretse bimpungiyeko, tugahana isezerano ry’amahoro. Ni ukuri, nibize duhane isezerano ry’amahoro.
Mu misi iza, uruvyaro rwa Yakobo ruzoshinga imizi, Isirayeli azoshurika kandi azokwiza ivyamwa isi yose.
Mbega Uhoraho yarakubise Isirayeli nk’uko yakubise abamukubise? Canke yaramwishe nk’uko yishe abamwishe?
Oya, ahubwo yamuhanye buhoro mu kumwirukana mu gihugu. Yamwirukanye mu gihuhusi gikomeye, nko ku musi umuyaga wo mu buseruko uhuhutirako.

Ng’ibi ibizotuma ivyaha vya Yakobo bitwikirwa, kandi ibi ni vyo vyamwa vy’uko ivyaha vyiwe vyakuweho: Amabuye yose yubatse ibicaniro vy’ibigirwamana azoyamenagura acike umukungugu, nta nkingi za Ashera canke ibicaniro vyo guturirirako ibimota neza bizosigara bihagaze muri Isirayeli.
Ibisagara bizitiriwe bizosigara ari imisaka, ari agahinga kahebwe, hameze nk’ubugaragwa. Inyana ni ho zizorisha, ziharyame, zirishe ku mashami yaho.
Amashami yaho niyuma azovunagurika, abagore bayasenye baje kuyacana. Kuko ubu bwoko ntibugira ugutahura, ni co gituma Umuremyi wabo ata mbabazi abugirira, Imana yabaremye ntibagirira impuhwe.
Kuri uwo musi, Uhoraho azosekura ingano, kuva ku ruzi Efutate kugeza ku mugezi wa Egiputa. Namwe Bisirayeli, muzokwegeranywa umwumwe.
Uwo musi inzamba nini izovuzwa. Abariko barahonera muri Ashuri n’abari barajanywe ari inyagano muri Egiputa bazoza guhimbariza Uhoraho ku musozi wera i Yerusalemu.

Ubonye ibara wa rugori rw’ubwibone imborerwa za Efurayimu zineganegana, ubwiza bukayangana bwawe bubaye nk’ishurwe rikabiranye, riri ku mutwe w’ikiyaya kimera cane, igisagara ari co bwibone bw’abagwishwa hasi n’umuvinyu!
Ehe raba Imana yifitiye umunyenkomezi w’intwari. Imeze nk’urubura canke igihuhusi gisambura, nk’imyuzure isendanisha. Izobakubitisha hasi inkomezi nyishi.
Maze urugori rw’ubwibone imborerwa za Efurayimu zineganegana, ruzohonyangirwa hasi.
Iryo shurwe rikabiranye, ryahorana ubwiza n’icubahiro, riri ku mutwe w’ikiyaya kimera cane, rizomera nk’insukoni zihishiye imbere y’iyimbura. Iyo abantu bazibonye, baca bazamura, bakazitamira.
Kuri uwo musi Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azoba urugori rw’ubwiza bwinshi, urugori rwiza ku masigarira y’ubwoko bwiwe.
Azobera impwemu y’ukugororoka uwicaye aca imanza, yongere abere isoko ry’inkomezi abasubiza urugamba inyuma y’amarembo.

Ariko Isirayeli na we adandabagiranishwa n’umuvinyu, ibiboreza biramuzungagije. Abaherezi n’abavugishwa badandabagiranishijwe n’ibiboreza, bazengerejwe n’umuvinyu, bazungagijwe n’inzoga. Iyo bariko barerekwa inzozi baradandabagirana, bagatsitagurika iyo bafata ingingo.
Imeza zabo zuzuyeko ivyo badashwe, umwanda ukwiragiye hose.
Barabazanya bati: “Mbega Yesaya yigira iki mu kugerageza kutwigisha? Ni ba nde ariko arabwira ayo majambo yiwe? Tubaye abana bagicuka, canke bakiva kw’ibere rya ba nyina?
Kuko ivyiwe ari: Kora ibi, kora birya, itegeko ry’iki ni iri, itegeko rya kirya ni rirya; dukeya aha, dukeya harya.”
Aho ni vyiza ko biri uko, akanwa k’abanyamahanga, n’indimi zitazwi ni vyo Imana izovuganiramwo n’aba bantu.
Abo yari yarababwiye ati: “Iki ni co kibanza co kuruhukiramwo, abarushe nibaruhuke”; kandi ati: “Ubu ni bwo buruhukiro;” ariko ntibamwumviye.

Ni co gituma kuri bo, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryahindutse, rizoba: kora ibi, kora birya, itegeko ni iri kuri iki, ni iri kuri kirya, dukeya aha, dukeya harya kugira ngo nibatambuka bagwire umugongo, bakomereke, bagwe mu mutego maze bafatwe.
None rero mwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho mwa bacokoranyi mwe, muganje i Yerusalemu.
Mwirata muvuga muti: “Twagiranye isezerano n’urupfu, kandi imva twarumvikanye. Icago gikukumura nicahaca, ntikizodushikako, kuko twarironkeye ubuhungiro mu binyoma, ububeshi ni bwo bwihisho bwacu.”
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Raba ndashira ibuye i Siyoni, ibuye ryageragejwe, ibuye ry’igiciro rigumya imfuruka. Uwuryizera ntazokwigera anyiganyiga.
Guca imanza zibereye ni vyo nzogira igipimo; kandi ubugororotsi ni bwo nzogira karisho urubura ruzosambura ubuhungiro bwanyu, ari vyo binyoma, kandi amazi azokwuzura ubwihisho bwanyu.
Isezerano mwagiraniye n’urupfu rizokurwaho; umwumvikano mwumvikanye n’imva ntuzoramba. Umwuzure ukomeye niwahaca, uzobakubita hasi.
Uwo mwuzure, uko uje kwose, uzokwama ubatwara, uko bukeye, ku murango no mw’ijoro uzobatwara.” Kandi gutahura ubu butumwa bizobatera guhinda agashitsi kenshi.
Uburiri ni bugufi, ntimuzoronka aho murambiriza, n’uburengeti ni buto, ntimushobora kubwipfuka ngo bubakwire.
Uhoraho azohaguruka nk’uko yahagurutse ku musozi Perazimu, arake nk’uko yarakiye ikiyaya c’i Gibeyoni, akore igikorwa ciwe c’agatangaza, igikorwa kitamenyerewe.
Nuko rero nimugeze ngaho ugushinyagura kwanyu, ahandi hoho ibihano birongerekana. Kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yambwiye ivy’agatikizo, ako yateguriye igihugu cose.
Nimuntege amatwi munyumve, nimwumvirize ivyo ndiko ndavuga.
Mbega umurimyi iyo ariko ararima aho agomba guteragira, yama ariko ararima gusa? Yama ariko ararima ategura ubusize?
Iyo amaze gutegura neza aho yarimye, ntaheza akamija imbuto, akabiba izitwa kumino, akabiba ingano mu kibanza cazo, akabiba izitwa sayiri uko zibibwa, akabiba n’izitwa kusemati uko zibibwa?
Imana yiwe ni yo imwigisha ikamwereka ingene abikora neza.
Uburo ntibabusekuza umuhini usongoye, kumino ntibazisekuza ibigata vy’imikogote Uburo bakabukubitisha ikibano, kumino bakayikubitisha inkoni.
Ingano barazisya bakazicumbamwo umutsima. Nta muntu yama ariko arazisya adaheza. Amapine y’umukogote usekura yoshobora gukoreshwa, ariko nta wukoresha ifarasi mu gusekura ingano.
Ubwo bumenyi bwose buva k’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, we mujenama w’igitangaza, n’ubwenge bw’agahebuza.

headings.text: Ivyago ku barongozi ba Efurayimu na Yuda

verses.text: Uzobona ibara yewe Ariyeli, Ariyeli, igisagara Dawidi yabayemwo! Ku mwaka ku mwaka nimwigirire imisi mikuru y’urutavanako,
Ariko nzoza nugarize Ariyeli; hazoba amarira no gucura intimba. Kuko Yerusalemu hazoba ico izina Ariyeli risigura, ni igicaniro cuzuyeko amaraso.
Nzokwugariza impande zose, nkuziguze ibirindiro, nkurundire ibirundo vyo kwuririrako kugira ngo ndakugwanye.
Nzokumanura hasi, usigare uvugira mw’ivu, amajambo yawe uyadebagure ava mu mukungugu. Ijwi ryawe rizokwumvikana nk’iry’umuzimu riva mw’ivu, ryongorere riva mu mukungugu.
Ariko mu kanya isase, abansi banyu naho ari benshi, bazocika umukungugu, n’ingabo zabo ziteye ubwoba, zizoba nk’umuguruka ugururwa n’umuyaga. Buno nyene, mu kanya isase,
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azoza kugutabara azanye inkuba na nyamugigima hamwe n’ukwasana gukomeye, n’agashururu, n’igihuhusi hamwe n’imbeya z’umuriro utongora.
Ingabo z’amahanga yose agwanya igisagara Ariyeli, zikagiterana n’inzitiro zaho zikagikikuza, zizokamangana nk’indoto, canke ukwerekwa kwo mw’ijoro.

Kurya uwushonje arota ariko ararya, ariko yavyuka agasanga agishonje. Kurya uwunyotewe arota ariko aranywa, ariko yavyuka agasanga akinyotewe. Uko ni ko bizomera ku ngabo z’amahanga zigwanya umusozi Siyoni.
Banza muhagarare mutangare! Muhumirize amaso, mube impumyi. Muborerwe mutanyoye umuvinyu, mudandabagirane mutanyoye ibiboreza.
Kuko Uhoraho abasutseko uruhumyi, ahumishije amaso yanyu ari bo bavugishwa, atwikiriye imitwe yanyu ari bo ba kamenyi banyu.

Kuko uku kwerekwa kwose kwababereye nk’amajambo yo mu gitabu kimatanishijwe ishashara. Mugihaye uwushobora gusoma mukamubwira muti: “Turakwinginze udusomere,” yobabwira ati: “Sinoshobora gusoma kuko kiramatanije.”
Mugihaye uwutazi gusoma na we mukamubwira muti: “Turakwinginze udusomere,” yobishura ati: “Sinzi gusoma.”
Imana ivuze ati: “Aba bantu baza aho ndi, banyubahisha iminwa yabo, ariko imitima yabo iri kure yanje. Ugusenga kwabo nta kindi kurimwo, atari ivyo bigishijwe n’amategeko y’abana b’abantu.
None rero ngomba nsubire ntangaze aba bantu, nkore ibitangaza bidasanzwe; ubwenge bw’abanyabwenge buzokamangana, n’ubumenyi bw’abiyita ko bazi vyinshi buzohindurwa ubusa.”
Bazobona ibara abamanuka kure i kuzimu ngo banyegeze imigambi yabo Uhoraho , bagakora ibikorwa vyabo bikinze umwijima kandi bibwira bati: “Hari uwutubona? Ni nde azomenya ivyo dukora?”
Ibintu murabicurika nk’aho womenga umubumvyi mwamunganishije n’ibumba! Mbega icabumbwe cobwira uwakibumvye kiti: “Ntiwambumvye?” Canke inkono yobwira umubumvyi iti: “Ntuzi kubumba?”
Hasigaye igihe gito, Libani hagacika itongo rimera cane, ahahora hamera cane na ho hagiye kuba ishamba.
Kuri uwo musi ibipfamatwi bizokwumva amajambo yo muri ca gitabu, amaso y’impumyi azobona ave mu muzitanya no mu mwijima.
Abaciye bugufi bazosubira kandi kunezererwa mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ; aboro bazonezerererwa Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Abateye ubwoba bazokamangana, abashinyagura bazonyika, kandi abashinze ijisho ivyo kugira nabi bazorandurwa,
bakoresha amajambo ngo batsindishe abantu mu manza, bagatega imitego abacamanza, kandi mu gukoresha ivyabona vy’ibinyoma uwari gutsinda mu rubanza ntatsinda.
None rero, Uhoraho , uwacunguye Aburahamu, abwiye abakomoka kuri Yakobo ati: “Bene Yakobo ntibazokwongera kumaramara, kandi mu maso habo ntihazosubira kwijirirwa.
Kuko nibabona abana babo hagati muri bo, ari bo gikorwa c’amaboko yanje, bose bazomenya ko izina ryanje ari iryera. Bazokwemera ukwera kw’Uwera wa Yakobo, batamarirwe batangarira Imana ya Isirayeli.
Abo imitima yazimiye bazomenya ukuri, n’abidodomba bazokwemera kwigishwa.”

“Muzobona ibara mwa bana badakurwa kw’ijambo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “mugira imigabo ihushanye n’ugushaka kwanje, mukagirana amasezerano n’abandi bantu, mugabo atavuye kuri Mpwemu wanje, mukirundaniriza ivyaha ku bindi.
Mwebwe mumanuka muri Egiputa mutangishije inama, mukarondera ubutabazi no gukingirwa kuri Farawo, mu gitutu ca Egiputa akaba ari ho murondera ubuhungiro.
Ariko kwizigira guhungira kwa Farawo bizobabera agatetereza, kandi igitutu ca Egiputa kizobamaramaza.
Naho bafise abatware bari i Zowani, intumwa zabo zikaba zigeze i Hanesi,
bose bazomaramara, kuko bazosanga bizigiye abantu b’imburakimazi, ata co babafasha kandi ata n’akarusho na kamwe, atari ukubateza isoni n’ibiteterwe gusa.”

Imburi ku bikoko vy’i Negebu: Mu gihugu c’amakuba n’imibabaro, kibamwo intambwe z’ingabo n’iz’ingore, kikabamwo inzoka z’ubumara bukaze n’iziguruka, izo ntumwa ni ho zaciye zitwaye ubutunzi ku migongo y’indogoba, n’ivy’agaciro ku mapfupfu y’ingamiya, kandi ivyo vyose babirungitse mu gihugu ata co kizobamarira,
muri Egiputa, kidashobora kubakingira na gatoya. Ni co gituma nahahaye izina rivuga ngo Rahabu w’imburakimazi.
Nuko nimugende muvyandike ku bisate vy’amabuye muvyandike mu gitabu, kugira ngo mu misi izoza, bizobabere ivyabona bizokwamaho.
Kuko aba bantu ni abagarariji, abana babesha, batagomba kwumvira ivyo Uhoraho yihanikiririza.

Babwira aberekwa bati: “Ntihagire ico musubira kwerekwa!” Bakabwira abavugishwa bati: “Ntihagire ikintu na kimwe c’ukugororoka musubira kutubwira! Tubwire ibiryohera amatwi yacu, nimuvugishwe ibinyoma!
Va muri iyo nzira, iyo nzira reka kuyicamwo, hanyuma mureke kuduhangara mutubwira ivy’uwo Wera wa Isirayeli.”
Ni co gituma Uwera wa Isirayeli avuze ati: “Ko mwanse kwumva ubwo butumwa mukizera agahahazo mukishimikiza n’ibinyoma,
iki caha kizobabera nk’igihome kirekire, case imigaga, kandi gihengamye, kigiye gusenyuka mu kanya gato.
Kizosenyuka kivunguke kurya kw’inkono imenetse, imenaguwe ata mbabazi, gushika aho ata n’uworonka n’urujo, rwo kurahurirako amakara yaka canke urwo kudahisha amazi mw’iriba.”
Ng’ibi ivyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji, Uwera wa Isirayeli, avuze ati: “Mu kwihana no mu gutekana ni ho hari agakiza kanyu, mu gutekana no mu kwizigira ni ho hari inkomezi zanyu. Ariko ntimwabishatse.
Mwishuye muti: ‘Oya! Tuzohunga turi ku mafarasi.’ Kandi koko muzohunga! Mwavuze muti: ‘Tuzogendera ku mafarasi anyaruka.’ Kubera ivyo ababahiga na bo nyene bazoba banyaruka cane!

Abantu igihumbi bazokinagizwa n’umuntu umwe; abantu batanu bazobatera ubwoba muhunge mwese, gushika musigaye mumeze nk’igiti c’ibendera kigaragara gishinze ku musozi, canke ibendera rishinze ku gasozi.”
