Ariko Uhoraho aripfuza kubagirira imbabazi; ku bw’ivyo azohaguruka kugira ngo abereke impuhwe, kuko Uhoraho ari Imana y’ukugororoka. Hahiriwe abamwiteze.
Yemwe bantu b’i Siyoni, namwe ababa i Yerusalemu, ntimugisubira kurira. Azobagirira imbabazi nimwamuririra. Niyamara kubumva, azoca abishura.
Naho Imana ibagaburiye ivyokurya vy’amakuba n’amazi y’imibabaro, umwigisha wanyu ntazosubira guhishwa, muzomwibonera imbonankubone.
Naho mwohengamira i buryo canke i bubamfu, amatwi yanyu azokwumva ijwi ryiwe inyuma yanyu, ribabwira riti: “Inzira ni iyi, nibe ari yo mucamwo.”
Maze muzomenagura ibishushanyo vyanyu mwometseko ifeza, hamwe n’ibibumbano mwometseko inzahabu. Muzobishibura nk’uwushibura ibiteye ishishi, muvuga muti: “Hogi, vaho wa mwanda we!”
Azosubira abarungikire imvura imeze ivyo mwarimye, kandi ivyo muzokwimbura bizoba vyiza, kandi vy’umusesekara. Ico gihe inka zanyu zizorisha mu matongo yagutse.
Inka n’indogoba zirima zizorya ivyatsi birunze umunyu, vyanikishijwe ikanya n’igipahu.
Ku musi w’agatikizo gahambaye, igihe iminara izosiduka, imigende y’amazi izotemba ku mitumba no ku misozi yose.
Ukwezi kuzokayangana nk’izuba, ugukayangana kw’izuba kuzokwigwiza incuro indwi, kungane n’umuco w’imisi indwi, umusi Uhoraho azopfuka ibisebe vy’abantu biwe, akabakiza inguma yabateye.
Ehe izina ry’ Uhoraho rije rivuye kure, rirurumbamwo uburake bwiwe, ritwikiriwe n’umwotsi mwinshi; iminwa yiwe yuzuye uburakari, ururimi rwiwe ni umuriro utongora.
Impwemu ziwe zimeze nk’umukuba w’amazi, uduga ukagera mw’izosi. Anyiganyije amahanga ayagosoresheje agatikizo, ayambitse umujiginya, ayakwegera mu mahonero.
Namwe muzoririmba nk’abigina umusi mukuru wera. Imitima yanyu izohimbarwa, nko mu gihe abantu baduga bavuza imyironge baja ku musozi w’ Uhoraho , baja ku Gitandara ca Isirayeli.
Uhoraho azotuma abantu bumva ijwi ryiwe ry’icubahiro, atume babona ukuboko kwiwe kumanuka mu burake bwinshi, kuzananye n’umuriro utongora, n’umuyaga w’igihuhusi, hamwe n’imituragaro n’urubura.
Abashuri nibumva ijwi ry’ Uhoraho bazocika ivutu. Azobakubitisha inkoni yiwe.
Uhoraho niyakubita inkoni imwe nk’uko yabitegekanije, izojana n’umudiho w’ingoma n’inanga mu gihe azoba ariko arabagwanya, abakubitisha ukuboko kwiwe.
Tofeti harateguye uhereye kera; hateguriwe umwami. Ikinogo co gutuririramwo caraguwe kiba kinini, n’inkwi zo gucana ziragwizwa; impwemu z’ Uhoraho , zimeze nk’amazuku yaka, ni zo zizidometse.

Bazobona ibara abamanuka muri Egiputa kurondera ugutabarwa, bakizera amafarasi, bakizera ubwinshi bw’imikogote n’inkomezi z’abagendera ku mafarasi, aho guhanga amaso Uwera wa Isirayeli, canke ngo barondere ugutabarwa kuva k’ Uhoraho .
Ariko rero Uhoraho na we arazi ubwenge, azobateza ivyago, kandi ntazokwivuguruza. Azohagurukira inzu y’inkozi z’ibibi, hamwe n’abatabara inkozi z’ibibi.

Kuko Abanyegiputa ari abantu buntu, atari Imana; amafarasi yabo na yo akaba ibintu vy’umubiri gusa atari impwemu. Uhoraho niyaramvura ukuboko kwiwe, umutabazi azotsitara, uwutabawe azogwa, bompi bazohonera hamwe.

Uhoraho yambwiye ati: “Nk’uko intare yivuga, kandi nk’uko intare ikomeye irohera ku co yafashe, abungere bagakorana ngo bayigwanye, ariko ntiterwe ubwoba n’urwamo rwabo n’induru yabo, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azomanurwa no kugwanira ku musozi Siyoni, n’ahakirurutse cane hawo.
Nk’uko ibisiga bisanza amababa, hejuru y’ivyari ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azokingira Yerusalemu; azohakingira yongere aharokore, azoca hejuru yaho ahakize.
Yemwe Bisirayeli, enda nimugaruke kuri Umwe mwagarariza.
Igihe kizogera, aho muzota ibigirwamana vy’ifeza n’ivy’inzahabu amaboko yanyu yuzuye ivyaha yakoze.
Ashuri hazorandurwa n’inkota itari iy’abantu; inkota itari iy’abantu buntu ni yo izobarigita. Bazohunga imbere y’iyo nkota, kandi imikangara yabo izogirwa abagurano.

Ahantu hakomeye binyegeza hazosenyuka kubera ubwoba, abakuru mu ntambara nibabona amabendera y’intambara, bazota umutwe.” Uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uwufise umuriro wiwe i Siyoni, akagira n’itanure i Yerusalemu.
Ehe raba, hagiye kwima umwami agororotse, kandi abatware biwe bazoganzanya ubugororotsi.
Umwumwe wese muri bo azomera nk’ahantu ho kwikinga umuyaga canke aho guhungira igihuhusi, yongere abe nk’imbizi y’amazi mu bugaragwa, canke nk’igitutu kiva ku gitandara kinini mu gihugu kigadutse.
Maze amaso y’ababona ntazosubira guhumiriza, nayo amatwi y’abumva azokwumviriza.
Imitima ihuha izogira ubwenge n’ugutahura, n’indimi z’abagigimiza zizovuga zirongorotse.
Abantu b’ibipfu ntibazoba bacitwa intwari, n’indyarya ntizizohabwa icubahiro.
Kuko ibipfu bivuga ivy’ubupfu, imitima yavyo yagondamiye ku bibi. Bagendera mu kutubaha Imana, bagakwiragiza ibinyoma k’ Uhoraho ; bima indya uwushonje, uwunyotewe bakamwima amazi.
Inzira z’indyadya ziragoramanze, barementaniriza ibinyoma umukene kugira ngo bamuranduze ibinyoma, naho umukene yoba avuga ibitunganye.
Ariko inyankamugayo zigira imigabo myiza, kandi mu bikorwa vyabo vy’inyankamugayo barashikama.
Mwa bagore mwe mwidibamiye, nimuve hasi munyumvirize, namwe bakobwa mwumva mutekaniwe, nimwumve ivyo mvuga,
Mu gihe kirenga gatoya umwaka, mwebwe mwumva ko mukingiwe muzojugumira. Inzabibu zanyu ntizizokwama, iyimbura ryazo ntirizokwigera ribaho.
Nimuhinde agashitsi, yemwe bagore mwidibamiye, muhagarike imitima namwe bakobwa mwumva mutekaniwe! Nimwambure imyambaro yanyu nziza, mukenyere amagunira.
Nimwikubite mu gikiriza, ku bw’imirima mwakunda, n’inzabibu zahora zama cane,
mubabazwe n’igihugu c’abantu banje, camezemwo amahwa n’imikere. Muborogere amazu meza ahimbaye, hamwe n’ibisagara vy’umunezero.
Kuko ikirimba c’umwami n’igisagara bizotabwa, igisagara cuzuyemwo urwamo gihebwe. Ahari agasozi n’umunara w’inderetsi hazotabwa ibihe vyose, hahinduke ikirimbiro ry’indogoba n’uburagiro bw’ibitungwa,
gushika aho Mpwemu azodusukwako avuye mw’ijuru. Ni ho ubugaragwa buzocika isi imera, umurima umera na wo ukamera nk’ishamba.
Ubutungane bw’ Uhoraho buzoba mu bugaragwa, ubugororotsi na bwo bube kw’isi imera.
Inkurikizi y’ubwo bugororotsi izoba amahoro, bizotuma haba ugutekana n’ukwizerana ibihe vyose.
Abantu banje bazoba ahantu hari amahoro, mu mazu y’umutekano, aho ata kizobakokoma baruhutse.
Naho urubura rwohonya ishamba, igisagara kigasenyukira hasi cose,
Uhoraho azohezagira ubwoko bwiwe. Bazobiba bimbure umusesekara, ibitungwa vyanyu bizorisha ahatotahaye.

Uzobona ibara yewe wa muranduzi we, wewe utarigera urandurwa! Uzobona ibara yewe muryarukanyi we, wewe utarigera uryarukwa! Niwamara kurandura abandi, nawe uzorandurwa; kandi niwamara guheza guhemukira abandi, nawe uzohemukirwa.
Uhoraho , tugirire ubuntu, ni wewe twamye twiteze. Utubere inkomezi uko bukeye, utubere n’agakiza mu bihe vy’amagorwa.
Iyo abansi bumvise ugukankama kwawe, bose barahunga, kandi iyo uhagurutse, amahanga arashwiragira.
Uwabanyaga, yemwe mahanga, abaye nk’umurima uciwemwo n’inzige, nk’uko ikigwi c’inzige cona ni ko ivyabo bizonyagwa.
Uhoraho ari hejuru ya vyose, ari mw’ijuru. Azokwuzuza Siyoni ubutungane n’ukugororoka vyiwe.
Ico gihe azobabara urufatiro rw’ukuri, ububiko bw’ubutunzi bw’agakiza, ubwenge n’ubumenyi; ukwubaha Uhoraho ni rwo rupfunguruzo rw’ubwo butunzi.
Ehe raba intwari zabo zizoborogera mw’ibarabara, n’intumwa zabo z’amahoro zirirane umubabaro.
Amabarabara manini aragaragara, nta ngenzi zikiyacamwo. Amasezerano y’amahoro bagize bayarenzeko, basuzuguye abayashingira intahe, nta muntu n’umwe bubaha.
Ehe raba igihugu kiragandaye kandi kiragadutse, Libani hatewe n’isoni kandi harakabiranye. Sharoni habaye nko muri Araba, Bashani na Karumeli hahunguruye amababi yaho.
“Ubu rero ngira mpaguruke,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze; “ubu rero nzoshirwa hejuru, ubu rero nzokwerekana ubukuru n’ubushobozi vyanje.
Mutwara inda y’umuguruka, mukavyara ibishingwe; impwemu zanyu ni zo zihinduka umuriro ubatongora.
Amahanga azoturirwa gushika abe umunyota; nka kurya amahwa atemwa agatererwa mu muriro.”
Yemwe abari kure, nimwumve ivyo nakoze; namwe abari hafi, mwemere ko ndi umunyenkomezi!

Abanyavyaha b’i Siyoni batewe n’ubwoba, ukujugumira guteye abatubaha Imana: “Ni nde muri twebwe yoshobora kubana n’uwo muriro utongora? Ni nde muri twebwe yoshobora kubana n’ugutongora kw’ibihe vyose?”

Nibagendera mu kugororoka, bakavuga ukuri, bagata kure ubugunge, bakarinda amaboko yabo kwakira ibiturire, bakazibira amatwi yabo ntiyumve inama z’abicanyi, bagahumiriza amaso yabo bakayabuza gukwegwa n’ibibi.
Abo ni bo bazoba ahataramutse, bikingirije umusozi nk’igihome. Bazohabwa umutsima wo kurya, kandi ntibazobura amazi yo kunywa.
Amaso yanyu azobona umwami mu bwiza bwiwe, abone n’igihugu ciwe ciramvuye gushika kure.
Ni ho muzokwibaza ku bihe vyari biteye ubwoba vyaheze muti: “Mbega wa mukuru yaganza ingabo ari hehe? Umwe yadutoza ikori we yaroye he? Wa mukuru akomeye mu ngabo yari ajejwe iminara ari he?”
Ntimuzosubira kubona na rimwe abo bantu bari buzuye ubwibone, bavuga imvugo itumvikana, mu rurimi rw’abanyamahanga mudatahura.

Nimurabe i Siyoni, umugwa wakorerwamwo imisi mikuru; amaso yanyu azobona Yerusalemu, hameze nk’uburuhukiro bw’amahoro, ihema ritazokwigera rishingurwa; imambo zaryo ntizizokwigera zishingurwa, nta n’umugozi waryo n’umwe uzocika.
Ni ho Uhoraho azotubera Umunyenkomezi. Hazoba ari ahantu h’inzuzi nini n’imigezi. Nta bwato busozwa buzozicamwo, nta n’amato akomeye azohaca.
Kuko Uhoraho ni we mucamaza wacu, Uhoraho ni we atanga amategeko. Uhoraho ni we Mwami wacu, kandi ni we azodukiza.
Imigozi yawe ifata amato iradohotse, ntiboshe neza ku giti c’igitambara, igitambara na co ntikibamvye. Hanyuma ivy’agaciro vyanyazwe bizogaburwa, mbere n’abacumbagira bazogira ivyo banyaze.
Mu baba i Siyoni nta wuzovuga ati: “Ndagwaye”; kandi ivyaha vy’abahaba vyose bizoharirwa.
Yemwe mwa mahanga mwe, nimwegere mwumvirize; nimutege amatwi mwa bantu mwe! Isi n’ibiri muri yo vyose nivyumve, isi yose n’ibiyivamwo vyose.
Uhoraho arakiye amahanga yose, uburake bwiwe buri ku ngabo z’ayo mahanga. Azobatikiza abaherengeteze, azobarekurira ku babasogota.
Imivyimba yabo izokwandagara, umunuko w’ibiziga uzokwira igihugu cose; imisozi izotemba amaraso yabo.
Inyenyeri zizozima, ijuru ryizinge nk’umuzingo. Ivyaka vyo mu kirere bizokoragurika nk’amababi y’umuzabibu yumye, canke nk’insukoni zihunguruka ziva ku giti.
Inkota yanje imaze kunywa ikaborerwa mu majuru, izoshunguruka igwe kuri Edomu, ubwoko naciriye urwo kuranduka.

Inkota y’ Uhoraho yoze mu maraso, yuzuye ibinure: amaraso y’intama n’impene, hamwe n’ibinure vyo mu mafyigo y’amapfizi y’intama. Kuko Uhoraho yatanze ibimazi i Bozira, akongera akica benshi muri Edomu.
Imbogo zitembana na bo, hamwe n’ibimasa n’amapfizi. Igihugu cabo kizoborerwa amaraso, umukungugu waho na wo umirwe n’ibinure.
Kuko Uhoraho afise umusi w’ukwihora, n’umwaka wo kwishuza, ivyo Siyoni hakorewe.
Imigezi ya Edomu izohinduka nk’ikaburimbi, umukungugu waho uhinduke nk’ibizuku vyaka. Igihugu cose kizoba nk’ikaburimbi yaka!
Kizokwaka ku murango no mw’ijoro; umwotsi waco uzopfunduka ibihe vyose. Igihugu kizocika ubugaragwa imyaka n’iyindi; nta n’uwuzosubira kugicamwo.
Ibihuna n’ibigendabunyovu ni vyo bizohiganzira. Ibihuna bininibinini n’ibikona ni vyo bizoharika. Imana izopimisha Edomu umugozi w’imivurungano, na karisho ari ko gatikizo.
Abubahwa baho ntibazoba bacitwa ko bafise ubwami, abaganwa baho bazoba bacitse ubusa.
Ibirimba vyaho bizomeramwo ivyatsi, inzitiro zaho zimereko ibisuru n’ibitovu. Hazohinduka ihuriro ry’imbwebwe, aho ibisiga vyitwa imbuni vyibera.
Inyamaswa zo mu bugaragwa zizohahurira n’imfyisi, n’impene zo mw’ishamba zizohagira ihuriro. Ibihuna bizoja kuharuhukira, biharonke inzu zo kwiberamwo.

Aho ni ho ibihuna bizokwarika bihate amagi, bibundikire amagi avemwo imiswi, hanyuma biyiteho ico gihe izoba iri mu gitutu c’amababa yavyo. Aho kandi ni ho ibinyakabaka bizokoranira, kimwekimwe na kigenzi caco.

Nimusesangure mu gitabu c’ Uhoraho , musome ivyanditsemwo: Nta na kimwe muri ivyo bikoko n’ivyo bisiga kizohara, nta na kimwe kizobura kigenzi caco, kuko akanwa k’ Uhoraho ari ko kabitegetse, Mpwemu wiwe na we akaba ari we avyegeranya.
Yakoresheje ubupfindo mu kugena ah’umwe wese, ukuboko kwiwe kuhabagaburira ku rugero. Bazohegukira ibihe vyose, uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi.
Ubugaragwa n’isi igadutse bizonezerwa, inyovu yumye inezerwe kandi ishurike nk’amashurwe yitwa narasisi.

Hazokwuzura amashurwe menshi, higinagure n’indirimbo z’umunezero. Hazohabwa ubwiza bw’i Libani, hahabwe n’igikundiro c’i Karumeli n’i Sharoni. Abaho bose bazobona ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho n’ubukuru bw’Imana yacu.
Nimukomeze amaboko adendebukiwe, mukomeze n’amavi areganutse,
mubwire abafise imitima yuzuye ubwoba muti: “Nimukomere, ntimutinye; Imana yanyu iraje, izanywe no kubahora; ije ifise ingero, izanywe no kubakiza.”
Maze amaso y’impumyi azohumuka, amatwi y’ibipfamatwi yuguruke.
Ibimuga bizosimba nk’ingeregere, indimi z’ibiragi ziririmbe indirimbo z’umunezero. Amasoko y’amazi azodudubiza mu bugaragwa, n’inzuzi zizosendanisha ahagadutse.
Ahari umusenyi uturira hazohinduka ikidengeri c’amazi, n’isi igadutse izodudubiza amazi. Ahahora ari ihuriro n’ubwihisho bw’imfyisi hazomera ubwatsi butotahaye, amarenga hamwe n’urufunzo.
Hazobayo ibarabara ryagutse, rizokwitwa Inzira y’Ukwera; izoba iy’abagendera mu nzira z’Imana. Abahumanye ntibazoyicamwo; ibipfu ntibizoyihonyoramwo.
Nta ntare zizoyicamwo, eka nta n’ikindi gikoko kiryana; kizoharangwa. Abacunguwe bonyene ni bo bazoyicamwo.

Abacunguwe n’ Uhoraho bazogaruka; bazokwinjira i Siyoni baririmba; umunezero udashira ni wo uzoba urugori ku mitwe yabo. Akamwemwe n’umunezero bizobuzura, kandi umubabaro no gusuhuza umutima bizohunga.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kane umwami Hezekiya ari ku ngoma, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri atera ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye vyose vy’i Buyuda, arabifata.

Maze umwami w’i Ashuri arungika umukuru w’ikambi n’ingabo nyinshi cane, bava i Lakishi baja i Yerusalemu aho umwami Hezekiya yari ari. Maze uwo mukuru ageze ku mugende utwara amazi mu rugomero rwo haruguru, kw’ibarabara rija kw’Itongo ry’Umumesuzi, ahagararaho.
Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya umukuru w’ikirimba, na Shebuna umunyamabanga w’umwami, na Yowa mwene Asafu umwanditsi, baba ari bo baja guhura na we.
Maze umukuru w’ingabo za Ashuri ababwira ati: “Mubwire Hezekiya muti: ‘Umwami ahambaye, ari we mwami w’i Ashuri avuze ngo: Mbega wishimirije iki?
Uvuga ngo ufise ubuhinga bwo kugwana ukagira n’ingabo nyinshi; ariko ivyo ni amajambo gusa ata co amaze. Mbe wishimirije nde yotuma ungarariza?
Mbega wishimiye Egiputa? Rirya renga rivunitse ricumita mu kiganza uwo wese aryishimikije! Uko ni ko Farawo umwami wa Egiputa ameze ku bamwizigira bose.

Niwaba na ho ugira uti: “Twishimikije Uhoraho Imana yacu,” mbega si wewe nyene Hezekiya wayisamburiye ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi hamwe n’ibicaniro, ukabwira Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu uti: “Muzohora musengera imbere y’iki gicaniro honyene”?
None rero, ingo muhige na databuja, umwami w’i Ashuri. Nanje ndaguha amafarasi ibihumbi bibiri, nimba unafise abashobora kuyagenderako!
Mbega none wewe, woshobora gute kwirukana intwazangabo naho yoba ari imwe yo mu ngabo za databuja zo hanyuma y’izindi, naho wozanana n’imikogote n’abagwanira ku mafarasi b’Abanyegiputa?
Turetse n’ivyo, mbe wibaza ko twaje gutera no gusambura iki gihugu, ata co Uhoraho yatubwiye? Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we yambwiye kuza gutera iki gihugu no kugisangangura.’ ”

Maze Eliyakimu, Shebuna na Yowa babwira uwo mukuru bati: “Turakwinginze twebwe abasavyi bawe utubwire mu Carameya, kuko tucumva. Ntubandanye uvuga mu Giheburayo abantu bose bari ku ruzitiro bavyumva.”

Ariko uwo mukuru w’ingabo abishura ati: “Mbega mwibaza ko databuja yarungikiye ubutumwa shobuja wenyene? N’abo bari ku ruzitiro nibavyumve kuko nimutishikana, tuzobugariza mwicwe n’inzara n’inyota gushika aho murya umwanda mukuru wanyu, munywe n’umwanda mutoya wanyu.”
Maze uwo mukuru w’ingabo arahaguruka avuga n’ijwi rirenga mu Giheburayo ati: “Nimwumve amajambo y’umwami ahambaye, ari we mwami w’i Ashuri!
Avuze ngo: Ntimwemere ko Hezekiya abahenda. Ntashobora kubakiza na gatoya.
Ntahave abahenda ngo mwizere Uhoraho ababwira ngo: ‘ Uhoraho azodukiza, ntazokwemera ko iki gisagara kigwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri.’

Ntimwumvirize Hezekiya. Ibi ni vyo umwami w’i Ashuri abamenyesheje: Nimurondere amahoro mu kwishikana iwanje. Ni ho umwe wese muri mwebwe azorya ku nzabibu no ku nsukoni ziwe, akanywa no ku mazi y’iriba ryiwe,
gushika aho nzobatwarira mu gihugu kimeze nk’iki c’iwanyu, igihugu kirimwo ingano n’umuvinyu mushasha, igihugu cuzuye indya n’imizabibu.
Ntimwemere ko Hezekiya abazimiza, niyababwira ati: ‘ Uhoraho azoturokora.’ Mbega hari imana z’ihanga na rimwe zigeze zirokora igihugu cazo mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Ashuri?
Mbega imana z’i Hamati n’i Arupadi ziri hehe? Iz’i Sefaruvayimu ziri hehe? Mbega zarakijije Samariya mu maboko yanje?
Mbega mu mana zose z’ivyo bihugu, ni izihe zashoboye kubikiza ukuboko kwanje? None Uhoraho ni we yokiza Yerusalemu mu maboko yanje?”
Ariko abari ngaho baguma banumye, ntihagira ico bishura, kuko umwami yari yabihanikirije ati: “Ntihagire na kimwe mumwishura.”

Maze Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya uwari ajejwe ikirimba, na Shebuna umunyamabanga, hamwe na Yowa mwene Asafu umwanditsi, basubira kwa Hezekiya, bitaburiyeko impuzu, bamubwira ivyo wa mukuru w’ingabo yavuze vyose.
Umwami Hezekiya avyumvise yitaburirako impuzu, yambara amagunira, aja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Aca arungika Eliyakimu umukuru w’ikirimba, Shebuna umunyamabanga hamwe n’abaherezi bakurira abandi, baja kuraba umuvugishwa Yesaya mwene Amozi, kandi bose bagenda bambaye amagunira.
Baramubwira bati: “Umwami Hezekiya avuze ati: Uwu ni umusi w’amagorwa, ibihano n’ibiteterwe, tumeze nka kurya umwana ageze kuvuka ariko nyina akabura inkomezi zo kumuvyara.

Kumbure Uhoraho Imana yawe yokwumva amajambo y’uwo mukuru w’ingabo, ayo yarungikanywe na shebuja umwami w’i Ashuri, yo gucokora Imana nzima; maze Uhoraho Imana yawe akabimuhanira. None rero udusengere twebwe abagisigaye.”
Abatware b’umwami Hezekiya baja kwa Yesaya,
na we aca ababwira ati: “Gende mubwire shobuja muti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ntimugire ubwoba kubera ivyo mwumvise, ari yo majambo yo kuntuka y’umwami w’i Ashuri.
Umviriza! Ngiye kumushiramwo impwemu izotuma yumva inkuru z’ibihuha, azoca afata ingingo yo gusubira mu gihugu ciwe, aho nzotuma yicwa n’inkota.’ ”
Wa mukuru w’ingabo yumvise ko umwami w’i Ashuri yavuye i Lakishi, aca ahamagara ingabo ziwe baja kuraba umwami, basanga ariko agwanira i Libuna.
Ico gihe nyene Senakeribu aca aronka inkuru zimubwira ko Tiruhaka umwami wa Etiyopiya azananye n’ingabo ziwe baje kumutera. Imbere yo gusubira inyuma, asigira ubutumwa Hezekiya, avuga ati:
“Mubwire Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda muti: Iyo Mana wishimiye ntiguhende ngo izobuza ko Yerusalemu hafatwa n’umwami w’i Ashuri.
Ndazi ko wumvise ivyo abami b’i Ashuri bakoreye ayandi mahanga, ingene babaranduye bakabamara. None wibaza ko wewe uzorokoka?
Mbega imana z’ayo mahanga yatikijwe na ba sogokuruza zarayakingiye? Za mana za Gozani, Harani, Rezefu n’abantu bo muri Edeni baba i Teli Asari, zarashoboye kubakiza?
Mbega umwami w’i Hamati ari hehe canke umwami w’i Arupadi? Abami b’ibisagara vya Sefaruvayimu, Hena na Iwa bari hehe?”
Maze Hezekiya yakira ikete ahawe n’intumwa ararisoma, aca aduga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , arizingururira imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Asenga Uhoraho avuga ati:
“ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Mana ya Isirayeli, wewe wicaye ku ntebe y’inganji hagati y’abakerubi, ni wewe Mana wenyene mu bwami bwose bwo kw’isi. Ni wewe waremye ijuru n’isi.
Tega ugutwi Mana yanje, wumve. Utereze inyonga zawe urabe, ewe Uhoraho ; wumve amajambo Senakeribu yarungitse yo gucokora Imana nzima.
Uhoraho we, ni ivy’ukuri ko abami b’i Ashuri batikije ayo moko yose n’ibihugu vyayo.
Bataye imana zabo mu muriro barazitikiza, kuko zitari imana, vyari ibiti n’amabuye, vyakozwe n’amaboko y’abana b’abantu.
None rero Uhoraho Mana yacu, dukize udukure mu maboko yiwe, kugira ngo ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi buzomenye ko wewe wenyene, Uhoraho , ari wewe Mana.”
Yesaya mwene Amozi arungikira ubutumwa Hezekiya avuga ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Numvise ugusenga kwawe ku vyerekeye Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri.
Aya ni yo majambo Uhoraho amurungikiye: Umukobwa w’i Siyoni aragukengereye kandi aragutwenze. Umukobwa w’i Yerusalemu akuzungurije umutwe akuraba ingene uhunga.
Mbega wibaza ko uwo watutse ukongera ukamucokora ari nde? Ni nde warengeje urwamo, ukamurabisha amaso yawe y’agakengerwe? Ni Uwera wa Isirayeli.

Watumye intumwa zawe ziza kuntuka jewe Imana. Uravuga uti: ‘Naduganye imikogote yanje myinshi nshika hejuru ku misozi, ndetse nshika no kw’isonga rya Libani. Niciye amasederi asumvya ayandi uburebure, n’ubujwari busumvya ubundi ubwiza. Narahagendagenze nshika no mu bibanza vyaho vya kure, ngenzura n’amashamba yaho atotahaye cane.
Nimvye amariba mu yandi mahanga, nywa n’amazi yaho. Mponyangisha ibirenge vyanje inzuzi za Egiputa, gushika aho zikama.’
Mbega ntiwari bwavyumve? Ivyo vyose ni jewe nagenye ko bizoba kuva kera. Nabiteguye kera cane, none ubu ndabishikije, ntuma ufata ibisagara bifise inzitiro zikomeye ubihindura ibirundo vy’amabuye.
Abantu bo muri vyo wabamaze amanyama, bacika ivutu, baramaramara. Bameze nk’ivyatsi vyo mu gahinga, nk’ubwatsi bukimera. Bameze nk’utwatsi twimeza ku nzu hejuru, dukabirana tutarakura.
Ariko ndakuzi neza, ndazi aho uri, ndazi amaja n’amaza yawe; ndazi n’ingene wandakiye.
None rero ko wandakiye, amajambo yawe atagira indero agashika mu matwi yanje, nzogutungira igera mu zuru, ndagushire umunyororo mu kanwa, ndagusubize inyuma, uciye mu nzira wazananye.

Yewe Hezekiya, iki ni co kimenyetso uhawe: Uwu mwaka uzorya ivyimejeje, umwaka ukurikira uzorya ibizonaga kuri vyo. Ariko ku mwaka ugira gatatu, uzobiba wimbure, utere imizabibu, urye ku vyamwa vyayo.
Nayo amasigarira y’abacitse kw’icumu yo mu muryango wa Yuda azokwongera amere nk’igiti gishora imizi mu kuzimu, maze hejuru amashami na yo akama ivyamwa.
Kuko i Yerusalemu hazokwamuka amasigarira, no ku musozi Siyoni have abacitse kw’icumu. Ishaka ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo rizoshitsa ivyo.

Ku bw’ivyo, uku ni ko, Uhoraho avuze ku mwami w’i Ashuri: Ntazokwinjira mu gisagara c’i Yerusalemu canke ngo araseyo umwampi. Ntazokwegera inzitiro yitwaje inkinzo yiwe, canke ngo azubakeko ivyo kwuririrako ngo ahatere.
Inzira yazananye ni yo izomusubiza inyuma; ntazokwinjira iki gisagara,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nzogwanira iki gisagara ndakirokore, ku bwanje no ku bw’umusavyi wanje Dawidi.”
Maze umumarayika w’ Uhoraho araza, atera insago z’Abashuri, yica ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani na bitanu. Abantu bavyutse mu gitondo basanga imivyimba irambikanze ahantu hose.
Maze Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri aca asubira inyuma, aja kuba i Ninewe agumayo.

Umusi umwe, Senakeribu ari mu ngoro ya Nisuroki imana yiwe ariko arasenga, abahungu biwe Adurameleki na Sharezeri baraza bamwicisha inkota, bahungira mu gihugu c’i Ararati. Umuhungu wiwe Esaruhadoni aca amusubirira ku ngoma.

headings.text: Yesaya avugishwa ivyo gutabarwa kwa Yuda

verses.text: Muri iyo misi, Hezekiya aragwara, ashika ku mpfiro. Umuvugishwa Yesaya mwene Amozi aja kumuraba, amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ngo: ‘Tunganya ivyo mu rugo rwawe, kuko ugiye gupfa, ntuzokira.’ ”
Maze Hezekiya aca ahindukiriza amaso ku ruhome, asenga Uhoraho ,
avuga ati: “ Uhoraho we, ibuka ingene nagendeye imbere yawe mu bwizigirwa nkagukorera nguhaye umutima wanje wose, ngakora ivyo ubona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga zawe.” Hezekiya ararira cane.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Yesaya,
riti: “Genda ubwire Hezekiya uti: uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya sogokuruza Dawidi avuze: ‘Numvise ugusenga kwawe, kandi nabonye n’amarira yawe; ndakwongeye iyindi myaka cumi n’itanu yo kubaho.
Kandi iki gisagara nzogikura mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri. Iki gisagara nzokigwanira.
Iki ni co kimenyetso cemeza ko Uhoraho azoshitsa ivyo asezeranye:
Nzosubiza inyuma amatambwe cumi; igitutu cazanywe n’izuba, mpereye ku ngazi ya Ahazi.’ ” Ca gitutu gisubira inyuma amatambwe cumi.
Aya ni yo majambo Hezekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda yanditse, amaze gukira ingwara yari agwaye.
Naravuze nti: “Nari ngeze hagati mu myaka y’ukubaho kwanje, none ngiye kwinjira mu marembo y’urupfu! Imyaka nari nsigaje kubaho ndayinyazwe.”
Naravuze nti: “Sinzosubira kubona Uhoraho nkiri kw’isi y’abazima, sinzosubira kubonana n’abantu, canke ngo mbane n’ababa muri iyi si.
Ubuzima bwanje bunkuweko, nk’ihema ry’umwungere rigururwa n’umuyaga. Ubuzima bwanje ndabuzinze nk’uko umujishi azinga impuzu, agira acacurire ku kijishiro. Imbere y’uko bwira, uzoba wancacuye.
Narindiriye nihanganye gushika mu bucagucagu, ariko uvunagura amagufa yanje yose nk’intare; imbere y’uko bwira, uzoba wandangije.
Mvuza induru ingana n’iy’intamba, mboroga nk’inuma. Amaso yanje aruhishwa no kurangamiza mw’ijuru ndagutakira. Ewe Mana, ntabara unkize.”
Mvuge iki kindi? Yavuganye nanje, kandi ni yo nyene yakoze ibi. Nzogenda niyoroheje imyaka yanje yose, ku bw’umubabaro uri mu mutima wanje.
Ewe Mana, ibi ni vyo bibeshaho abantu, kandi impwemu yanje ni ho ironkera ubugingo. Wansubije amagara, unyemerera kubaho.
Koko, vyari bibereye ko nca muri iyo mibabaro. Mu rukundo rwawe, ntiwemeye ko nja mu rwobo rwo kurandurwa, ivyaha vyanje vyose, wabisize inyuma yawe.
Kuko abari mu mva badashobora kugutazira, kandi abapfuye badashobora kukuririmbira ishimwe; abamanuka epfo i kuzimu ntibaba bacizera ubwizigirwa bwawe.
Abazima bonyene ni bo bashobora kugutazira nk’uko ndiko ndabikora uwu musi. Abavyeyi biganira abana babo ivy’ubwizigirwa bwawe.
Uhoraho , ni wewe uzonkiza, nanje nzokuririmbira ishimwe, ngucurarangire inanga ibihe vyose, ndi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Yesaya yari yavuze ati: “Nimutegure akarobe kabumvye mu nsukoni, mugatembagaze ku kivyimba, aca akira.”
Hezekiya abaza ati: “Ni ikihe kimenyetso cemeza ko nzosubira kuduga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ?”
Muri ico gihe nyene, Merodaki-Baladani mwene Baladani, umwami w’i Babiloni, arungikira Hezekiya amakete yo kumusuhuza hamwe n’utuganuke, kuko yari yumvise ivyo kugwara no gukira kwiwe.

Hezekiya yakira neza abazanye ubwo butumwa, abereka mu nzu hose n’ivyari mu bubiko vyose: ifeza, inzahabu, ibimota neza, amavuta, abereka n’imyambaro y’intambara, hamwe n’ibindi vyose vyari mu bubiko bwiwe. Nta na kimwe cari ku kirimba canke mu bwami bwose ataberetse.
Umuvugishwa Yesaya aragenda abaza umwami Hezekiya ati: “Abo bantu bakubwiye iki, kandi baje bava he?” Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Baje iwanje bavuye mu gihugu ca kure; baje bava i Babiloni.”
Yesaya aramubaza ati: “Babonye iki ku kirimba iwawe?” Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Babonye ibintu vyose biri mu ngoro yanje. Nta na kimwe c’ubutunzi bwanje ntaberetse.”
Yesaya abwira Hezekiya ati: “Niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose:
Hazogera igihe aho ibiri muri iyi ngoro vyose, ivyo ba sogokuruza bawe begeranije gushika uwu musi, bizotwarwa i Babiloni. Nta na kimwe kizosigara, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Kandi bamwe bo mu ruvyaro rwawe, abana bawe bwite, bazogukomokako, bazotwarwa, bagirwe inkone ku kirimba c’umwami w’i Babiloni.”
Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho uvuze ni ryiza.” Aho rero ni kubera yibwira mu mutima ati: “Kazima mu gihe nzoba nkiriho hazoba hari amahoro.”
Nimuhumurize, nimuhumurize abantu banje, ni ko Imana yanyu ivuze.
Nimuvuge ibihumuriza imitima y’ab’i Yerusalemu, mubabwire ko imisi yaho y’imibabaro iheze, ko ivyaha vyabo bihariwe, ko nabahaniye incuro zibiri ivyaha vyose bakoze.
Hari ijwi ry’uwusemerera mu bugaragwa ati: “Nimutegurire Uhoraho aho aca, mugorore inzira agenderamwo, mutegurire Imana yacu inzira yagutse.
Imyonga yose izokwuzuzwa iringanire, imisozi n’udutumba vyose bisenwe, n’inzira zisivye zizosiburwa, ziringanizwe, ahakirurutse hagirwe itaba.
Ubwiza bw’Imana buzohishurwa, kandi abantu bose bazobubona. Akanwa k’ Uhoraho ni ko kabivuze.”
Ijwi riravuze riti: “Semerera.” Nanje ndavuga nti: “Nsemerere mvuga iki?” “Semerera uvuge ko abantu bose bameze nk’ivyatsi, kandi ko ubwiza bwabo bumeze nk’amashurwe yo ku misozi.
Ubwatsi buruma, amashurwe agakabirana, iyo impwemu z’ Uhoraho zibiciyeko. Ukwo ni ko abantu bameze.
Ivyatsi biruma, amashurwe agakabirana, ariko ijambo ry’Imana rizokwama rihangamye ibihe vyose.”

Wewe uzanye inkuru nziza kuri Siyoni, duga ku musozi hejuru. Wewe uzanye inkuru nziza kuri Yerusalemu, semerera n’ijwi rirenga. Semerera ntutinye, ubwire ibisagara vy’i Buyuda uti: “Imana yawe iraje!”
Ehe raba Uhoraho Nyeninganji azananye ubushobozi, kandi azoganzisha ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi. Ehe aje azanye ingero, kandi impera ziwe zimwitangiye imbere.
Azoragira ibitungwa vyiwe nk’umwungere, imyagazi azoyikikira mu maboko yiwe, ayiyegereza ku mutima, maze izonsa azoziyobora azengenga.

Mbega ni nde yageze amazi yo mu biyaga? Ni nde yageze ubunini bw’ijuru n’intambwe z’intoke ziwe? Ni nde yegeranirije umukungugu wo kw’isi mu giseke, canke agapima imisozi ku kiro, n’imitumba ku munzane?
Ni nde yotahura ubwenge bw’ Uhoraho , akayibera umwigisha canke umujenama?
Ni nde Uhoraho yagishije inama kugira ngo umuhe impanuro, kandi ni nde yamwigishije inzira iroranye? Ni nde yamwigishije ubwenge, canke ngo amurongore mu nzira y’ugutahura?
Imbere y’ Uhoraho , amahanga ameze nk’ima ry’amazi mu ndobo; ameze nk’umukungugu ku munzane. Agera izinga nk’aho ari umukungugu utumuka.
Ibiti vy’i Libani ntibikwiye ku gicaniro, n’ibikoko vyaho ntibikwiye ku kimazi Uhoraho abereye.
Imbere yiwe amahanga yose ni ubusa; nta co amaze, ni ubusa gusa.
None ni nde twogereranya n’Imana? Ni ikihe kigereranyo twoyigereranya?
Mbega yogereranywa n’ivyakozwe n’amaboko y’abantu, bikomekwako inzahabu, bigasharizwa n’ifeza?
Umukene adashobora kuronka ishikanwa nk’iryo yironderera ikigegene c’igiti kitazobungwa, akarondera umubaji w’umuhinga, akamushingira igishushanyo kitazotemba.
Ntimwari mubizi? Ntimwari bwavyumve? Ntimwabibwiwe kuva mu ntango? Ntimwari mwarabitahuye kuva isi itararemwa?
Imana ni yo yicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami hejuru y’umuzingi w’isi, kandi ababa kw’isi baboneka nk’inzige. Amajuru iyasanza nk’igitambara, ikayagira kurya kw’ihema ryo kubamwo.
Abaganwa bo mw’isi ibahindura ubusa, abatwara iyi si ikabahindura abatagira ico bamaze.
Baba bakigenwa, batarafata ivyicaro, batarashinga imizi, igaca abahuha impwemu bagakabirana, hanyuma umuyaga w’agashururu ukabagurura nk’umuguruka.
“Mbega ni nde mwongereranya? Ni nde angana nanje?” ni ko Uwera abaza.

Unamura amaso murabe kw’ijuru: ni nde yaremye ivyo mubona vyose? Ni we yashizeho inyenyeri zose, imwe ku yindi, imwe yose ayihamagara mw’izina. Kubera ubushobozi bwiwe bwinshi n’inkomezi ziwe, nta n’imwe ibuzemwo.
Ni kuki widodomba, ewe Yakobo, kandi ni kuki, ewe Isirayeli, uvuga uti: “Inzira zanje zinyegejwe Uhoraho , Imana yirengagije urubanza rwanje”?
Ntimwari mubizi? Ntimwari bwavyumve? Uhoraho ni Imana y’ibihe vyose, ni we muremyi w’isi iyo iva ikagera. Ntazorambirwa canke ngo adendebukirwe, ubwenge bwiwe ntibutahurwa n’abantu.
Ni we yongera inkomezi abacitse intege, akongerereza inguvu abanyantegenke.
Mbere n’imisore iracika intege ikaruha, abakiri bato baradandabagirana bagatemba,
ariko abizigiye Uhoraho bazokwama bongerwa inkomezi. Bazoguruka mu kirere nk’abagurukisha amababa y’inkona, bazokwiruka ntibaruhe, bazogenda ntibacike intege.
“Nimucereze imbere yanje, mwa mazinga mwe! Amahanga niyongerwe inkomezi! Muyareke aze imbere avuge! Naze duhurire imbere y’intahe.

Ni nde yahagurukije uwo ava mu buseruko, akamuhamagaza ubugororotsi ngo aze ku gikorwa ciwe? Amuhereza amahanga, kandi abami abacishije bugufi imbere yiwe. Bose abahinduje umukungugu inkota yiwe, umuheto wiwe ubagize ibishingwe bigururwa n’umuyaga.
Arabakinagiza, akabacamwo ntagire ico aba, agaca mu nzira ibirenge vyiwe bitigeze bicamwo na rimwe.
Ni nde yabikoze kandi akabishitsa, mu guhamagara urunganwe uhereye mu ntango? Ni jewe Uhoraho , uwa mbere n’uwa nyuma. Ni jewe.”
Amazinga yarabibonye aratinya; impera z’isi zihinda agashitsi. Abo ku mpera z’isi baraza begera hafi,
baterana intege, umwe wese abwira mugenziwe ati: “Komera!”

Uwucura ivyuma atera intege uwucura inzahabu, uwusena akoresheje inyundo agatera intege uwuri kw’ihondero. Bakavuga bati: “Ni igikorwa ciza cane.” Bagaheza bagafatisha imisumari ca kigirwamana kugira ngo ntikinyiganyige.
“Ariko wewe Isirayeli, umusavyi wanje, Yakobo, uwo natoranije, yemwe ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu, umukunzi wanje,
nabazanye ndabakuye ku mpera z’isi, ndabahamagara ndabakuye mu mfuruka zayo za kure. Naravuze nti: ‘Uri umusavyi wanje’; naragutoranije kandi sinagutaye.
Nuko ntutinye kuko ndi kumwe nawe; ntuhagarike umutima, ndi Imana yawe. Nzogukomeza, nzogutabara, nzokuzigamisha ukuboko kwanje kw’i buryo.
Abakurakiye bose bazomaramara, bateterwe, abakugwanya na bo bazohinduka ubusa, ndetse bazohona.
Naho worondera abo bakugwanya, nta bo uzobona. Abagutera ngo bakugwanye bazohinduka ubusa.
Kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, ni jewe ngufashe ukuboko kw’i buryo, nkakubwira nti: Ntutinye, nzogutabara.
Ntutinye, ewe Yakobo, wa musiba we, hanga ritoya rya Isirayeli, ntuhagarike umutima, kuko jewe ubwanje nzogutabara,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Umucunguzi wawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli.
“Ehe raba nzokugira igisekuzo gishasha, gifise amenyo menshi akarishe. Uzosekura imisozi uyisavye, imitumba uyihindure umukungugu.
Uzobagosora umuyaga na wo ubagurure, agashururu kabashwiragize. Ariko uzonezerererwa Uhoraho hamwe n’ubwiza bw’uwera wa Isirayeli.
Abakene n’aboro barondera amazi, ariko nta ho bayaronka; indimi zabo zigatuwe n’inyota. Ariko jewe Uhoraho nzobishura; jewe Imana ya Isirayeli, sinzobaheba.
Nzotembesha inzuzi ku misozi igadutse, ntobore amariba mu biyaya. Ubugaragwa nzobuhindura ibidengeri vy’amazi, isi yumye na yo ndayihindure amasoko y’amazi.
Mu bugaragwa nzotera amasederi n’akasiya, imiriteli na elayo. Nzomeza amapinusi kw’isi yahebwe, meze firu n’akajwari vyose hamwe,
kugira ngo abantu babone ivyo bitangaza, hanyuma batahure, ko ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho ari kwo kwabikoze, ko Uwera wa Isirayeli ari we yabiremye.”
“Nimushinge urubanza rwanyu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimuzane ibirego vyanyu,” ni ko Umwami wa Yakobo avuze.
“Nimutubwire, mwebwe bigirwamana, mutubwire ibizoba. Nimutubwire ibintu vya kera ingene vyari bimeze, natwe tuvyiyumvireko, tumenye n’iherezo ryavyo. Canke nimutubwire ibigira bibe,
tubwire ibiri muri kazoza, kugira ngo noneho tumenye ko muri imana. Gira ico mukoze, caba ciza canke caba kibi, kugira ngo tubitangarire, duhinde agashitsi.
Ariko si vyo, kuko muri hanyuma y’ubusa; n’ibikorwa vyanyu nta co bimaze.
Ariko hari uwo nahagurukije avuye mu buraruko, aje ava mu buseruko, yambaza izina ryanje. Azohonyanga abatware nk’uwuhonyanga ubudongo, canke nk’umubumvyi akata ibumba.

Ni nde yabivuze bikiri mu ntango, kugira ngo tubimenye? Ni nde yabivuze bitaraba, kugira ngo tuvuge tuti: ‘Vya bintu vyari ivy’ukuri’? Nta n’umwe yigeze abivuga, nta n’uwabivuzeko imbere y’igihe, nta n’uwigeze yumva ko ijambo rivuye kuri mwebwe.
Ni jewe nabwiye Siyoni ubwa mbere nti: ‘Ehe ng’abo.’ Kandi ni jewe narungitse i Yerusalemu uwo kuhabwira inkuru nziza.
Nararavye muri mwebwe mbura n’umwe, nta na kimwe mu bigirwamana gishobora gutanga impanuro. Nta na kimwe gishobora kumpa inyishu ndabibajije.
Raba vyose ni ibintu ata co bimaze. N’ibikorwa vyavyo ni ubusa gusa; ishusho yavyo ni umuyaga kandi ni ikiyoberane.
Ng’uwu umukozi wanje, uwo nshigikiye, uwo natoranije nkamunezererwa. Namushizeko Mpwemu wanje, na we azokwereka amahanga ivy’ubutungane.
Ntazoyogora canke ngo avuze urwamo, canke ngo yumvikanishe ijwi ryiwe mu mabarabara.
Ntazohohosha irenga rivunitse, kandi n’urumuri rwaka buhoro ntazoruzimya; mu bwizigirwa, azoshitsa ubutungane mu bantu.
Ntazocika intege kandi ntazodendebukirwa, kugeza aho azoshikiriza ukugororoka kw’isi. Mu nyigisho ziwe ni ho amazinga ya kure azoshira ivyizigiro.”
Ng’ibi ivyo Uhoraho Imana avuze: uwaremye amajuru akayasanza hejuru, uwaguye isi n’ibiyimerako vyose, agaha impwemu abantu bose bayibako, n’ubuzima abayigenderako:
“Jewe Uhoraho ni jewe nabahamagaye ngo mwerekane ubugororotsi bwanje; nzobafata ukuboko. Nzokuzigama, nzotuma ubaho kugira ngo ubere isezerano abantu banje, n’umuco abanyamahanga,
kugira ngo uhumure amaso y’umpumyi, ubohore imbohe, ukure mu mwijima ababohewe mu mabohero.”
“Ndi Uhoraho , iryo ni ryo zina ryanje! Icubahiro canje sinzogiha uwundi, kandi amashimwe yanje sinzoyahebera ibigirwamana.
Ehe raba ivya mbere birashitse, n’ibishasha ndabibamenyesheje; imbere y’uko bija ahabona, ndabibabwiye.”
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, mumuririmbire uhereye ku mpera z’isi! Nimumuririmbire yemwe abagendera mu kiyaga, namwe ibikibamwo mwese, namwe mwa mazinga, n’abayabamwo mwese.
Ubugaragwa n’ibisagara vyabwo nibiduze amajwi yavyo, n’aho Kedari aba hanezerwe. Ababa i Sela nibaririmbe indirimbo y’umunezero, baririmbire ku mpinga z’imisozi!
Nibahe icubahiro Uhoraho , bamutazirire mu mazinga yabo.
Uhoraho azotabara nk’umunyenkomezi, agire ishaka nk’intwari ku rugamba; azokwiha akamo k’intambara n’ijwi rirenga, kandi azonesha abansi biwe.
Azovuga ati: “Kuva kera naracereje, naratekereje, ndiyumanganya. Ariko ubu ho ndataka cane nk’umugore ari ku bise, ndasemerera, ndaniha kandi ndahemagirika.
Nzorandura imisozi n’imitumba, ntume n’ibimera vyaho vyose vyuma. Inzuzi nini nzozihindura ahagadutse zibe nk’amazinga, ibidengeri na vyo ndabikamye.

Impumyi nzozirongora mu nzira zitigeze zimenya, ndazicishe mu tuyira zitari zimenyereye. Mpindure imbere yabo umwijima ucike umuco, kandi nzogorora inzira zabo. Ivyo ni vyo nzokora, kandi sinzobaheba.
Ariko abishimira ibigirwamana, bakabwira ibishushanyo bati: ‘Muri imana zacu,’ bazomaramara cane.
Nimwumve, yemwe bipfamatwi, namwe mwa mpumyi, nimurabe kandi mubone!
Hari iyindi mpumyi atari abantu banje, abasavyi banje, canke hari igipfamatwi kimeze nk’intumwa natumye? Ni nde mpumyi ingana n’abo dufitaniye isezerano, canke impumyi ingana n’umusavyi w’ Uhoraho ?
Mwabonye vyinshi, ariko ntimwabishirako umutima; amatwi yanyu yari yuguruye, ariko nta na kimwe mwumvise.”
Vyarahimbaye Uhoraho kubera ukugororoka kwiwe, ko atanga Ivyagezwe bihambaye kandi bitunganye.

Ariko ubu ni ubwoko bwasahuwe, buranyagwa, bose bafashwe n’imitego yo mu vyobo, banyegejwe mu mabohero. Bajanywe nk’inyagano, habura n’umwe wo kubatabara, baranyazwe, habura n’umwe yovuga ati: “Basubize iwabo.”
Ibi ni nde abitega amatwi, agashira umutima ku vya kazoza?

Ni nde yatanze aba Yakobo ngo batwarwe nk’abaja, aba Isirayeli akabaha ababanyaga? Mbega si Uhoraho , uwo twacumuyeko? Vyababayeko kuko batagendeye mu nzira ziwe, canke ngo bakurikize Ivyagezwe vyiwe.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho abasukako uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi, n’intambara zikomeye. Zibahindukira kuba imbeya, ariko ntibigeze batahura; zirabatongora ariko ntibazishirako n’umutima.
Ariko noneho, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Uwakuremye, ewe Yakobo, akakubumba, yewe Isirayeli, aravuze ati: “Ntutinye kuko nakurokoye; naguhamagaye mw’izina; uri uwanje.
Niwaca mu mazi menshi, nzoba ndi kumwe nawe; niwaca mu nzuzi, ntizizokurengera. Niwaca mu muriro, ntuzosha, imbeya ntizizogutongora.
Kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli, Umukiza wawe. Natanze Egiputa nk’incungu yawe, Etiyopiya na Seba ndahatanga mu gishingo cawe.
Kuko uri uw’agaciro, ukaba umwubahwa mu nyonga zanje; kandi kubera ko nagukunze, nzotanga abantu ku bwawe, n’amahanga ku bw’ubuzima bwawe.
Ntutinye kuko ndi kumwe nawe; nzokoranya abana bawe ndabakuye mu buseruko, ndabegeranye bavuye mu burengero.
Nzobwira uburaruko nti: ‘Barekure!’ Ubumanuko na bwo ndabubwire nti: ‘Ntubafate.’ Nzanira abahungu banje bavuye kure, n’abakobwa banje bavuye ku mpera z’isi;
munzanire uwo wese yitirirwa izina ryanje, uwo naremye mu bwiza bwanje, uwo nibumbiye, nkamurema.”
Sohora abafise amaso ariko batabona, bakagira amatwi ariko ntibumve.

Amahanga yose nakoranywe, n’abantu bose bahurire hamwe. Ni ikihe mu bigirwamana vyabo cari carabivuze, kikatumenyesha ivyabayeho? Nibazane ivyabona vyerekana ko bari mu kuri, kugira ngo abandi nibavyumviriza bavuge bati: “Ni ivy’ukuri.”

“Ni mwebwe vyabona vyanje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, mukaba n’abasavyi banje natoranije, kugira ngo mumenye mwongere munyizere, mwongere mutahure ko ndi Imana. Imbere yanje nta mana yigeze ibaho, kandi inyuma yanje nta yindi izohaba.
Ni jewe Uhoraho jenyene; kandi uretse jewe, nta wundi mukiza ariho.
Ni jewe nabahishuriye ivy’agakiza, ndabakiza ndongera ndabitangaza, ni jewe, si imana z’inyamahanga ziri muri mwebwe. Ni mwebwe vyabona vyanje ko ndi Imana,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Uhereye ibihe vyose, ndi Imana. Nta wushobora kunkura mu kuboko ico mfashe. Ngize ico nkoze, ni nde yogihindura?”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Umucunguzi wanyu, Uwera wa Isirayeli: “Ku bwanyu nzotuma intumwa i Babiloni, Abanyababiloni bose ndabamanure ari impunzi, bahunge bakoresheje arya mato bishimira.
Ni jewe Uhoraho , Uwera wanyu, umuremyi wa Isirayeli, Umwami wanyu.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, we yaciye inzira mu kiyaga, agaca inzira mu mazi menshi,
agasohora imikogote n’amafarasi, ingabo n’abagwanyi b’abahizi bagakorana, maze bakagwa hamwe, ntibongere kuvyuka, bakazima nk’uko urumuri ruzima:
“Nimwibagire ivyabaye, ntimwumire kuri kahise.
Ehe ngiye gukora ikintu gishasha! Raba kimaze no kugaragara; mbega nta co mubona? Ngiye guca inzira mu bugaragwa, ntembeshe inzuzi ahagadutse.
Ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba biranyubaha, imbwebwe n’ibihuna, bizonyubaha, kuko nzobiha amazi mu bugaragwa, kugira ngo mpe abantu banje ico banywa, abo natoranije,
abantu niremeye ubwanje, kugira ngo bavuge ishimwe ryanje.
Ariko ntiwigeze umpamagara, yewe Yakobo, ahubwo waranzinutswe, wewe Isirayeli!
Ntiwanshikaniye intama zawe nk’amashikanwa yo guturira, canke ngo unyubahishe ibimazi vyawe. Sinakuremereje kunzanira amashikanwa y’ifu, canke ngo nkurambire nkwaka ibimota neza iyo bituriwe.
Nta bimota neza wigeze unzanira, canke ngo umpaze ibinure vy’ibimazi vyawe. Ariko wewe wandemereje ivyaha vyawe, umvunisha ibicumuro vyawe.
Ariko jewe nyene, ni jewe mpanagura ibicumuro vyawe, ku bw’izina ryanje, kandi sinzosubira kuvyibuka.
Nyibutsa ivya kera, maze tuburane. Shinga urubanza rwawe maze wiregure.
Umuvyeyi wawe wa mbere yakoze icaha, abarongozi bawe na bo barangararije.
Ni co gituma nanje nzotuma abaherezi bawe bakengerwa, Yakobo nkamurekurirako ukurandurwa, Isirayeli nkamuhindura ikimaramare.
Ariko noneho niwumve yewe Yakobo umusavyi wanje, Isirayeli, uwo natoranije.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uwakuremye, akakuremera mu nda, akaba ari we azonagutabara, ntutinye, yewe Yakobo, umukozi wanje, Yeshuruni, uwo natoranije.
Kuko nzosuka amazi kw’isi igadutse, ntembeshe imigende kw’isi yumye. Nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku ruvyaro rwawe, n’umugisha ku bagukomokako.
Bazokura nk’ubwatsi buvomererwa, nk’ibiti vy’imilebeni biri i ruhande y’umugezi.
Umwe azovuga ati: ‘Jewe ndi uw’ Uhoraho ’; uwundi na we azokwiyitirira izina rya Yakobo; uwundi na we azokwandika mu kiganza ciwe ati: ‘Ndi uw’ Uhoraho ’; hanyuma yiyitirire izina rya Isirayeli.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Umwami n’Umucunguzi wa Isirayeli, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose: Ndi uwa mbere nkaba n’uwa nyuma; nta yindi Mana ibaho atari jewe.
Ni nde wundi ahwanye nanje? Naze abimenyeshe. Naze abivuge abishire imbere yanje, ambwire ivyabaye kuva nkirema abantu banje ba kera, avuge n’ibizoza. Ni koko naze avuge ibizoba.
Ntimujugumire, ntimugire ubwoba. Sinari nabibabwiye, nkabibamenyesha kera bitaraba? Muri ivyabona vyanje. Nta yindi Mana ihari atari jewe? Haba na mba, nta rundi Rutare; nta rundi nzi.”
Abakora ibishushanyo bose nta co bamaze, n’ivyo baha agaciro vyose nta co bimaze. Ababivugira bose ni impumyi; ni imburabwenge, bazoteterwa.
Ababaza ibishushanyo canke bakabumba ibigirwamana, bazobikuramwo iki?
Ababikora n’ababifatanya na bo bazomaramara; ababikora ni abantu buntu. Bose nibakoranire hamwe, bahagarare; bazokwicwa n’ubwoba, isoni zibicire hamwe.
Umucuzi afata ico acurisha akagishusha mu makara, agahingura ikigirwamana akoresheje inyundo, akagiha imero n’inkomezi z’amaboko yiwe. Agasonza agaca acika intege, atanyoye amazi akaraba.

Umubaji w’ibishushanyo apimisha umugozi, agashira ibimenyetso ku gishushanyo n’ikaramu; akibazisha imbazo, akagipima cose n’icuma gipima. Akagishushanyamwo ishusho y’umuntu, mu bwiza bwiwe bwose, maze akagishira mu kanyabugoro.
Yicira isederi, canke agahitamwo ikindi giti. Arakireka kigakurira hagati y’ibindi biti vyo mw’ishamba, canke agatera pinusi, hanyuma imvura ikakimeza,
mu nyuma kikazoba inkwi zo gucana, umuntu akagikurako inkwi zo kwota, canke izo gucumba umutsima. Ariko agikoramwo n’igishushanyo akagisenga, akagikoramwo ikigirwamana akacikubita imbere.
Igice kimwe caco agicanisha umuriro; akagitekesha ivyokurya, akacotsako inyama, akarya agahaga. Arongera akota, hanyuma akavuga ati: “Ahwi! Ndasusurutse, ndonse umucanwa.”
Igisigaye akagikoramwo imana, ikigirwamana ciwe; akacunamira, akagisenga. Akagisenga akibwira ati: “Ndokora; ni wewe mana yanje.”
Nta co bazi, nta co batahura; amaso yabo aratwikiriwe kugira ngo ntabone, ubwenge bwabo buracuramye kugira ngo ntibutahure.

Nta n’umwe yiyumvira, nta n’uwutahura ngo avuge ati: “Igice kimwe nagicanye, nacumbiye ku makara yaco, nongera notsa inyama ndazirya. Mbega none igice gisigaye nogikoramwo imana? Mbega nokwunamira ikigegene c’igiti?”
Uwo muntu arya umunyota, ayobejwe n’umutima wibesha. Ntashobora kwikiza, canke ngo avuge ati: “Mbega burya iki mfise mu ntoke si ikinyoma?”
“Niwibuke ivyo bintu, yewe Yakobo, uvyibuke nawe Isirayeli umusavyi wanje. Ni jewe nakuremye, uri umusavyi wanje; yewe Isirayeli, sinzokwibagira.
Neyuye ivyaha vyawe nk’uko igicu ceyuka, ivyaha vyawe ndabikuraho nk’igipfungu co mu gatondo. Nimungarukeko, kuko ni jewe nabacunguye.”

Ririmbana umunezero mwa majuru mwe, kuko Uhoraho ari we yakoze ibi; Semerera wa kuzimu we. Nimuturagare muririmbe mwa mitumba mwe, namwe mashamba hamwe n’ibiti vyose biri muri mwebwe, kuko Uhoraho yarokoye Yakobo, akerekanira icubahiro ciwe muri Isirayeli.
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Umucunguzi wawe, uwakubumbiye mu nda: Ni jewe Uhoraho , uwaremye ibintu vyose, uwabamvye ijuru wenyene, akagaranzura isi wenyene.
Ni jewe mpinyuza ibimenyetso vy’abavugishwa b’ibinyoma, abapfumu nkabahindura ubusa, nsubiza inyuma abanyabwenge, ubwenge bwabo nkabuhindura ubupfu.

Ni jewe nshitsa amajambo y’abasavyi banje, n’ivy’intumwa zanje zavugishijwe. I Yerusalemu ndahavugako nti: ‘Hazosubira kuba abantu,’ ibisagara vy’i Buyuda na vyo nti: ‘Bizosubira kwubakwa,’ imisaka yaho nkayivugaka nti: ‘Nzohasanura.’
Mbwira ibiyaga binini nti: ‘Kama, kandi n’inzuzi zawe nzozikamya.’
Ndavuga kuri Kuro nti: ‘Ni umusavyi wanje, azoshitsa ivyo nshaka vyose; azotegeka ati: “Yerusalemu nihubakwe,” avuge ati: “Amatanguriro y’Ingoro nashirweho.” ’

Uku ni ko Uhoraho abwiye uwo yitoranirije, Kuro, uwo afashe ukuboko kw’i buryo kugira ngo aneshe amahanga ari imbere yiwe, ateko anyage abami ibigwanisho vyabo; uwo yugururiye imiryango, n’amarembo ntasubire kwugarwa:
Nzokuja imbere, ndinganize imitumba; menagure inzugi z’imyakaka, ncagagure n’ivyugazo vy’ivyuma.
Nzoguha ubutunzi buri mu mwijima, hamwe n’ubuhishijwe ahinyegeje, kugira ngo umenye ko ndi Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, uwaguhamagaye mw’izina.
Ku bw’umusavyi wanje Yakobo, na Isirayeli uwo natoranije, naguhamagaye mw’izina, ndaguha izina ry’icubahiro, naho kugeza ubu utanzi.
Ni jewe Uhoraho , nta wundi; nta yindi Mana ihari atari jewe. Nzogukomeza naho utaramenya,
kugira ngo kuva iyo izuba riserukira kugeza n’iyo rirengera, abantu bose bamenye ko ata yindi Mana atari jewe. Ni jewe Uhoraho , nta wundi ariho atari jewe.
Ni jewe ndema umuco n’umwijima, nkazana amahoro n’ivyago; ni jewe Uhoraho nkora ivyo vyose.
Mwa majuru mwe, cuncubura imvura y’ukugororoka kwanje, ibicu nibiyirekure ishike hasi. Isi na yo niyuguruke agakiza gatutuze, ukugororoka kuyimereko; ni jewe Uhoraho naremye ivyo.

Bazobona ibara abaharira bagatongana n’Umuremyi, kandi ari injo gusa mu zindi njo zo kw’isi. Mbega ibumba ryobaza umubumvyi riti: ‘Ugomba kubumba iki?’ Canke icabumbwe covuga kiti: ‘Umubumvyi nta maboko agira?’
Azobona ibara uwubaza se ati: ‘Ni igiki wavyaye?’ canke akabaza nyina ati: ‘Ni igiki wibarutse?’
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Uwera wa Isirayeli akaba n’Umuremyi wawe: Ku bijanye n’ibizoba hanyuma, mbega murambaza ivyerekeye abana banje, canke murampa amategeko ku bikorwa vy’amaboko yanje?
Ni jewe naremye isi, ndema n’abantu bo kuyibako. Amaboko yanje ni yo yabamvye ijuru, kandi ni jewe ntegeka ingabo z’inyenyeri.

Nzohagurutsa Kuro mu kugororoka kwanje: nzogorora inzira ziwe. Azonsanurira igisagara, arekure abantu banje banyazwe bidegemvye. Ivyo ntazobikora ngo ahabwe impera canke agashimwe, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ivyimburwa vyo muri Egiputa n’ibidandazwa vyo muri Etiyopiya, hamwe n’abagabo barebare b’Abasabeya, bazoza iwawe; kandi bazoba abawe, bazogendera inyuma yawe, bagukurikira baboshwe n’iminyororo. Bazokwikubita imbere yawe, bagutakambire bavuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe, ni we Mana wenyene, nta yindi mana iriho.’ ”
Ni ukuri, uri Imana yamye yihisha, Imana, mukiza wa Isirayeli.
Abakora ibigirwamana bose bazokwicwa n’isoni, bazomaramarira hamwe.
Ariko Isirayeli azorokorwa n’ Uhoraho , amuhe agakiza katazovaho; ntazosubira kumaramara canke ngo ateterwe, gushika ibihe bitazoshira.

Kuko uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uwaremye isi n’ijuru, akaba ari we Mana; ni we yaremye isi arayibumba, arayikomeza, ntiyayiremeye kuba iyigaragara, ahubwo ni ukugira ngo abantu bayibeko; uwo ni we avuze ati: “Ndi Uhoraho , atari jewe nta wundi.
Sinavugiye mw’ibanga, nihishije mw’isi y’umwijima; sinabwiye uruvyaro rwa Yakobo nti: ‘Nimundondere ariko ntimuzombona.’ Jewe Uhoraho mvuga ukuri; nabamenyesheje ibigororotse.
Nimukorane mwese muze, egerana, yemwe abacitse kw’icumu bo mu mahanga. Ibipfu, ni abarerura ibigirwamana bibajwe mu biti, bagasenga imana zidashobora kubakiza.

Nimuvyamamaze mubishikirize, nimwegerane mugire inama. Ni nde yamenyekanishije ivyo kuva kera, akabivuga muri kahise ka kera? Mbega si jewe Uhoraho ? Kandi nta yindi Mana iriho atari jewe, Imana igororotse kandi ikiza; nta yindi atari jewe.
Nimungarukeko ndabakize, yemwe mpera z’isi, kuko ari jewe Mana, kandi akaba ata yindi mana ibaho.
Indahiro ni jewe nyene, akanwa kanje kabivuganye ubwizigirwa bwose, kavuga ijambo ritazovaho. Amavi yose azompfukamira, kandi indimi zose zizorahira izina ryanje.
Abantu bazokwatura bati: ‘Ni k’ Uhoraho wenyene turonka gutabarwa n’inkomezi.’ ” Abari bamufitiye uburake bose, bazomwegera maze bamaramare.
Ariko abakomoka kuri Isirayeli bose bazoronka ugutabarwa k’ Uhoraho kandi bazokwirata kuba muri we.
Beli harapfukamye; Nebo harubamye hasi, ibigirwamana vyaho bihekwa n’ibikoko. Ibigirwamana vyahindutse umutwaro uremereye, umutwaro uvuna ibikoko biremerewe.
Ivyo bigirwamana birunama bikunamira hamwe, uretse ko izo mana zidashobora kwikingira, ahubwo zijanywe nk’iminyago.
Nimunyumve yemwe abakomoka kuri Yakobo, namwe masigarira y’abantu ba Isirayeli, abo nahetse kuva mukivuka, nkabaterura kuva mukiva mu nda.
Mbere no gushika mu myaka yanyu y’ubusaza mukamera imvi, nguma ndi wa wundi, kandi nzoguma ndabashigikiye. Ni jewe nabaremye, no kubaterura nzobaterura, nzobashigikira kandi nzobarokora.
Mbega mwongereranya na nde canke uwo mwovuga ko tungana ni nde? Ni nde mwibaza ko dusa ku buryo mwotugereranya?
Bamwe bakura inzahabu mu masaho yabo, abandi bagapima ifeza zabo ku minzane; bagaca bahamagara umucuzi w’inzahabu agacuramwo imana, hanyuma bakayunamira bongera bayisenga.
Bakayiterura bakayishira ku bitugu, bakayijana, bakayihagarika mu kibanza bayiteguriye, ikaguma aho nyene. Aho bayiteretse ntihava. Naho umuntu yosemerera gute, ntiyitaba, ntimukiza amagorwa.
Nimwibuke ivyo, mubigumize mu mitwe, nimubishireko umutima mwa bagarariji mwe.
Nimwibuke ibintu vya mbere; ivyabaye hakaba haciye igihe kirekire; ndi Imana, kandi nta yindi iriho. Ni jewe Mana, kandi nta yindi ingana nanje.
Ibintu bikiri mu ntango menyesha iherezo ryavyo, mpereye mu bihe vya kera, menyesha ibizoba. Nkavuga nti: imigambi yanje izokomera, kandi nzokora ico nzoshaka cose.
Nzohamagara igisiga c’amerwe co mu buseruko; ari we mugabo azoza gushitsa imigambi yanje; ivyo navuze ko nzoshitsa, n’ivyo nateguye ko nzokora.
Nimunyumve yemwe abafise imitima ikomantaye, yemwe abagerereye kure y’ukugororoka kwanje.
Negereje hafi ukugororoka kwanje, ntikuri kure na gatoya; kandi agakiza kanje ntikazoteba kuza. Nzoha agakiza Siyoni, Isirayeli ndayihe ubwiza bwanje.
Manuka wicare mu mukungungu, yewe mukobwa w’i Babiloni, icara hasi, uve ku ntebe y’ubwami, wa gisagara we; mwamikazi w’Abakaludaya. Ntuzosubira kwitwa ko uteye igomwe canke ko uhimbaye.
Fata ingasiro usye uronke ifu; twikurura mu maso hawe. Duza ikanzu yawe, amaguru aboneke, kugira ngo ushobore kujabuka inzuzi.
Ubwambure bwawe buzoja ahabona, maze umaramare. Nzokwihora, kandi nta n’umwe nzosigaza.
Umucunguzi wacu, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe, ni we Uwera wa Isirayeli.
“Icara ucereze, uje mu mwijima, wa gisagara we, mwamikazi w’Abakaludaya; kuko utazongera kwitwa umwamikazi w’ubwami.
Narakiye abantu banje, nsuzugura iragi ryanje; ndabarekurira mu maboko yawe, nawe ntiwabagirira n’imbabazi. N’abasaza bo muri bo, wabaremeka imitwaro iremereye.
Waravuga uti: ‘Nzokwama nganza, nzoba umwamikazi ibihe vyose!’ Ariko ntiwigeze wiyumvira kuri vyo, ntiwigeze wibaza ku bizoba.

None rero niwumve ibi, yewe muntu ukunda kwinezereza, ukiyumvira ko uri ahantu hatekanye, ukibwira uti: ‘Ni jewe gusa, impande yanje nta wundi. Sinzokwigera mba umupfakazi, canke ngo mbure abana banje.’
Ivyo vyompi bizogushikira mu kanya gato, ndetse ku musi umwe: kubura abana no gupfakara. N’aho wujuje abapfumu n’abanyamareba, ivyo bizogushikako, bifise ububi bwavyo bwose.
Wishimikije ububisha bwawe, wibwira uti: ‘Nta wumbona.’ Ubwenge bwawe n’ubumenyi bwawe vyarakuyobeje, aho wibwira uti: ‘Ndikwije, nta wundi nkeneye.’
Ivyago bizokuzako, kandi ntuzomenya ingene uvyigobotoramwo. Amakuba azokugwako, kandi nta mpongano uzoronka ubitangira; ivyago bizogushikira giturumbuka, utanavyiteze.
Nuko rero komeza ayo mareba yawe, wirundanirize abapfumu, ivyo watanguye ukiri umwana muto. Kumbure bizogira ico bikumarira, hagire abo utera ubwoba.
Inama zose bakugiriye zarakuruhije. Hamagara abapfumu bawe baragurisha ivy’inyenyeri baze, abazi kuraba inyenyeri bakubwira ibizoba ukwezi ku kwezi, baze bagukize ibigiye kugushikira.
Ariko bazomera nk’umuguruka; umuriro uzobarigita. Ntibazoshobora kwikiza ububasha bw’imbeya z’umuriro. Uwo muriro ntuzoba ari amakara yo kwota, canke icotezo co kwicara i ruhande.
Uko ni ko abo waruhiye kuva kera bazokubera, n’abo mwadandazanya mugakorana uhereye mu buto bwawe: bose babandanya kugendera mu makosa yabo, nta n’umwe muri bo ashobora kugukiza.

Umviriza, mwebwe abakomoka ku nzu ya Yakobo, mwebwe mwitirirwa izina rya Isirayeli, mukava mu muryango wa Yuda, mwebwe murahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , mukambaza Imana ya Isirayeli, ariko ntimubikore mu kuri mu bugororotsi,
mwiyita abo mu gisagara cera, mukavuga ko mwisunga Imana ya Isirayeli, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Ivyabayeho kera, nabivuze imbere y’igihe, akanwa kanje karabitangaza, ndabimenyekanisha, ndabikora ako kanya, birashika.
Nari nzi ko udakurwa kw’ijambo; izosi ryawe rikomeye nk’icuma, uruhanga rwawe na rwo rukomeye nk’umwakaka.

Ni co gituma nababwiye ivyo bintu kuva kera cane, ndabibatangariza bitaraba, kugira ngo ntimuzovuge muti: ‘Ibigirwamana vyanje ni vyo vyabikoze; ibishushanyo nabaje mu biti hamwe n’imana nacuze, ni vyo vyabitegetse biraba.’
Ivyo mwaravyumvise, nimuvyihweze vyose. Mbega ntimuvyemera? Uhereye ubu ngira ndababwire ibintu bishasha, canke ibihishijwe mutigeze mumenya.
Biremwe ubu nyene, si ivya kera; ntimwigeze muvyumva imbere y’uwu musi. Kugira ngo ntimuvuge ngo: ‘Ni vyo, nabimenye kuva kera!’
Nta vyo mwigeze mwumva kandi nta vyo mwigeze mutahura; kuko uhereye kera amatwi yanyu atari bwazibuke. Nari nzi neza ingene muri abanyabinyoma, mwiswe abagarariji kuva mukivuka.
Ku bw’izina ryanje narabangiriye kubasukako uburake bwanje, kandi ku bw’ishimwe ryanje narabihanganiye, ndeka kubakuraho rwose.
Ehe raba, narakuvugutiye, naho atari kurya kw’ifeza, nagupimiye mw’itanure ry’ukugeragezwa.
Ku bw’izina ryanje, kandi ku bw’izina ryanje nyene, ndabikoze. Mbega nokwemera gucokorwa? Icubahiro canje sinzogiha uwundi muntu n’umwe.
Nyumviriza, ewe Yakobo, nawe Isirayeli, uwo nahamagaye: ndi we; ndi uwa mbere nkaba n’uwa nyuma.
Amaboko yanje ni yo yashizeho amatanguriro y’isi kandi ukuboko kwanje kw’i buryo ni kwo kwagaranzuye ijuru; iyo ndabihamagaye, biritaba, bikazira icarimwe.
Mwese nimutororokane mwumve, mbega hari ikigirwamana cigeze kibabwira ibi bitaraba? Uwo Uhoraho yihitiyemwo ngo azoshitsa umugambi wiwe kuri Babiloni; ukuboko kwiwe kuzogwanya Abanyababiloni.
Jewe, jewe nyene ubwanje naravuze, ni vyo, naramuhamagaye. Kandi nzomuzana, azoshitsa neza igikorwa namutumye.
Nimunyegere mwumve! Kuva ku vyo natanguriyeko kuvuga, nta na rimwe nigeze mvuga nyegeje, kandi igihe vyaba vyose, nari ngaha.” None ehe raba Uhoraho Nyeninganji yantumye, andungikanye Mpwemu wiwe.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, umucunguzi wanyu, Uwera wa Isirayeli: “Ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, akwigisha ibibereye, akakurongorera mu nzira ukwiye gucamwo.
Iyo wumvira amabwirizwa yanje, amahoro yawe yotemvye nk’uruzi, n’ukugororoka kwawe kwonganye n’imipfunda y’ikiyaga.
Uruvyaro rwawe rwonganye n’umusenyi, abana bawe bakangana n’amahonda mu kigega; izina ryabo ntiryokwibagiranywe, kandi ntiryozimanganye imbere yanje.”
Nimusohoke muve i Babiloni, muhunge Abakaludaya. Nimusemerere mubivugane umunezero, mubimenyekanishe hose, muvyamamaze gushika ku mpera z’isi, muvuga muti: “ Uhoraho yacunguye, Yakobo umusavyi wiwe.”
Igihe yabarongorera mu bugaragwa ntibishwe n’inyota, yabatembeshereje amazi ava mu gitandara. Yasatuye ikibuye, amazi aradudubiza.
“Ariko nta mahoro ku munyavyaha,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimunyumvirize yemwe ababa mu mazinga, mwumve ibi yemwe ababa mu mahanga ya kure. Ntarabaho, Uhoraho yari yarampamagaye; yampaye izina nkiri mu nda ya mama.
Akanwa kanje yakagize nk’inkota ikarishe, ampisha mu gitutu c’ukuboko kwiwe. Yangize nk’umwampi usongoye, anzigamira mu mutana wiwe.
Yarambwiye ati: “Uri umusavyi wanje, Isirayeli, ni ho nzokwerekanira ubwiza bwanje butangaje.”
Ariko ndavuga nti: “Nakoreye ubusa, inkomezi zanje zapfuye ubusa. Ariko ico ntegerezwa kuronka, kiri mu kuboko kw’ Uhoraho , kandi impera yanje ifiswe n’Imana yanje.”

None rero Uhoraho aravuze, uwambumbiye mu nda ya mama, kugira ngo nzomubere umukozi, ngo nzomugarukanire Yakobo, nongere ndamwegeranirizeko Abisirayeli; natewe iteka mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kandi Imana yanje yambereye inkomezi;
avuga ati: “Ni ikintu gitoya cane kuba uri umukozi wanje, ukanagura imiryango ya Yakobo, ukagarukana Abisirayeli, umuco ku Banyamahanga, kugira ngo uzoshikane agakiza ku mpera z’isi.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Umucunguzi, akaba n’Uwera wa Isirayeli, abwira uwo abantu basuzugura, akankwa n’amahanga, akaba umuja w’abatware, ati: “Abami bazokubona bahaguruke, abaganwa na bo bakubone bakwunamire, kuko Uhoraho , Uwera wa Isirayeli ari umwizigirwa, akaba ari we yagutoranije.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Igihe canje co kugira neza, nzokwishura, kandi no ku musi wo gukirizwako, nzogutabara. Nzokuzigama ndakugire uko ngomba, ube isezerano hagati yanje n’abantu, usubize igihugu uko cahora, ugisubize beneco,
ubwire abari mu mabohero uti: ‘Sohoka,’ n’abari mu mwijima uti: ‘Nimuje ahabona!’ Bazoba intama zanje zirisha ahatotahaye, zironka ubwatsi ku misozi itahora imera.
Ntibazokwongera gusonza canke ngo banyoterwe, kandi ntibazokwicwa n’ubushuhe canke izuba ryo mu bugaragwa. Kuko uwubagiriye impuhwe azobaja imbere, abajane ku masoko y’amazi.
Imitumba yanje yose nzoyihindura amabarabara, kandi amabarabara yose azokwagurwa.
Ehe raba bazoza bavuye kure, bamwe bazova mu buraruko, abandi bave mu burengero, abandi bazanana mu bumanuko, ari ho muri Egiputa.”
Nimuririmbe mwa majuru mwe, unezerwe nawe wa si we; muturagare muririmbe yemwe mitumba! Kuko Uhoraho aremesheje abantu biwe, akagirira impuhwe abari mu mibabaro.
Ariko Siyoni aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho yarantaye, Uhoraho yaranyibagiye.”
Mbega umuvyeyi yokwibagira umwana yonsa, akareka kugirira impuhwe uwo yavyaye? Naho we yomwibagira, jewe sinzokwibagira.
Ehe raba nakwanditse mu biganza vyanje, kandi inzitiro zawe ndazihozako amaso.
Abana bawe bazogaruka vuba, maze abagusambuye bazokuvako bagende.
Unamura amaso yawe urabe: abana bawe barakoranye, baje aho uri. Uhoraho aravuze ati: “Ndarahiye ukubaho kwanje, uzobambara bose nk’ibisharizo, kurya kw’ibisharizo vy’umugeni.
N’aho wageshejwe, ugasigara uri akahebwe mbere igihugu cawe kigasigara ari amatongo yahebwe, abawe bazokwagirwa vyanke ko bagukwirwamwo, abagutabagura na bo baje kure yawe.
Abana bavukiye mu kinyago bazogaruka, bavuge wumva, bati: ‘Iki gihugu ntikidukwiye, ntitugira aho twubaka.’

Nawe uzokwibaza mu mutima uti: ‘Aba ni nde yabamvyariye? Ko nari naranyazwe abanje, ata vyizigiro vyo kuronka abandi, ndi inyagano, ndi igicibwa? None abo ni nde yabareze? Ko nari jenyene, abo bo bari he?’ ”
Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: “Ehe nzokwakura abanyamahanga, nshingire ibendera amoko; bazozana abahungu bawe babateruye mu maboko yabo, abakobwa bawe babazane ku bitugu vyabo.
Abami bazokubera abarezi, abamikazi na bo bakwonkereze. Bazokwikubita imbere bubamye hasi, baguhanagure umukungugu wo ku birenge. Nawe uzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , kandi ko abanyiteze batazomaramara.”
Mbega hari uwaka umugwanyi ivyo yanyaze, canke abo yafashe nk’inyagano hari uwobatabara?
Ariko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Ni vyo, inyagano zizokurwa mu maboko y’abahizi mu ntambara, kandi abateye ubwoba bazonyagwa ivyabo. Nzogwanya abakugwanya, kandi abana bawe nzobarokora.

Abagutwaza umukazo nzobarisha inyama zabo ubwabo, ndabanyweshe amaraso yabo ubwabo nk’uwunywa umuvinyu. Maze abantu bose bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho kandi ko ndi Umukiza wanyu, Umucunguzi wanyu, Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho abaza: ati: “Mbega ikete ryo kwahukana na nyoko, riri hehe iryo namuhaye ndamwirukanye? Canke uwo mfitiye umwenda ni nde nkaba naramubagurishijeko? Kubera ivyaha vyanyu mwaragurishijwe, kandi ibigabitanyo vyanyu ni vyo vyatumye nyoko yirukanwa!

Igihe naza, ni kubera iki ata n’umwe nahasanze? Kandi igihe nahamagara ni kubera iki ata n’umwe yanyitavye? Mbega ukuboko kwanje kwabaye kugufi, kunanirwa kubatabara? Mbega singira inkomezi zo kubacungura? Nkankamiye ikiyaga kiragaduka, ahatemba inzuzi ndahahindura ubugaragwa; amafi yaho akabora, kubera kubura amazi; akicwa n’inyota.
Ijuru ndaryambika umwijima, nkaripfuka amagunira.”
Uhoraho Nyeninganji yampaye amajambo yiwe y’ubwenge, kugira ngo nshobore kuremesha abadendebukiwe. Yama anzindura imisi yose mu gitondo, amatwi yanje akayakangurira kwumviriza nk’umwigishwa.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyuguruye amatwi, kandi sinamugararije, canke ngo nsubire inyuma.
Nategeye umugongo abankubita, abanshikura ubwanwa sinabima imisaya. Abamvuma n’abancokora sinabanyegeje mu maso hanje.
Kubera yuko Uhoraho Nyeninganji amfasha, sinzoteterwa. Ni co gituma mu maso hanje hakomera hakamera nk’ibuye ry’isare, kandi ndazi ko ntazomaramara.
Uwuncira urubanza rw’ukuri ari hafi. None ni nde azonyagiriza icaha? Naze duhangane! Ni nde afise ico anyagiriza? Nashike imbere yanje duhangane.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji ni we amfasha. Ni nde azoncira urubanza akavuga ko ntsinzwe? Bose bazosaza nk’impuzu; inyo zizobarya zibamare.
Ni nde muri mwebwe yubaha Uhoraho , akumvira ijambo ry’umukozi wiwe? Uwugendera mu mwijima, atagira umuco, niyizigire izina ry’ Uhoraho , kandi yishimikize Imana yiwe.
Yemwe abacana ibimuri mwese, mukironderera umuco wo kubamurikira, nimugendere mu muco w’umuriro wanyu, no mu bimuri mwadometse. Ivyo muzoronka mu kuboko kwanje ni ibi: muzoryamana umubabaro.
“Nimuntege amatwi, yemwe abakurikirana ukugororoka, namwe abarondera Uhoraho : Nimwitegereze igitandara mwasatuweko, n’icobo mwimbwemwo.
Nimurabe sogokuruza Aburahamu, na Sara yabavyaye. Igihe namuhamagara yari wenyene, hanyuma ndamuhezagira, ndamugwiza.

Uhoraho nta gukeka azohumuriza Siyoni, kandi azorabana impuhwe imisaka yaho; ubugaragwa bwaho azobugira nka Edeni, n’isi itamera yaho azoyigira nk’itongo ry’ Uhoraho . I Siyoni hazorangwa umunezero n’agahimbare, amashimwe n’amajwi y’indirimbo.
Nimunyumve yemwe bantu banje, ntega ugutwi wa hanga ryanje we: Icagezwe kizova muri jewe, kandi uguca iziroranye kwanje kuzobera amahanga umuco.
Ubugororotsi bwanje buriko buraza bwihuta, agakiza kanje kari mu nzira kaza, kandi ukuboko kwanje kuzozanira amahanga ubutungane. Amazinga azonyitegana igishika, andindire yizigiye ukuboko kwanje.

Nimwunamure amaso yanyu murabe amajuru, murabe no kw’isi; amajuru azokamangana nk’umwotsi, isi na yo ihere nk’impuzu, abayibako na bo bazopfa nk’imibu. Ariko agakiza kanje kazokwamaho ibihe vyose, kandi ubugororotsi bwanje ntibuzogira iherezo.
Nimunyumve yemwe abazi ivy’ukugororoka, namwe mwashize imitima yanyu ku nyigisho zanje: Ntimutinye ivyo abantu bapfa babagiriza, canke ngo murandurwe imitima n’ivyo babatuka.

Kuko imiswa izobarya ibamare nk’uko imara impuzu, n’inyo zizobarya nk’uko zirya ubwoya. Ariko ukugororoka kwanje kuzokwamaho ibihe vyose, kandi agakiza kanje kazokwamaho uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.”
Kanguka, kanguka wa kuboko kw’ Uhoraho , wambare inkomezi! Kanguka nko mu misi yaheze, nko mu runganwe rw’aba kera. Mbega si wewe waciye ubunywenywe Rahabu, ugasogota ca gisizimwe?
Mbega si wewe wakamije ikiyaga, n’amazi yo mw’ibenga rinini, ugaca inzira i bwina mu kiyaga, kugira ngo abo wicunguriye bashobore kujabuka?

Abacunguwe n’ Uhoraho bazogaruka; bazokwinjira i Siyoni baririmba, umunezero udashira ni wo uzoba urugori ku mitwe yabo. Akamwemwe n’umunezero bizobuzura, kandi umubabaro no gusuhuza umutima bizohunga.
“Jewe ubwanje ni jewe ndabahumuriza, none uri nde, wewe utinya umuntu apfa, utinya umwana w’umuntu ameze nk’ubwatsi,

ukibagira Uhoraho Umuremyi wawe, uwagaranzuye amajuru, agashiraho amatanguriro y’isi, ku buryo umusi ku wundi ubayeho uri mu bwoba, utinya uburake bw’uwugucinyiza, kandi agerewe kuranduka? Mbega none uburake bw’uwucinyiza buri hehe?
Abo wagize imbohe bagiye kubohorwa; ntibazogwa mu vyobo barimwo, kandi ntibazokwicwa n’inzara.
Kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, ntera ikiyaga gusuriranya, imipfunda ikabomborana Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ni ryo zina ryanje.
Nashize amajambo yanje mu kanwa kawe, ngutwikiriza igitutu c’ukuboko kwanje, jewe nashize amajuru mu kibanza cayo, nshiraho amatanguriro y’isi, nkabwira Siyoni nti: ‘Muri abantu banje.’ ”

Kanguka, kanguka! Haguruka, yewe Yerusalemu, wewe wanywereye ku gikombe kiri mu kuboko kw’ Uhoraho , igikombe c’uburake bwiwe, ukaciranguza gushika kw’ima rya nyuma, ca gikombe gituma abantu bazungurirwa.
Mu bana yavyaye bose, nta wurimwo wo kumuja imbere ngo amurongore mu bana yareze bose, nta wurimwo wo kumufata ukuboko.
Ibi vyago bigwijwe kabiri bije kuri wewe; mbega ni nde azokuremesha? Gusamburwa no kurandurwa, inzara n’inkota. Ni nde azoguhoza?
Abana bawe bararabiranye, barambaraye mu mahwane yose y’inzira, bameze nk’impongo yafashwe n’umutego. Buzuweko n’uburake bw’ Uhoraho , ari kwo guhana kw’Imana yawe.
Kubera ivyo, nimwumve ibi, mwebwe mubabaye, mwebwe muborewe ariko mutaborewe umuvinyu.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji, Imana yanyu igwanira abantu bayo, avuze: “Ehe raba, nkuye mu kuboko kwawe igikombe catuma udandabagirana; ico gikombe ni co burake bwanje, ntuzosubira kukinywerako.
Nzogishira mu biganza vy’ababacinyiza, bamwe bavuga bati: ‘Rambarara hasi tuguceko.’ Maze umugongo wawe ukawugira nk’imbuga, canke nk’inzira yo gucako.”
Ikangure, ikangure, yewe Siyoni, wambare inkomezi. Niwambare imyambaro yawe y’ubwiza, Yerusalemu, umugwa wera. Kuko ata batakebwe canke abahumanye bazosubira kukwinjiramwo.
Ikunkumure umukungugu; uhaguruke, wicare ku ntebe y’ubwami, ewe Yerusalemu. Iyambure iminyororo mw’izosi, yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni, wagizwe imbohe.
Kuko uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Mwaguzwe ubusa, muzocungurwa ata mahera atanzwe.”
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Ubwa mbere, abantu banje babanje kumanukanwa muri Egiputa, mu nyuma bacinyizwa na Ashuri.

None ibi na vyo ni ibiki? Ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Ko abantu banje basubiriye kujanwa nk’inyagano ata gituma, kandi abatware bakanshinyaguriza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze Kandi ku murango no mw’ijoro izina ryanje rikama ritukwa?”
“Ni co gituma abantu banje bazomenya izina ryanje; ni co gituma kuri uwo musi bazomenya ko ari jewe nabivuze imbere y’igihe. Ni vyo, koko ni jewe.”
Ese ukuntu ibirenge vy’abazanye inkuru nziza ari vyiza ku misozi bakamamaza ivy’amahoro, bakazana inkuru nziza bakamamaza ivy’agakiza, bakabwira Siyoni bati: “Imana yawe iraganje!”
Umviriza! Abateramyi bawe badugije amajwi yabo; bose hamwe barafatanije kuririmba indirimbo z’umunezero. Uhoraho niyagaruka i Siyoni, bazovyibonera n’amaso yabo.
Turika muririmbire hamwe indirimbo z’umunezero, yemwe mwa misaka mwe y’i Yerusalemu, kuko Uhoraho ahojeje abantu biwe, kandi acunguye Yerusalemu.
Uhoraho yerekanye ububasha bwiwe n’ukwera kwiwe imbere y’amahanga yose, kandi impera z’isi zose zizobona agakiza k’Imana yacu.
Nimugende, nimugende, musohoke muveyo! Ntihagire igihumanye mukorako! Muveyo, mutunganye, yemwe abatwaye ibikoresho vyo mu nzu y’ Uhoraho .
Ariko ntimuzoveyo mwiruka, mumeze nk’abahunga; kuko Uhoraho azoba ari imbere yanyu, Imana ya Isirayeli izoba ari igihome kibakingira.
Ehe raba umusavyi wanje azokorana ubwenge; azokuzwa, ashirwe hejuru, ahabwe icubahiro cinshi.
Kandi nk’uko benshi bamutangariye bamubonye kuko mu maso hiwe hari hononekaye, hadasa n’ah’abantu, n’ishusho yiwe yononekaye idasa n’iy’abantu,
ni uko azokweza amahanga menshi, kandi abami ntibazokura ururimi mu kanwa imbere yiwe. Kuko ivyo batabwiwe bazovyibonera, kandi ivyo batigeze bumva, bazobitahura.
Ni nde yizeye ubutumwa bwacu, kandi ni ba nde Uhoraho yahishuriye ukuboko kwiwe kw’ubushobozi?

Yakuriye imbere y’ Uhoraho ameze nk’igiterwa kigoyagoya, ameze nk’agati kamera kava mw’isi yumye. Ntiyari afise ubwiza canke ishusho ikayangana ngo bitume abantu bamwirukira, nta co twamubonako cotumye tumwipfuza.
Yarasuzugurwa, agakumirwa n’abantu, yari umunyamibabaro, yari azi kubabazwa ico ari co. Yari ameze nk’umuntu abandi batagomba kuraba, yarakengerewe, natwe nta gaciro twamuhaye.
Ariko ni ukuri imibabaro yacu ni yo yishizeko, imibabaro yacu ni yo yikoreye. Ariko twibajije ko yahanywe n’Imana, ko yakubiswe na yo, kandi akababazwa.
Ariko ivyaha vyacu ni vyo yacumitiwe, yajanjaguriwe ibigabitanyo vyacu; igihano kiduhesha amahoro cabaye kuri we, kandi ibikomere vyiwe ni vyo bidukiza.
Twese twari tumeze nk’intama zizimiye, umwe wese akajana inzira yiwe; maze Uhoraho amushirako ibigabitanyo vyacu twese.
Yarahahajwe, arababazwa, ariko ntiyakuyeko umunwa; amera kurya kw’umwagazi w’intama ujanwa kubagwa, atekereza nk’intama imbere y’uwuyimwa ubwoya, ntiyigera akurako umunwa.
Agacinyizo n’urubanza rw’akarenganyo ni vyo vyatumye akurwaho. Mbega, hoba hari n’umwe wo mu runganwe rwiwe yabihakanye? Kuko yaciwe mw’isi y’abazima, yicirwa ivyaha vy’abantu banje.
Yahambwe hamwe n’inkozi z’ibibi, asangira imva n’umutunzi, n’aho ata kibi yakoze, kandi ata bugunge bwari mu kanwa kiwe.

Ariko Uhoraho ni we yashimye kumujanjagura, amuteza imibabaro, kandi naho Uhoraho yatumye ubuzima bwiwe buba ikimazi c’indishi, azobona uruvyaro rwiwe, kandi azoramba, imigambi y’ Uhoraho yose izoshitswa n’ukuboko kwiwe.

Amaze kubabazwa, azobona umuco w’ubugingo, azobona ivyamwa vy’imibabaro yiwe, kandi azohimbarwa. Kubera ubwenge bwiwe, umusavyi wanje agororoka azoshikana benshi ku kugororoka, kandi azokwishirako ukugabitanya kwabo.

Ni co gituma nzomuha gutorana hamwe n’abahambaye, agabure iminyago n’abanyenkomezi, kuko yatanze ubuzima bwiwe gushika n’aho yemera gupfa, agaharurwa nk’umwe mu bagarariji. Yikoreye ivyaha vya benshi, yongera asabira abanyabicumuro.

“Ririmba, ewe mugore w’ingumba, wewe utigeze uvyara; turika uririmbe usemererane umunezero, wewe utigeze utera igise; kuko abana b’intabwa ari bo benshi gusumba ab’abafise abagabo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Agura ikibanza c’ihema ryawe, wagure n’amahema yawe, ntugarukire hafi. Wungure imigozi yaryo, ukomeze imambo zaryo.
Kuko uzokwira hose i buryo n’i bubamfu; uruvyaro rwawe ruzokwegukira amahanga, babe mu bisagara vyahebwe.

Ntutinye, kuko ntuzosubira guteterwa. Kandi ntutinye kumaramara, kuko isoni ntizizokwongera kukwica. Ahubwo uzokwibagira ibimaramare vyo mu buto bwawe, n’agakengerwe ko mu bupfakazi bwawe ntuzokibuka.
Kuko Umuremyi wawe ari we azoba umugabo wawe, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe, Uwera wa Isirayeli ni we Mucunguzi wawe; yitwa Imana y’isi yose.
Uhoraho azokwiyegereza nk’umugore yahebwe yuzuye amaganya mu mutima, nk’umugore yarongowe akiri muto, hanyuma akirukanwa, ni ko Imana yawe ivuze.
Naragutaye igihe gito, ariko nzokwiyegerezanya imbabazi nyinshi nkugarukane.
Kubera ishavu ryinshi nakunyegeje mu maso hanje kumara igihe, ariko mu bugwaneza bwamaho nzokugirira impuhwe,” ni ko Uhoraho Umucunguzi wawe avuze.
“Ivyo bimbereye nko mu misi ya Nowa, aho narahira ko umwuzure utazosubira kurengera isi. N’ubu ndarahiye ko ntazosubira kukurakira, sinzosubira kuguhana.
Naho imisozi yonyiganyiga, imitumba ikavaho, urukundo ngukunda ntiruzokwigera runyiganyiga, canke ngo isezerano ryanje ry’amahoro riveho,” ni ko Uhoraho agufitiye imbabazi avuze.
“Yewe wa gisagara gihahajwe, ukazungagizwa n’igihuhusi ukabura kiremesha, nzokwubakisha amabuye y’agaciro yitwa turikwaze, kandi amatanguriro yawe ndayubakishe amabuye yitwa lapisi lazuli.
Iminara yawe nzoyubakisha amabuye aca ibibatsi, amarembo yawe nzoyubakisha amabuye y’agaciro, inzitiro zawe ndazubakishe utubuye dukayangana.
Abana bawe bose bazokwigishwa n’ Uhoraho , kandi bazogira amahoro asesekaye.
Nzogukomereza mu bugororotsi: Ugutwazwa amanyama kuzoba kure yawe, ntuzogira ico utinya. Ibiteye ubwoba bizoshirwa kure, ntibizokwegera.
Nihagira uwugutera, si jewe nzoba ndamurungitse; kandi uwuzogutera wese azoza akwisabe.
Ehe raba ni jewe naremye umucuzi avugutira amakara akaba urubeya, hanyuma agacura ikigwanisho uko ashatse, kandi umuranduzi ni jewe namuremeye kurandura.

Ariko nta kigwanisho cacuriwe kukugwanya kizogira ico kikugira, kandi uzotsinda uwo wese azoguhagurukira ngo akuburanye. Uwo ni wo mugabane w’abasavyi b’ Uhoraho , kandi ni kwo kugororoka kwabo kuva kuri jewe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

headings.text: Icubahiro ca Siyoni mu gihe kizoza

verses.text: Nimuze yemwe abafise inyota, nimuze mwironkere amazi; na mwebwe mudafise amahera nimuze, nimuze, musume kandi murye! Nimuze, mugure umuvinyu n’amata, ata mahera, ata kiguzi.
Ni kuki muta amahera yanyu ku bitari indya, mukaruhira ibitabahaza? Nimunyumvirize kugira ngo mubone kurya ivyiza, ni ho muzonezerererwa ivyokurya biryoshe.
Nimutege amatwi, muze aho ndi, mwumvirize, kugira ngo mubone kubaho. Nzogirana namwe isezerano ry’intahava, ari ryo sezerano ry’urukundo rudahera nasezeraniye Dawidi.
Ehe raba, namugize icabona co gushingira intahe abantu, ndamugira umutware wo kubarongora.
Ni ukuri nawe uzotegeka amahanga utazi, kandi amahanga utigeze umenya azokwihuta aza aho uri, abitewe n’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli, kuko azoba yakwambitse ubwiza.
Nimurondere Uhoraho bigishoboka ko mumubona, mumuhamagare akiri hafi.
Umunyakibi nareke inzira ziwe, umunyavyaha ave mu vyiyumviro vyiwe bibi. Bagaruke k’ Uhoraho , na we azobagirira imbabazi, bagaruke ku Mana yacu, na yo izobaharira ku buntu.
“Kuko ivyiyumviro vyanje atari vyo vyiyumviro vyanyu, kandi n’inzira zanyu atari zo nzira zanje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nk’uko amajuru ari hejuru cane y’isi, ni ko n’inzira zanje ziri hejuru cane y’inzira zanyu, kandi ni ko n’ivyiyumviro vyanje biri hejuru cane y’ivyanyu.
Nk’uko imvura na shelegi bimanuka bivuye mw’ijuru, hanyuma ntibisubire inyuma bitavomeye isi, bigatuma itota igashobora kumera, kugira ngo ihe umubivyi umwimbu n’umuryi ivyokurya,
ni ko n’ijambo riva mu kanwa kanje riri: ntirizosubira inyuma uko ryaje, ariko rizoshitsa intumbero yanje, rishitse intumbero yatumye ndarituma.
Namwe muzovanayo umunezero, murongowe mu mahoro; imisozi n’imitumba bizoturika bibaririmbire, n’ibiti vyo ku misozi bibakomere amashi.
Ahahora imibambangwe hazomera amasederi, ahari imikere hamere imiriteli Ivyo bizotuma Uhoraho aba rurangiranwa kubera ico kimenyetso gihoraho, kitazigera gikurwaho.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimuce iziroranye, kandi mukore ibibereye, kuko agakiza kanje kari hafi cane, kandi ukugororoka kwanje kukaba kugira guhishurwe vuba.
Hahiriwe uwukora ivyo, uwo muntu abifashe nkama, yubahiriza Isabato ntayihumanye, akarinda amaboko yiwe ntakore ikibi na kimwe.”
Umunyamahanga yifatanije n’ Uhoraho , ashobora kuvuga ati: “ Uhoraho azonca mu bantu biwe.” Kandi n’inkone ishobora kuvuga iti: “Jeho ndi igiti cumye.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Inkone zubahiriza Isabato, zigahitamwo gukora ibimpimbara, zikazigama isezerano,
nzoziha igihome c’icibutso mu nzu yanje, icibutso hamwe n’izina risumba iry’abahungu n’abakobwa; nzoziha izina rizohoraho, rizokwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abanyamahanga bifatanya n’ Uhoraho kugira ngo bamukorere, bakunde izina ry’ Uhoraho babe abakozi biwe, hamwe n’abo bose bubahiriza Isabato ntibayihumanye, bakagumya isezerano ryanje,

nzobazana ku musozi wanje wera, ndabahere umunezero mu nzu yanje yo gusengeramwo. Amashikanwa y’ibiturirwa bikamota neza hamwe n’ibimazi vyabo bizokwakirwa ku gicaniro canje; kuko Ingoro yanje izokwitwa inzu isengerwamwo n’amahanga yose.”
Uhoraho Nyeninganji, we yegeranije Abisirayeli abakuye mu kinyago, avuze ati: “Nzokwegeranya n’abandi, ndabashire hamwe n’abamaze kwegeranywa.”
Nimuze, yemwe nyamaswa zo mu gahinga mwese, nimuze mutabagure namwe bikoko vyo mw’ishamba!
Abateramyi ba Isirayeli ni impumyi, bose ni imburabwenge; ni imbwa z’ibiragi, zidashobora gukuga; bararyama bakarota, bakunda gusinzira!
Ni imbwa zitigera zihaga, zitigera zironka ibikwiye. Ni abungere batagira ubwenge, bazimirira mu nzira zabo, umwe wese akironderera inyungu ziwe.
Umwe wese aravuga ati: “Nimuze, hinge nzane umuvinyu! Reka tunywe iziboreza kugeza tuborewe! Kandi ejo bizoba bimeze nk’uno musi, canke mbere binarushirize kuba vyiza.”
Abagororotsi bariko barahona, ariko nta n’umwe abishizeko umutima. Intungane ziriko zirakurwaho, ariko nta n’umwe atahura ko abagororotsi bakuweho kugira ngo barindwe ivyago biri imbere.
Abagendera mu kugororoka bashikira mu mahoro, bararuhuka basinziriye itiro ry’urupfu.
“Ariko mweho nimwigire hano, mwa bana b’umupfumukazi, namwe ruvyaro rw’umusambanyi n’umumaraya!
Mbega uwo mucokora ni nde? Ni nde muha ibinoko, mukamwereka ururimi? Mbega ntimuri abana b’abagarariji, uruvyaro rw’ababeshi?
Muganzwa n’ivyipfuzo vy’ubusambanyi muri musi y’ibiti binini no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye, abana banyu mukabatangako ibimazi mu myonga no mu migaga y’ibitandara.
Mu mabuye asenye yo mu myonga ni ho hari umugabane wanyu, kandi ni vyo ragi ryanyu. Ni yo mwashikaniye amashikanwa yanyu y’ibinyobwa, muyashikanira n’amashikanwa y’ifu. Mbega ivyo nobinezerererwa?
Wasambaniye ku mpinga z’imisozi mu kuhasengera ibigirwamana; ni ho wagiye urashikanira ibimazi.

Inyuma y’inzugi n’ibishimaryango vyawe wahashize ibimenyetso vy’ingene uri umunyavyaha. Mu kunta, wapfukuye uburiri bwawe, urabwurira urabugaranzura, ugirana isezerano n’abo wikundiye, urabana ukwipfuza imibiri yabo iri gusa.
Wagiye kuraba Moleki wisize amavuta ya elayo, wisize n’ibimota cane iyo bituriwe. Utuma intumwa zawe kure cane, gushika n’aho zishika i kuzimu.
Wagenze urugendo rurerure, urananirwa, ariko ntiwikebuka ngo uvuge uti: ‘Nta kizovamwo.’ Ariko kuko ukwipfuza kwawe kwari gukomeye, wakomeje urugendo, ntiwacitse intege.
Mbega uwo mwatinya akabatera ubwoba ni nde, bigatuma mumbesha, mukanyibagira, ntimunanyiyumvireko mu mitima yanyu? Mbega si kubera namaze igihe kinini nihoreye, vyatumye mutanyubaha?
Nzoshira ahabona ivyo wita ukugororoka kwawe n’ibikorwa vyawe, ariko nta co bizokumarira.

Niwasemerera ushaka gutabarwa, ibigirwamana wegeranije birazogutabara! Igihuhusi kizobitwara, n’umuyaga usanzwe uzobikuraho. Ariko uwungira ubuhungiro bwiwe azoragwa igihugu, ahabwe umusozi wanje wera.”
Kandi bizovugwa ngo: “Nimuharure, nimuharure, mutunganye inzira y’ Uhoraho ! Mukure mu nzira ivyotsitaza abantu banje vyose.”
