Kuko uwushizwe hejuru cane, aravuze uwuhoraho ibihe vyose, akitwa uwera: avuze ati: “Mba hejuru, kandi hera, ariko kandi mbana n’uwufise umutima umenetse, yicishije bugufi, kugira ngo mpembure imitima iciye bugufi, n’imitima imenetse.
Sinzokwama ntongana ibihe vyose, kandi sinzokwama ndatse, ahandi ho imitima n’impwemu vy’umuntu naremye vyohonera rimwe imbere yanje.
Icaha ciwe ni co candakije, maze ndamuhana, nyegeza mu nyonga hanje kubera ndatse, ariko yigumira mu vyo yigombeye.
Narabonye ingeso ziwe, ariko nzomukiza; nzobarongora, nongere ndemeshe Abisirayeli bagandaye,
ndeme ishimwe mu kanwa kabo. Amahoro, amahoro, ku bari hafi no ku bari kure,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Kandi nzobakiza.”
Ariko abanyakibi bameze nk’ikiyaga gisuriranya, kidashobora gutekana, imipfunda yaco ikazikurura isuri n’ivyondo.
“Nta mahoro ku munyakibi,” ni ko Imana yanje ivuze.
“Semerera cane, ugumizeko. Duza ijwi ryawe nk’inzamba. Ubwire abantu banje ivy’ubugarariji bwabo, n’abakomoka kuri Yakobo ubabwire ivy’ivyaha vyabo.

Kuko uko bukeye uko bwije barandondera, basa n’abafise inyota yo kumenya inzira zanje, bakaboneka nk’ihanga rikora ibigororotse, ritataye ivyagezwe vy’Imana yaryo. Bansaba gukora ivyo bategerezwa gukora bonyene ubwabo, bakiyerekana nk’abashaka ko Imana ibegera.
Barabaza bati: ‘Ni kuki twisonzesha, ariko ntubibone? Ni kuki twicishije bugufi ariko ukavyirengagiza?’ Ariko ku musi mwisonzesheje mukora ibibahimbara gusa, mugakoresha nabi abakozi banyu bose.
Ukwisonzesha kwanyu guherera mu mitongano no mu matati, mu kugwana mukubitana ingumu. Ntimushobora kwisonzesha uko mubigira uwu musi, ngo mwitege ko ijwi ryanyu ryumvikana mw’ijuru.

Mbega ukwo ni kwo kwisonzesha nahisemwo, umusi abantu bicisha bugufi? Umusi umuntu yunamika umutwe kurya kw’irenga rigondwa n’umuyaga, akaryama ku magunira yisize iminyota? Ivyo ni vyo mwita kwisonzesha, umusi wemewe n’ Uhoraho ?
Mbega uku si kwo kwisonzesha nahisemwo: gucagagura ingoyi z’akarenganyo, mugapfundurura imigozi iboheye imitwaro ku bantu, abacinyijwe bakidegemvya mukavunagura ingogo zose?
Mbega si ugusangira ivyokurya vyawe n’abashonje, no guha abakene aho baba, mubonye uwugenda gusa mukamwambika, ntimwirengagiza mwenewanyu?
Aho ni ho umuco wanyu womurika nk’umutwenzi, n’ugukira kwanyu kukihuta kugaragara. Maze ukugororoka kwanyu kuzobitangira imbere, kandi ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho buzoba igihome kibakingira.
Ni ho muzohamagara Uhoraho , na we akabishura; muzomutabaza, na we azobishura ati: ‘Ndi hano.’ Nimwakura imitwaro ku bacinyijwe, mukareka gutungana intoke no kubwirana nabi,
mukitanga kugira ngo mushobore kugaburira abashonje, mugahaza abakene n’abahahajwe, ico gihe umuco wanyu uzokayangana mu mwijima, kandi ijoro ryanyu rizohinduka rimere nk’umutaga.
Uhoraho azokwama akurongora, aguhere ivyo ukeneye mu gihugu kigatuwe n’uruzuba, azokomeza ubugingo bwawe. Uzomera nk’itongo rivomerewe neza, umere nk’iriba ritigera rikama.
Abantu bawe bazosanura ivyasambutse kera, baduze amatanguriro yashizweho n’aba kera cane; uzokwitwa uwusanasana ibirengero vy’inzitiro, uwusibura amayira n’amazu yo kubamwo.

Nimutahumanya Isabato, mukareka gukora ivyo mwigombeye ku musi wanje wera, mukayita umusi Uhoraho anezerererwa, wera kandi ukwiye kwubahwa, mukawubahisha kutigira mu ngeso zanyu no mu kudakurikira ivyo imitima yanyu yipfuza n’amajambo y’imburakimazi,
muzonezerererwa Uhoraho , nanje nzobashira hejuru muri iki gihugu, ndabahe gutorana umugabane wa Yakobo.” Akanwa k’ Uhoraho ni ko kabivuze.
Ehe, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho ntikwabaye kugufi ngo kunanirwe kubakiza, kandi n’amatwi yiwe ntazivye ku buryo adashobora kubumva.
Ibigabitanyo vyanyu ni vyo vyabatandukanije, n’Imana yanyu, ivyaha vyanyu ni vyo vyatumye abahisha mu nyonga hiwe, kugira ngo ntabumve.
Kuko ibiganza vyanyu vyuzuyeko amaraso, intoke zanyu zandujwe n’ivyaha. Iminwa yanyu yuzuye ububeshi, ururimi rwanyu rukavuga ibibi gusa.
Nta n’umwe arondera ubutungane, kandi nta n’uwuvugisha ukuri mu kuburana. Ivyo bashikiriza ni amajambo gusa, bavuga ibinyoma, batwara inda y’ibikorwa bibi bakavyara icaha.
Babundikira amagi y’imvuvyi, bakajisha nk’ibitangurirwa. Uwuriye amagi yabo wese arapfa kandi iyo igi rimwe rimenetse, havamwo inzoka
Ivyo bajisha nta mpuzu zishobora kuvamwo, ntibashobora kwipfuka ivyo bijishiye. Ibikorwa vyabo ni ivy’ukugabitanya, kandi amaboko yabo akora ivy’umuryano.
Ibirenge vyabo vyirukira gukora ivyaha, barihuta gusesa amaraso y’abantu ata co bazira. Ivyiyumviro vyabo bihengamiye ku bibi; ibikorwa vy’umuryano ni vyo birangwa aho baciye.
Ntibazi inzira z’amahoro; nta butungane buba mu nzira bacamwo. Inzira zabo barazigoramika; abazicamwo ntibigera bagira amahoro.
Ni co gituma ubutungane buri kure yacu, ukugororoka ntigushika aho turi. Turondera umuco, ariko ico turonka ni umwijima; tukarondera ugukayangana, ariko tukagendera mu gitutu c’umwijima.
Dukabakaba impome nk’impumyi, tukarondera inzira nk’abatagira amaso. Dutsitara ku murango nk’aho bwamaze kwira, mu bakomeye tumeze nk’abapfuye.
Twese twivuga nk’idubu, ariko tukaniha nk’inuma ziguguza. Turondera ubutungane ariko tukabubura, twarondera ukubohoka, kukaba kure yacu.
Kuko ibicumuro vyacu vyabaye vyinshi mu nyonga zawe, kandi ivyaha vyacu bikaba biturega kuri wewe. Ibicumuro vyacu bitwomyeko, kandi ibigabitanyo vyacu turavyemeye:
gucumura no kwihakana Uhoraho , gutera umugongo Imana yacu, kuvuga ivy’agahahazo n’imigumuko, kuvuga ibinyoma imitima yacu yigeneye.
Ni co gituma ubutungane bwasubiye inyuma, ukugororoka kugahagarara kure cane; ukuri kukaba kwaratsitaye mu nzira, ukuba inyankamugayo ntibikunde kwinjira.
Ukuri nta na hamwe kuboneka, kandi uwugwanya ikibi ahigwa bwa gikoko. Uhoraho yaravyihweje biramubabaza, abonye ko ata butungane bukihari.
Yararavye abona nta n’umwe, atangazwa n’uko ata n’umwe wo gutabara. Ni co catumye ukuboko kwiwe kubazanira agakiza, ukugororoka kwiwe kukaba ari kwo kubashigikira.
Yambaye ukugororoka nk’icuma gikingira igikiriza, yambara n’inkofero y’agakiza ku mutwe wiwe. Yambara impuzu z’uguhora, yambara n’ishaka nk’umutamana.
Akurikije ivyo bakoze, azobishura ibikwiranye uburake ku bansi biwe, n’impera ikwiye abamugwanya n’amazinga azoyishura ibikwiranye n’ivyo yakoze.
Uhereye mu burengero, abantu bazokwubaha izina ry’ Uhoraho , guhera mu buseruko bazohindira agashitsi icubahiro ciwe. Kuko azoza nk’umwuzure uhushwe n’uguhumeka kw’ Uhoraho .
“Umucunguzi azoza i Siyoni, gucungura aba Yakobo bihanye ivyaha vyabo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Uhoraho aravuze ati: “Nanje iri ni ryo sezerano ngiranye na bo: Mpwemu wanje ntazova kuri mwebwe, kandi n’amajambo yanje nashize mu kanwa kanyu ntazohava, eka ntazova no mu kanwa k’abana banyu, canke mu kanwa k’uruvyaro rwabo, uhereye ubu ugashitsa ibihe vyose,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Haguruka ukayangane, kuko umuco wawe washitse, kandi n’ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bukaba buri kuri wewe.
Ehe raba, umwijima utwikiriye isi, umwijima w’umuzitanya utwikiriye amahanga, ariko Uhoraho ahagurutse ku bwawe, kandi umuco wiwe uragukayanganiye.
Amahanga azoza akurikirana umuco wawe, abami bazoza kuraba ugukayangana kwawe.
Unamura amaso yawe urabe hirya no hino: bose barakoranye baje aho uri, abahungu bawe baje bava kure, abakobwa bawe na bo baje bateruwe mu maboko.
Mu maso hawe hazokayangana, umutima wawe na wo udidagizwe kubera umunezero; ibidandazwa vyo ku kiyaga bizozanwa kuri wewe, ubutunzi bw’amahanga yose buzozanwa iwawe.
Ingamiya zizokwuzura igihugu cawe, inyana zazo zizozanwa zivuye i Midiyani no muri Efa. Ab’i Sheba bazoza, bazanye inzahabu n’ibiturirwa bikamota neza, baze bavuga amatazirano y’ Uhoraho .
Ibitungwa vy’i Kedari bizokwegeranirizwa iwawe; intama z’i Nebayoti zizanwe ku gicaniro cawe; zizokwemerwa nk’ibimazi, nanje nzokwuzuza ubwiza Ingoro yanje.
Mbega abo mbona baguruka nk’ibicu ni ba nde, bameze nk’inuma zitashe mu vyari vyazo?

Ni ukuri amazinga ni jewe yipfuza; n’amato y’i Tarushishi arafashe inzira, azanye abana bawe, bavuye kure, bazanye inzahabu n’ifeza zabo, gusenga Uhoraho Imana yawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli, kuko yakwambitse ugukayangana.
Abanyamahanga bazosanura inzitiro zawe, abami bayo na bo bagukorere. Naho nagukubise kubera uburake, mu buntu bwanje nkugiriye impuhwe.
Amarembo yawe azokwama yuguruye, ntazokwigera akingwa, haba ku murango, haba mw’ijoro, kugira ngo abantu bazokwame bazana ubutunzi bw’ayandi mahanga, abami bayo bazanwe bashorewe mu birori.
Kuko ihanga canke ubwami butazogukorera buzotikizwa, buzosenyurwa burangire.
Ubwiza bw’i Libani buzoza kuri wewe, ibiti vy’amasederi, imitidari n’amapinusi vyose hamwe bizoza gushariza Ingoro yanje; nanje nzokwubahisha aho nshira ibirenge vyanje.
Abana b’abagutwaza umukazo bazoza bakwunamire, abakugaya bazoza bikubite imbere y’ibirenge vyawe, bakwite Igisagara c’ Uhoraho , Siyoni h’Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Naho wari waratawe, ukankwa, ata wukugendera, nzoguha ubwiza butazokwigera buvaho, nkugire umunezero w’urunganwe rwose.
Uzonywa amata y’amahanga, wonke amabere y’ubwami. Ni ho uzomenya ko jewe Uhoraho , ndi Umukiza wawe, Umucunguzi wawe, Umunyenkomezi wa Yakobo.

Mu gishingo c’umwakaka nzokuzanira inzahabu, nkuzanire ifeza mu gishingo c’ivyuma. Mu gishingo c’imbaho nzokuzanira imyakaka, nkuzanire n’ivyuma mu gishingo c’amabuye. Abategetsi bawe bazoba abanyamahoro, co kimwe n’abatware bawe.
Nta muryano uzosubira kwumvikana mu gihugu cawe, nta gusenyura n’ugutikiza bizovugwa aho imbibe zawe zigera, ariko inzitiro zawe uzozita Gakiza, amarembo yawe na yo uyite Mashimwe.
Ku murango ntuzoba ukibonesherezwa n’izuba, kandi ugukayangana kw’ukwezi si kwo kuzokumurikira mw’ijoro, kuko Uhoraho ari we azokubera umuco wamaho, Imana yawe izokubera ubwiza.
Izuba ryawe ntirizoba rikirenga, n’umuco w’ukwezi kwawe ntuzigera ugabanuka. Uhoraho azoba umuco wawe uzohoraho, kandi imisi y’umubabaro wawe izorangira.
Hanyuma abantu bawe bose bazoba abagororotsi, kandi bazoragwa igihugu ibihe vyose. Ni bo giterwa nitereye, ni bo gikorwa c’amaboko yanje, kigaragaza ubwiza bwanje.
Uwa nyuma muri mwebwe azogwira abemwo ibihumbi, umuto muri mwebwe avemwo ihanga rikomeye. Ndi Uhoraho , ivyo nzobishitsa mu kanya gato cane, igihe cavyo kigeze.”

Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ari kuri jewe, kuko Uhoraho yansize amavuta ngo mbwire aboro ubutumwa bwiza. Yantumye kwunga imitima isanzaye, kumenyesha inyagano ko zibohowe, no guha imbohe umwidegemvyo.
Yantumye kumenyesha umwaka wo kugirirwa ubuntu n’ Uhoraho , n’umusi wo kwihora kw’Imana yacu, no kuremesha abagandaye bose,

nshirireho no kuri abo b’i Siyoni bagandaye, urugori rw’ubwiza mu gishingo c’iminyota, amavuta y’akanyamuneza mu gishingo c’ikigandaro, n’umwambaro w’amashimwe mu gishingo c’umutima wihebuye. Bazokwitwa igiti c’ukugororoka, catewe n’ Uhoraho , ngo cerekane ubwiza bwiwe.
Bazosubira bubake ivyasambuwe kera, basanasane ahasanganguwe kera cane. Bazosanura ibisagara, vyasambuwe hakaba haciye igihe kirekire.
Ba kavantara bazokuragirira ibitungwa, abanyamahanga bazokurimira mu mirima y’imizabibu.
Namwe muzokwitwa abaherezi b’ Uhoraho , muzokwitwa abakozi b’Imana yacu. Muzorya ku butunzi bw’amahanga, kandi muzokwiratira mu butunzi bwabo.

Mu gishingo co kumaramara, muzoronka umugabane wanyu ugwije kabiri, mu gishingo co guteterwa, muzonezerererwa umugabane wanyu. Muzohabwa umugabane wanyu ugwije kabiri mu gihugu canyu, umunezero udashira uzoba uwanyu.
Kuko jewe Uhoraho nkunda guca iziroranye; nkanka ubusuma n’ubugunge. Mu bwizigirwa bwanje nzoha impera abantu banje, nongere ngirane na bo isezerano ritazovaho.
Uruvyaro rwabo rumenyekane mu mahanga, n’abana babo bamenyekane mu bantu benshi. Abazobabona bose bazomenya ko ari ubwoko bwahezagiwe n’ Uhoraho .

Nzohimbarwa n’ Uhoraho , umutima wanje unezerererwe Imana yanje. Kuko yanyambitse umwambaro w’agakiza, akantwikiriza umutamana w’ukugororoka, nk’uko umukwe ashariza umutwe wiwe nk’umuherezi, umugeni na we akishariza n’udusharizo twiwe tw’inzahabu.
Nk’uko isi isokorora ingemwe, maze itongo rigakuza ibiterwa, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji azoshiraho ukugororoka, maze amashimwe yiburuke imbere y’amahanga yose.
Ku bwa Siyoni sinzocereza, no ku bwa Yerusalemu sinzotekereza, gushika ukugororoka kwiwe gukayanganye nk’umutwenzi, n’agakiza kiwe kamuritse nk’urumuri.
Amahanga yose azokwihweza ukugororoka kwawe, abami na bo babone ubwiza bwawe; uzokwitwa izina rishasha, iryo uzohabwa n’akanwa k’ Uhoraho .
Uzoba urugori rw’ubwiza mu kuboko kw’ Uhoraho , n’urugori rw’ubwami mu biganza vy’Imana yawe.

Ntuzoba ucitwa intabwa, canke ngo igihugu cawe bacite icahebwe. Ariko uzokwitwa Hefuziba, bisigura “umugwa Uhoraho anezerererwa”, igihugu cawe na co citwe Beyula, bisigura “Uwarongowe”; kuko Uhoraho azokunezerererwa, akwemere nk’uwiwe.
Nk’uko umukwe amenyana n’umugeni wiwe, ni ko abakwubaka muzomenyana, kandi nk’uko umukwe anezerererwa umugeni wiwe, ni ko Imana yawe izokunezerererwa.
Nashize abateramyi ku nzitiro zawe, ewe Yerusalemu; ntibazigera bahora haba ku murango canke mw’ijoro. Yemwe abambaza Uhoraho , ntimuruhuke,
kandi na we nyene ntimumwemerere ko aruhuka, gushika ahinduye Yerusalemu ishimwe ryiwe kw’isi yose.

Uhoraho yararahiye n’ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo, ari kwo kuboko kw’inkomezi, ati: Sinzosubira kugabura ingano zanyu ngo ndazihe abansi banyu bazirye, kandi n’abanyamahanga ngo banywe imivinyu mishasha, iyo mwaruhiye;
ariko abavyimbura ni bo bazobiryako hanyuma bashime Uhoraho kandi n’abazogana inzabibu bazozinywako, bazinywere mu rugo rw’Ingoro yanje.
Nimurenge, nimurenge amarembo! Mutegurire inzira abantu. Nimuharure, muharure inzira zagutse! Nimukure amabuye mu nzira. Nimudugirize ibendera amahanga.
Uhoraho yatanze itegeko gushika ku mpera z’isi zose ati: “Nimubwire umukobwa w’i Siyoni muti: ‘Ehe Umukiza wawe araje! Ehe aje azanye impera, kandi impembo yiwe iramuherekeje.’ ”
Bazokwitwa ubwoko bwera, abacunguwe n’ Uhoraho ; nawe uzokwitwa Uwipfuzwa, Igisagara Kitahebwe.

Uriya ni nde aje ava muri Edomu, azananye i Bozira, yambaye impuzu z’amabara atukura? Uriya ni nde yambaye impuzu z’icubahiro, agenda anyaruka kandi afise inkomezi nyinshi? “Ni jewe Uhoraho , ntangaje intsinzi, jewe mfise ububasha bwo gukiza.”
Ni kubera iki imyambaro yawe itukura, isa n’iy’abaganira inzabibu mu bwato?

Ni jewe naganiye inzabibu mu bwato jenyene, kuko mu mahanga yose nta n’umwe yari kumwe nanje. Nabaganishije ibirenge ndatse, ndabahonyangira hasi mfise uburake; amaraso yabo yatarukiye ku myambaro yanje, maze impuzu zanje zirandura.
Uwo musi kuri jewe wari uwo kwihora, n’umwaka wo gucungura ukaba washitse.
Narondeye uwomfasha ndabura, ntangazwa n’uko ata n’umwe ahari wo kumfasha; ni co catumye ukuboko kwanje kunzanira agakiza, ubushangashirwe bwanje na bwo burampagarikira.
Nahonyanze amahanga nshavuye, ndababoreza uburake bwanje, maze amaraso yabo ndayasesa hasi.

Nzovuga ukugira neza kw’ Uhoraho , birakwiye ko ibikorwa vyiwe abihererwa ishimwe, twisunze ivyo Uhoraho yadukoreye vyose. Ni vyo, ivyiza vyinshi, yarabikoze ku bwa Isirayeli nk’uko impuhwe ziwe ziri, nk’uko impuhwe ziwe n’ukugira neza kwiwe bingana.
Yavuze ati: “Koko ni abantu banje, abana batazosubira kumpemukira;” maze na we ababera Umukiza.
Mu mibabaro yabo yababaranye na bo, abamarayika b’imbere yiwe barabakiza. Mu rukundo no mu mbabazi ziwe yarabarokoye; arabaterura, arabajana, abaheka imyaka yose ya kera.
Ariko baragararije, bababaza Mpwemu Yera, na we arabahindukirira, aba umwansi wabo, ubwiwe arabagwanya.

Maze abantu biwe bibuka ibihe vya kera, ibihe vya Mose n’abantu bayo: ari hehe uwabatahanye abacishije mu kiyaga, bari kumwe n’umwungere w’umukuku wiwe? Ari hehe uwarungitse Mpwemu Yera wiwe ngo abane n’abantu biwe?
Ari hehe uwatumye ukuboko kwiwe kwiza kandi kw’ubushobozi kukagendera i buryo bwa Mose, uwagabuyemwo kabiri amazi igihe Mose yaramvura ukuboko kwiwe, maze bimuha kuba rurangiranwa ibihe vyose?
Ari hehe uwacishije abantu i bwina mu kiyaga, bakagenda nk’amafarasi yiruka mu bugaragwa atigera atsitara?
Nk’uko ibitungwa bica mu kiyaya gitekanye, ni ko Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho yabahaye akaruhuko. Uko ni ko warongoye abantu bawe, uhesha izina ryawe icubahiro.
Ihweze hasi uri mw’ijuru, witegereze, uri ku ntebe yawe yera kandi y’icubahiro. Ishaka n’inkomezi vyawe biri hehe? Ubugwaneza n’imbabazi vyawe vyanse kudushikako.
Ariko uri Data wa twese, naho Aburahamu atatuzi, canke ngo Isirayeli atwemere. Yewe Uhoraho , uri Data, Umucunguzi wacu ryamye ari ryo zina ryawe.
Yewe Uhoraho , ni iki gituma utureka tukava mu nzira zawe, ugakomantaza imitima yacu, bikanka ko duhinda agashitsi imbere yawe? Hindukira utabare abasavyi bawe, imiryango yawe ari yo mugabane wawe.
Abantu bawe baganje ahera hawe igihe gito, none ubu ho abansi bacu bahasanganguye.
Turi abawe kuva kera, ariko bobo ntiwabaganje, ntibigeze bitirirwa izina ryawe.
Ese icompa ugasatura ijuru, ukururuka, maze imisozi igahindira agashitsi imbere yawe!
Nk’uko umuriro uturira inkwi, na zo zikabiza amazi, ukuza kwawe kwotuma izina ryawe rimenywa n’abansi bawe, amahanga agatetemera imbere yawe!
Kuko igihe wakora ibitangaza tutari twiteze, waramanutse, imisozi ihindira agashitsi imbere yawe.
Uhereye kera cane, nta wurumva, nta gutwi kwigeze kwumva canke ijisho ryigeze ribona Imana imeze nkawe, ikorera ibitangaza abayiteze.
Waje gutabara abakora ivyiza banezerewe, bakibuka inzira zawe. Ariko igihe twigumira mu vyaha vyacu, waraturakiye. None tuzokizwa n’iki?
Kuko twese twahindutse abanduye, kandi ivyo twakora nk’ukugororoka vyose vyabaye nk’imishambara yanduye. Twese twakabiranye nk’ibabi, ivyaha vyacu bidukubeba nk’umuyaga.
Nta wambaza izina ryawe, kandi nta wirukira kukwumirako; kuko waduhishije mu nyonga hawe, uratureka twicwa n’ivyaha vyacu.
Ariko Uhoraho , ni wewe Data wa twese. Turi ibumba, nawe uri umubumvyi; twese turi igikorwa c’amaboko yawe.
Ntuturakire birenze urugero, yewe Uhoraho , kandi ntuze wigere usubira kwibuka ivyaha vyacu. Turabishe inyonga zawe, turagusavye, kuko twese turi abantu bawe.
Ibisagara vyawe vyera vyahindutse ubugaragwa, na Siyoni hasigaye ari agahinga, Yerusalemu na ho habaye umusaka.
Ingoro yacu y’ubwiza bwinshi, iyo ba sogokuruza baguhimbarizamwo, yaraturiwe, ivyari ivy’agaciro vyose kuri twebwe vyarononekaye.
None inyuma y’ivyo vyose, uzoguma utwigira kure, ga yewe Uhoraho ? Uzoguma winumiye, uduhane ibirenze urugero?
“Nihishuriye abatariko baranandondera; mbonwa n’abatariko baranabaza ivyanje. Ihanga ritigeze ryambaza izina ryanje naribwiye nti: ‘Ndi hano, ndi hano!’
Umusi wose niriwe nshanje amaboko, ndayategeye abantu b’intagondwa, bagendera mu ngeso mbi, bagakurikira ivyiyumviro vyabo bipfuye;
abantu bama bariko barakora ibikorwa vyo kumbabaza, babikorera imbere yanje, mu gutangira ibimazi mu matongo, no mu guturirira ibimota neza ku bicaniro vy’amatafari.
Mw’ijoro baja kwicara mu mva, bagahamagara imizimu, bakarya ingurube hamwe n’ibindi vyose bihumanye.
Ariko bakabarira abandi ngo: ‘Ntunyegere, wompumanya, kuko ndi uwera kugusumvya!’ Abantu nk’abo bameze nk’umwotsi mu mazuru yanje, ni umuriro waka bukarinda bwira.
Ehe raba, ivyo biguma vyanditswe imbere yanje: sinzokomeza guhora, nzobasubiriza mu nkoko bikwiranye n’ivyo bakoze, ni vyo, nzobibishura,
mbahanire ivyaha vyabo n’ivya ba sekuruza babo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Baturirira imibavu ku misozi, bakantukira ku mitumba, nzobasubiriza mu nkoko ibikwiranye n’ivyo bakoze.”
Uhoraho avuze ati: “Nk’uko ihando ry’inzabibu riboneka ko ririmwo umutobe, maze abantu bakavuga bati: ‘Ntimuwurandure kuko ugifise akamaro,’ nanje ni ko nzogirira abasavyi banje, sinzobarandura bose.
Muri Yakobo nzohakura uruvyaro, no muri Yuda nzohakura abazokwegukira imisozi yanje; abantu banje batoranijwe ni bo bazoyitorana, kandi abasavyi banje ni yo bazobako.
Sharoni hazoba uburagiro bw’imikuku, ikiyaya ca Akori na co kibe icanya co kuvyagiramwo. Kubera abantu banje bandondera.
Ariko mwebwe mureka Uhoraho , mukibagira umusozi wanje wera, mugaterekera imeza ikigirwamana c’imigisha, mugasukira umuvinyu ikigirwamana ca kazoza
nanje ndabateguriye kwicwa n’inkota namwe muzotega izosi imbere y’uwuritema, kuko nabahamagaye ntimwanyitaba, ndavuga ntimwanyumviriza. Mwakoreye ibibi imbere yanje, muhitamwo ibitampimbara.”

None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Abasavyi banje bazorya, ariko mwebwe muzokwicwa n’inzara; abasavyi banje bazonywa, ariko mwebwe muzokwicwa n’inyota; abasavyi banje bazonezerwa, ariko mwebwe muzokwicwa n’isoni.
Abasavyi banje bazoririmba kubera umunezero wo mu mitima yabo, ariko mwebwe muzorira kubera agahinda ko mu mitima yanyu, muborogeshwe n’ukubabara kw’imitima yanyu.
Izina ryanyu muzorisigira abo natoranije, ngo baze barikoreshe mu mivumo yabo. Uhoraho Nyeninganji azobarandura, ariko abasavyi biwe azobaha irindi zina.
Uwuzogomba umugisha mu gihugu azowusaba Imana y’ukuri; n’uwuzorahira mu gihugu azorahire Imana y’ukuri. Kuko nzokwibagira imibabaro yanyu ya kera, inyegezwe mu nyonga hanje.”
“Ehe raba ngiye kurema ijuru rishasha n’isi nshasha. Ivya kera ntibizosubira kwibukwa, ntibizosubira no guca mu mitwe y’abantu.
Ariko nimuhimbarwe, munezerererwe ibihe vyose ivyo ngiye kurema, kuko ngira ndemere Yerusalemu kuba ibihimbaro, n’abantu baho kuba umunezero.
Nzonezererwa Yerusalemu, mpimbarwe n’abantu banje; urwamo rw’amarira n’amaborogo ntibizosubira kwumvikana.
Aho ntihazokwongera kuba abana bapfa bakiri inzoya, canke abatama bapfa batamaze imyaka yabo. Uwuzopfa afise imyaka ijana azoba apfuye nk’uwukiri umwana; kandi uwutazoyishikana azofatwa nk’uwavumwe.
Bazokwubaka amazu bayabemwo, barime imizabibu, barye ivyamwa vyayo.

Ntibazoba bacubaka amazu hanyuma ngo abandi baze bayabemwo, canke ngo barime abandi baze bimbure. Kuko abantu banje bazomara imyaka nk’iy’ibiti, abo natoranije bazomara imyaka barya ivyo babiriye akuya.
Ntibazoruhira ubusa, canke ngo bavyare abagenewe amagorwa; kuko ari abantu bahezagiwe n’ Uhoraho , kandi n’uruvyaro rwabo rwarahezagiwe.
Nzobitaba bataranampamagara, kandi bakivuga nzoba nabumvise.

Ibingira n’umwagazi w’intama bizosangira, intare izorisha ivyatsi nk’inka, kandi umukungugu ni wo uzoba indya y’inzoka. Nta kwonona canke ugusambura bizosubira gukorwa, ku musozi wanje wose wera,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ijuru ni intebe yanje y’ubwami, isi na yo ni indava y’ibirenge vyanje. Mbega mwonyubakira inzu nyabaki? Canke ikibanza canje co kuruhukiramwo coba hehe?
Mbega ukuboko kwanje si kwo kwaremye ivyo vyose hanyuma bikabaho?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. “Ariko abo ndaba ryiza ni abicisha bugufi, bafise imitima imenetse, kandi bahindira agashitsi ijambo ryanje.

Ariko uwutanga ikimazi c’impfizi uko abibonye, ameze nk’uwica umuntu, kandi uwushikana umwagazi w’intama uko abibonye angana n’uwubaga imbwa, n’uwutanga amashikanwa y’ifu uko abibonye ameze nk’uwushikana amaraso y’ingurube, nayo uwuturira ibimota neza uko abibonye, ameze nk’uwusenga ikigirwamana. Bahisemwo inzira zabo, imitima yabo inezerererwa ibizira.
Ni co gituma nzobarungikira ivyago bikomeye, ivyo batinya cane. Kuko igihe nahamagara, ntibitavye n’igihe navuga, ntibanyumvirije. Bakoreye ibibi mu maso yanje, bahitamwo ibitampimbara.”

Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe abahindira agashitsi ijambo ryiwe: Benewanyu babanka, bakabakumira, bakabakumira kubera izina ryanje, bavuze bati: “ Uhoraho nashimagizwe, kugira ngo tubone umunezero wanyu!” Ariko bazokwicwa n’isoni.
Nimwumve urwamo rw’umuvurungano ruri mu gisagara, nimwumve iyo nduru iri mu Ngoro! Ni urwamo rw’ Uhoraho , ariko arishura abansi biwe ibihwanye n’ivyo bakoze.
“Imbere yo gutera ibise, Yerusalemu haravyaye; imbere y’imibabaro, havyaye umwana w’umuhungu.
Ni nde yari bwavyumve? Ni nde yari bwabibone? Mbega igihugu covuka ku musi umwe, canke ihanga ryovyarirwa icarimwe? Ariko igihe co gutera ibise nicahera, Siyoni hazoba hamaze kwibaruka.
Mbega nzoshitsa umugore ku mwanya wo kuvyara, hanyuma sindamureke ngo avyare?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. “Mbega ndapfunga inda y’umuvyeyi hageze ko avyara?” ni ko Imana yawe ibaza.
“Nezeranwa na Yerusalemu mwongere muhahimbarirwe, yemwe abahakunda mwese; munezeranwe na ho cane yemwe abaharirira.
Kuko muzokwonka muhage, amabere yaho abahumuriza. Muzokwonka cane, mwongere munezererwe ubwiza bwaho buhebuje.”
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nzohasesekazako amahoro atemba nk’uruzi, n’ubutunzi bw’amahanga butemba nk’imigende; muzokwonka, murerurwe mu maboko yaho, habasimbagize ku bibero.
Nk’uko umuvyeyi ahumuriza umwana wiwe, ni ko nanje nzobahumuriza, namwe muzohumuririzwa i Yerusalemu.
Ivyo nimwabibona muzonezerwa, kandi muzototahara nk’ubwatsi. Abasavyi b’ Uhoraho bose bazobona ukuboko kwiwe, ariko abansi biwe bazobona uburake bwiwe.
Ehe raba Uhoraho aje afise umuriro, kandi imikogote yiwe ije nk’igihuhusi; azomanukana uburake bwiwe n’umujinya mwinshi, igihano ciwe kizanane n’imbeya z’umuriro.
Kuko Uhoraho azozana umuriro n’inkota, acire urubanza abantu bose, kandi abazotikizwa na we ni benshi.
Abiyeza bakitunganiriza kwinjira mu mashamba, bakagira imisi mikuru barya ingurube n’imbeba, hamwe n’ibindi bizira, bose bazohonera rimwe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nanje ndazi ibikorwa vyabo n’ivyiyumviro vyabo, kandi ngiye kuza negeranye amahanga yose n’indimi zose, na yo azoza abone ubwiza bwanje.

Nzoshira ikimenyetso muri bo, kandi nzorungika bamwe mu bazoba bacitse kw’icumu mu mahanga; i Tarushishi, muri Libiya n’i Ludi mu bazi kugwanisha imiheto, i Tubali no mu Bugiriki, no mu mazinga ya kure, aho bataramenya izina ryanje canke ngo babone ubwiza bwanje. Bazokwerekana ubwiza bwanje mu mahanga.

Bazozana ubwoko bwanyu, babakuye mu mahanga, babazane ku musozi wanje wera Yerusalemu, baze nk’ishikanwa ry’ Uhoraho , baje ku mafarasi, mu mikogote no mu bikwegana, ku nyumbu no ku ngamiya,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Bazobazana, nk’uko Abisirayeli bazana amashikanwa yabo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bayazanye mu bikoresho bimeze neza.
Nzobatoranyamwo bamwe ndabagire abaherezi n’Abalewi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nk’uko ijuru rishasha n’isi nshasha nzorema bizokwamaho, ni ko izina ryanyu n’uruvyaro rwanyu bizoramba,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Kuva mu mboneko z’ukwezi kumwe gushika mu z’ukundi, no kuva kw’Isabato kugeza ku yindi, abantu bose bazoza bampfukamire,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Bazosohoka baje kuraba imivyimba y’abangararije; inyo zabo ntizizopfa, kandi umuriro wabo ntuzozima, kandi bazotera ishishi abantu bose.”
